TL;DR: TagInsert：去掉解码器注意力掩码，让 Transformer 自行决定标签生成顺序，在词性标注与 CCG 超标注上优于 L2R 编码器-解码器模型，并在低资源与长尾类别上表现更好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 序列标注中各标签间的依赖未必符合从左到右（L2R）的自然顺序，而常规 Transformer 解码器强制 L2R 生成会限制建模能力并带来自回归误差传播。

Method: 提出 TagInsert：移除解码器端注意力掩码，使模型在推理时可自行决定标签生成顺序；在词性标注与 CCG 超标注任务、多语言及低资源设定下与 L2R 编码器-解码器、纯编码器（BERT）模型对比。

Result: TagInsert 常优于 L2R 编码器-解码器模型；在数据稀缺条件下达到与纯编码器模型相当的效果；在稀有类别的长尾分布上表现更佳；分析表明模型通过将困难预测推迟到解码后期来缓解自回归误差传播。

Conclusion: 解除 L2R 约束、学习生成顺序是提升序列标注的有效策略，可减轻误差传播，并在低资源与长尾场景下具有优势。

Abstract: This paper introduces TagInsert, a Transformer-based model that challenges the common left-to-right (L2R) generation paradigm in Transformers, for sequence labelling tasks where dependencies may not naturally align with a L2R order. TagInsert lifts the L2R constraint by removing the decoder-side attention mask and enabling the model to decide a preferred order of tag generation at inference time. We experiment on the common Part-of-Speech tagging and the more complex Combinatory Categorial Grammar (CCG) supertagging tasks on multiple languages and low-resource data settings. We show that, although encoder-only models like BERT remain strong performers for tagging tasks, TagInsert frequently outperforms a L2R encoder-decoder model, achieves results comparable to encoder-only models under data-scarce conditions, and shows better results on the long-tail of rare categories. Our analyses show that TagInsert alleviates error propagation typical of autoregressive models by learning to defer difficult predictions to later stages in the decoding process.

</details>


### [215] [TEM: Temporal State Tracking Memory for Large Language Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21900)
*Pengfeng Song,Yunkai Zhuang,Liye Shi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出免训练的时序状态跟踪记忆框架TEM，将事实存为带来源的版本化记录，并按来源顺序检索、标注历史版本后交给回答模型，提升多次更新事实相关问题的准确率并显著压缩证据长度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话中信息不断变化：新事实可能取代旧值，但旧值对后续问题仍可能相关。现有记忆机制难以同时保留事实的多个版本及其时序状态。

Method: TEM为免训练框架：将事实存为链接来源的版本化记录；检索相关版本，按来源顺序排列并对历史记录加时间标签后送入回答模型；事件记忆与原始对话轮次补充结构化事实缺失的细节。另在固定证据预算下评估混合记忆。

Result: 在600个会话、60个人设的420个问题上，四个开源模型关键实体命中率75.71-97.62%，历史居住地子集达96.67-100%；仅加历史标签即使整体命中率提升17.14-55.95个百分点；每答案证据仅94-118个token，比会话感知RAG少48.75-56.73%；在1,540个LoCoMo问题上，两个主干模型下保守分差分别为7.92与10.58个百分点。

Conclusion: 回答反复更新的信息时，应保留事实版本并向生成器显式暴露其时序状态；该策略在准确率与证据效率上均优于会话感知RAG。

Abstract: An agent's memory must remain useful as information changes across conversations. A new fact may replace an earlier value without making that value irrelevant to a later question. We present Temporal State Tracking Memory (TEM), a training-free framework for tracking these changes. TEM stores facts as versioned records linked to their sources. It retrieves relevant versions, places them in source order and labels historical records before passing the evidence to the answer model. Event memory and original dialogue turns provide details missing from structured facts. We evaluated TEM on 420 questions drawn from 600 sessions involving 60 personas. Across four open-weight models, key-entity hit rates reached 75.71-97.62% overall and 96.67-100.00% on the historical-residence subset. Adding historical labels to otherwise identical, source-ordered facts increased overall hit rates by 17.14-55.95 percentage points. The evidence was compact: 94-118 tokens per answer, or 48.75-56.73% less than session-aware retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). A further evaluation on 1,540 LoCoMo questions tested hybrid memory under a fixed evidence budget. TEM exceeded session-aware RAG with both backbones; conservative score differences were 7.92 and 10.58 percentage points. The results support preserving fact versions and exposing their temporal status to the generator when answering questions about repeatedly updated information.

</details>


### [216] [Learning Speech Attribute Representations via Multi-Teacher Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21941)
*Maryem Bouziane,Salima Mdhaffar,Yannick Estève*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出多属性多教师蒸馏框架，使单一SSL语音编码器通过共享骨干+属性专属分支，同时保留语义、说话人、语言和情感四类话语级表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后训练方法（knowledge distillation）通常只让自监督语音编码器学习单一话语级属性，尚不清楚一个编码器能否同时保持多种互补表征。

Method: 多属性、多教师蒸馏：以一个共享SSL骨干搭配各属性专属分支，从四个冻结教师模型分别蒸馏语义、说话人、语言与情感表征；并分析各分支学到的层聚合（layer aggregation）策略。

Result: 在多语种语义检索、说话人验证、语种识别、语音情感识别任务上，性能接近专用的单任务学生模型，而仅需一个共享编码器；层聚合分析显示不同语音属性自然涌现于SSL编码器的不同深度。

Conclusion: 单一共享SSL编码器可有效承载多属性表征，实现接近单任务模型的性能并提升参数效率；同时揭示了语音属性在编码器深度上的分层组织规律。

Abstract: Recent post-training approaches have shown that self-supervised speech encoders can be adapted to learn a single utterance-level speech attribute through knowledge distillation. In this work, we investigate whether a single speech encoder can simultaneously preserve multiple complementary utterance-level speech representations. We propose a multi-attribute multi-teacher distillation framework that learns semantic, speaker, language, and emotion representations from four frozen teacher models using a shared SSL backbone and attribute-specific branches. Experiments on multilingual semantic retrieval, speaker verification, language identification, and speech emotion recognition show that the proposed model achieves performance close to dedicated single-task students while requiring only a single shared encoder. Furthermore, the learned layer aggregation strategies reveal that different speech attributes naturally emerge at different depths of the SSL encoder, providing new insights into the organization of speech representations.

</details>


### [217] [Priming Base Models for Agentic Post-Training: An Open Midtraining Recipe](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22019)
*Soumye Singhal,Joseph Jennings,Ka Shun Shum,Alexander Bukharin,Khushi Bhardwaj,Zirui Liu,Venkat Srinivasan,Jonathan Li,Yash Jain,Kezhi Kong,Markus Kliegl,Olivier Delalleau,Sanjeev Satheesh,Mostofa Patwary*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一个开放的"中训练"(midtraining)配方，在预训练与后训练之间以256K长上下文、数千亿token训练自然软件工程数据与少量agent轨迹，显著提升两个Nemotron模型的SWE-bench等agentic基准表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿模型普遍引入预训练与后训练之间的midtraining阶段，但该阶段如何构建鲜有公开。预训练上下文短且几乎无agent交互，SFT数据多为合成且过长SFT会损害后续RL可训练性，需要填补这一空白。

Method: 在预训练与SFT之间插入midtraining：以256K上下文、数百亿至数千亿token训练多样化自然软件工程数据（打包仓库、PR、commit历史、构建日志）加少量agentic轨迹；在两个不同规模Nemotron上验证，并做消融；建立基于短固定SFT运行的评估协议，因base模型代理指标与后训练结果相关性不可靠。

Result: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning：500B midtraining token使SWE-bench Verified 60.7→64.5，Multilingual 55.8→62.8，Pro 32.0→35.5；Nemotron 3.5 Super：280B token使DeepSWE 11.7→15.7，Verified 72.9→74.3（均为相同全量SFT后）；两模型在不同agent harness下鲁棒性均提升。

Conclusion: midtraining是衔接预训练与agentic后训练的有效阶段，开放配方可迁移至不同规模模型；基于base模型的代理指标不可靠，应以短固定SFT运行作为评估协议。

Abstract: Frontier models, general-purpose and domain-specific alike, now include a midtraining stage between pretraining and post-training, but little has been published about how this stage is built. We present an open midtraining recipe that primes base models for agentic post-training, and we show its effectiveness on two Nemotron models of different sizes. Pretraining typically runs at short context and sees almost no agent interactions, while SFT data is mostly synthetic, and very long SFT stages can hurt the model's later RL trainability. Our midtraining stage sits between the two. It trains at 256K context for hundreds of billions of tokens on a diverse mixture of natural software-engineering data like packed repositories, pull requests, commit histories, and build logs together with a small share of agentic traces. On Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, 500B midtraining tokens improve SWE-bench Verified from 60.7 to 64.5, SWE-bench Multilingual from 55.8 to 62.8, and SWE-bench Pro from 32.0 to 35.5 after identical full SFT. On the larger Nemotron 3.5 Super, 280B midtraining tokens improve DeepSWE, a harder benchmark of long-horizon tasks, from 11.7 to 15.7 and SWE-bench Verified from 72.9 to 74.3 after identical full SFT. Midtraining also improves robustness across agent harnesses on both models. We report the ablations behind the recipe and an evaluation protocol built on short fixed SFT runs, since base-model proxy metrics did not correlate reliably with post-training results.

</details>


### [218] [Name-Bias in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22053)
*Kalyan Bhetwal,Ceren Mert,Ian Whitehouse*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对6个本地大语言模型开展姓名偏见评估：通过填空任务在姓名对之间选择，隔离年龄与性别效应，基于30万次响应发现模型偏好非刻板男性化、年长、常见、白人姓名，且性别偏见最显著、偏见高度依赖句式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 姓名隐含年龄、性别、种族等人口统计线索，是LLM偏见中隐蔽却强烈的触发因素；现有研究多集中于商业API模型，缺乏对本地部署模型及多属性（年龄/性别/流行度/种族）联合、控制变量式的系统评估。

Method: 选取6个来自不同厂商、不同参数规模的本地LLM；采用填空任务，令模型在成对名字中选择，姓名取自美国社会保障局数据集与Rosenman等的种族分类数据集；通过平衡姓名配对与固定句法结构的句式模板，隔离年龄与性别效应；累计收集30万条响应进行统计分析。

Result: 本地LLM中存在一致且可测量的姓名偏见：模型偏好刻板印象中较少男性化、更年长、更常见（流行度高）以及白人的姓名；偏见强度排序为性别>年龄>姓名流行度>种族；姓名偏见高度依赖具体句式，但其句式依赖程度不高于相关刻板印象本身。

Conclusion: 姓名偏见即便在本地LLM中依然普遍存在，凸显建立标准化评估方法与缓解策略的必要性。

Abstract: Names carry demographic indicators such as age, gender, and race, which makes them a subtle but strong target of bias in large language models (LLMs). In this work, we present an evaluation of name-based bias across 6 local large language models spanning multiple providers and parameter scales. Using a fill-in-the-blank task, we prompt these models to choose between pairs of first names drawn from U.S. Social Security Administration datasets and a race classification dataset by Rosenman et al.. Our experimental de- sign isolates age and gender effects through balanced name pairings and sentence templates that share a fixed syntactic structure. Across 300,000 local LLM responses, we find consistent and measurable name bias. Models prefer names that are less stereotypically male, older, popular, and white. Furthermore, we find that name-bias is highly sentence-dependent, but not more than associated stereotypes, and gender is the most significant bias, followed by age, name popularity, and race. Our results demonstrate that name-based bias remains pervasive even in local LLMs, highlighting the necessity for standardized evaluation methods and mitigation strategies.

</details>


### [219] [Beyond Context Length: Characterising the Difficulty of Long-Context Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22067)
*Shiwen Qin,Cameron Barker,Henry Gouk,Elliot J. Crowley,Shay B. Cohen,Mirella Lapata,Miao Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出以证据范围、证据分散度和推理深度三个属性刻画长上下文任务的真实难度，构建 LURCH 基准（6,550 题，含证据与推理图），实证表明这三者与模型表现强负相关，且难度可叠加。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长上下文评测把上下文长度当作难度的主要指标，但等长上下文可带来截然不同的挑战（单段可解 vs 需全局证据整合），长度无法解释模型在需复杂推理的长上下文任务上的失败。

Method: 定量定义三个难度属性：证据范围（需找到的必要信息量）、证据分散度（信息在上下文中的散布程度）、推理深度（导出答案所需的依赖步骤数）；据此构建多领域问答基准 LURCH，含 6,550 个实例并标注支撑证据与推理图，使三属性可量化；对闭源与开源权重模型进行评测与相关性分析。

Result: (1) 固定上下文长度下，三属性均与模型性能强负相关；(2) 随长度增加，证据分散样本性能急剧下降，而证据局部化样本相对稳定；(3) 难度跨属性叠加：三项均中等偏高的题目比仅一项极端的题目更难。

Conclusion: 证据范围、分散度与推理深度可作为长上下文推理难度的度量，补充而非替代上下文长度这一指标。

Abstract: Long-context language models support ever longer context windows, and evaluations typically treat context length as the main indicator of difficulty. However, context length alone cannot explain why models fail on long-context tasks that require reasoning over complex information. Contexts of equal length can pose very different challenges: a task may be solvable from a single local passage, or it may require integrating evidence distributed across the full context. We quantitatively characterise this difficulty through three properties: evidence scope, how much necessary information must be found; evidence dispersion, how widely that information is scattered within the context; and reasoning depth, how many dependent steps are needed to derive an answer from it. We construct LURCH, a multi-domain question-answering benchmark of 6,550 instances with supporting evidence and reasoning graphs, enabling all three properties to be quantified. Evaluations of proprietary and open-weight models show that: (1) at fixed context length, all our three properties are strongly negatively correlated with model performance; (2) as context length increases, performance degrades sharply on samples with dispersed evidence, whereas it remains relatively stable on samples with localised evidence; and (3) difficulty compounds across properties, as questions with moderately high values on all three are harder than those with an extreme value on just one. These findings establish evidence scope, dispersion and reasoning depth as measures of long-context reasoning difficulty that complement context length.

</details>


### [220] [The Right Byte First: How UTF-16 Helps Multilingual Boundary Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22071)
*Hyunsik Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: UBE将部分三字节UTF-8码点改写为两字节（低字节在前），使首符号携带8个低位码点位，从而在单符号前瞻下大幅降低字节级边界预测错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分层字节级语言模型用学习到的边界预测器把字节分组成patch，其"看到下一个码点"的能力受编码方式与前瞻长度制约。UTF-8中许多文字的三字节码点里，24位中有8位用于标记长度/续接，首字节仅含4个高位码点位，导致同一左下文后"延长字素簇的附加符"与"开启下一字母"可能共享首字节，无法区分。

Method: 提出Universal Byte-Level Encoding（UBE）：保留UTF-8的一、二字节编码，将三字节码点改写为两个UTF-16字节（低字节在前），并设置等长的大端变体作对照。在匹配的FineWeb-2语料上训练小型因果预测器，在FLORES-200上以UTF-8、UBE、大端变体三种编码评估，覆盖13种婆罗米系文字、17种语言，并测试保留父分词器字素边界子词切分的目标设置。

Result: 单符号前瞻下，婆罗米系文字码点边界的平衡字素边界错误率：UTF-8为8.76%，大端变体8.62%，UBE仅0.06%。目标保留父分词器子词切分时，同前瞻下UBE相对UTF-8平均错误降低：韩语72.91%、汉语35.29%、另外八种文字67.32%–99.55%。在主体Unicode块可容纳于单个256码点页的七种文字中，大端变体与UTF-8相差不超过3.0%，说明增益源于字节顺序而非长度；韩语、汉语中UBE仅用25%和37.5%训练量即低于UTF-8的最终平均错误。

Conclusion: 字节的先后顺序决定了字节级边界预测器所需的前瞻量：UBE通过低位字节优先暴露更多码点位，在单符号前瞻下即可近乎消除字素边界歧义，并显著减少训练所需步数。

Abstract: Many hierarchical byte-level language models group bytes into patches using a learned boundary predictor whose view of the next codepoint depends on encoding and lookahead. In UTF-8, codepoints of many scripts take three bytes: 8 of 24 bits mark length and continuation, and the first byte carries only 4 high codepoint bits. After the same left context, a mark extending a grapheme cluster and a letter starting the next can thus share their first byte. Universal Byte-Level Encoding (UBE) keeps one- and two-byte UTF-8 encodings but writes these codepoints as two UTF-16 bytes, low byte first, so its first symbol carries 8 low codepoint bits that can distinguish such continuations. We train small causal predictors on matched FineWeb-2 text and evaluate on FLORES-200 under UTF-8, UBE, and UBE's same-length big-endian variant. At one-symbol lookahead, balanced grapheme-boundary error at codepoint boundaries across 17 languages in 13 Brahmic scripts is 8.76% with UTF-8, 8.62% with the big-endian variant, and 0.06% with UBE. When the target instead retains a parent tokenizer's subword cuts at grapheme boundaries, UBE lowers the mean error relative to UTF-8 at the same lookahead by 72.91% in Korean, 35.29% in Chinese, and 67.32-99.55% in eight more scripts. In the seven of them whose main Unicode block fits on one 256-codepoint page, the big-endian variant stays within 3.0% of UTF-8, so the gain follows byte order, not length. In Korean and Chinese, UBE's mean error falls below UTF-8's final mean error after only 25% and 37.5% of training. Which byte comes first thus affects how much lookahead a byte-level boundary predictor needs.

</details>


### [221] [Multi-SFT: Permissively-Licensed Multilingual Instruction-Following](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22086)
*Daniela Baiamonte,Kamyar Zeinalipour,Elena Fano,Stefano Simonazzi,Andrea Zugarini*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Multi-SFT：一个可商业使用、覆盖五种欧洲语言、共502,818条指令-回复对的多语言监督微调数据集，通过翻译与再生成流水线构建，人工评估标注者一致性≥0.87；对三个模型家族九个模型（1B-32B）在13个基准上微调评测，证明单一Multi-SFT即可媲美更大规模混合数据与官方指令微调版本，且在安全任务上优势明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有监督微调（SFT）数据高度以英语为中心，且多由专有模型生成，其服务条款禁止用于训练竞品系统，导致商用授权受限、多语言覆盖不足，亟需可商业许可的多语言SFT数据资源。

Method: 构建Multi-SFT：覆盖五种欧洲语言、502,818条instruction-response pair；按任务类型分别采用翻译流水线与"翻译不足则再生成"（regeneration）流水线；通过人工评估验证质量（跨数据集与语言的标注者间一致性至少0.87）；在EuroLLM、OLMo 2、Qwen3三个模型家族共九个模型（1B–32B）上进行SFT，并在13个基准上评测。

Result: 人工评估中各数据集与语言的一致性指标均≥0.87；仅使用Multi-SFT微调即可与更大规模的增强混合数据及官方指令微调发布版竞争，并在安全类任务上取得明显优势。

Conclusion: Multi-SFT提供了可商业许可、高质量的多语言SFT数据，验证了"翻译+再生成"数据构建策略的有效性，表明精心构建的单一多语言数据集可替代庞杂混合数据，并显著提升模型安全性，为开放多语言模型训练提供可行路径。

Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning datasets remain overwhelmingly English-centric and commercially restricted, as their content is frequently generated by proprietary models whose terms of service forbid training competing systems. We introduce Multi-SFT, a commercially permissive collection of 502,818 instruction-response pairs across five European languages, built via translation and regeneration pipelines for tasks where translation is insufficient. Human evaluation yields inter-annotator agreement of at least 0.87 across all datasets and languages. Fine-tuning nine models from three different families (EuroLLM, OLMo 2, Qwen3; 1B-32B) and evaluating them on 13 benchmarks shows that Multi-SFT alone is competitive with larger augmented mixes and official instruction-tuned releases, with decisive advantages on safety tasks.

</details>


### [222] [Patch where the text is new: a compression view of where byte-level models should spend compute](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22100)
*Nicolás Vera Zúñiga*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出"新颖性分块"（novelty patching）规则：在即将出现的字节不太可能重复最近上下文的处开新patch，基于前两字节查表、无需标签或损失函数，在数学语料上显著提升计算中间结果与大模型准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BLT等字节级模型以"下一字节熵高"作为开patch的准则，但该准则很少在行内计算结果（如"="后的数字）处开patch，紧预算下这类内容准确率崩塌。作者借鉴LZ77压缩思想，希望用"可预测重复性"而非"surprisal"来确定边界。

Method: 规则为基于前两个字节的查表（lookup table），在原始文本上数秒内拟合，无需标签、参考模型或损失；在1.9 GB数学语料上以约11%匹配patch率从零训练BLT风格模型（每种3个种子），并在1M/12M/50M参数规模下与熵规则对比；同时分析边界落点分布（boundary enrichment、chance enrichment），并与H-Net学习式分块器和若干失败方案对照。

Result: 1M参数下无明显效果；12M下最终答案准确率47%→72%；50M下计算结果准确率21%→57%，最终答案准确率60%→90%；在原始预训练语料上拟合的表仍保留增益。非数学域优势减弱：散文上降低bits per byte，代码与合成执行轨迹上仅与熵打平。边界分析显示熵规则边界富集度最高（1.61）却最专注于高surprisal字节、在计算结果上最差；最佳规则接近随机富集度。

Conclusion: 新颖性分块在"新内容起始于靠近计算的段首"的场景（如书面数学）有效；H-Net等学习式分块器可自行发现此类结构（数学与代码均适用）。失败方案包括：将类型化不确定性作为训练规则、训练后切换规则、上下文感知的新颖性预测器。

Abstract: Byte-level language models such as the Byte Latent Transformer (BLT) run their large global model once per patch and start a patch where a small model's next-byte entropy is high. This rule rarely starts a patch at in-line computed results, such as the number after "=" in a worked solution, and accuracy on them collapses under tight patch budgets. We propose novelty patching, motivated by LZ77-style compression: start a patch where the upcoming bytes are unlikely to repeat the recent context. The rule is a lookup table over the previous two bytes, fitted in seconds on raw text with no labels, reference model or losses. In BLT-style models trained from scratch on a 1.9 GB math corpus at a matched ~11% patch rate (3 seeds each), it has no clear effect at 1M parameters, raises final-answer accuracy from 47% to 72% at 12M, and at 50M raises computed-result accuracy from 21% to 57% and final-answer accuracy from 60% to 90%; a table fitted on the raw pretraining corpus keeps the gain. Outside math the advantage shrinks: novelty lowers bits per byte on prose and ties entropy on source code and on synthetic execution traces. An analysis of where boundaries fall explains the pattern. Computed results have ordinary surprisal for the patcher's model, so surprisal-seeking rules pass over them: entropy concentrates patch starts on high-surprisal bytes most strongly of all rules (boundary enrichment 1.61) and is the worst on computed results, while the best rules sit near chance enrichment. Novelty works where new content begins at segment starts close to the computation, as in written math; a learned chunker (H-Net) finds such structure on its own, in math and in code. We also report what did not work: typed uncertainty as a training rule, switching rules after training, and a context-aware novelty predictor.

</details>


### [223] [Unfragmenting Nawatl NMT: Single-Variant Specialization for Masewalkopa](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22110)
*Luis A. Mercado-Campos,Alexis Palmer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 针对墨西哥原住民语言Nawatl的"变体碎片化"问题，本文以mT5-large为基础，为Santa Ana Tlacotenco村的Masewalkopa变体（nhn）构建专用翻译模型，通过有限状态分析器提供功能句法前缀，并用CTranslate2 int8量化实现低成本CPU部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少数民族（低资源）语言技术常用做法是把多个变体的文本合并为单一语料以缓解数据稀疏，但密切相关的原住民变体混合会生成不对应任何单一说话人社群的人工语域，作者称之为"变体碎片化"的结构性失败。该问题在墨西哥Nawatl等语言上尤为突出。

Method: 基于7万对多变体基础数据，将mT5-large微调至Masewalkopa（nhn）变体：整理2,665对平行语料，全部句级数据保留作评测，并通过非对称回译引入192句长老转写目标句；自研有限状态分析器把未分析表面形式从82.0%降至19.9%，并以纯文本前缀形式提供功能句法标签，使模型复用现有子词嵌入而非依赖冻结的特殊token；采用LoRA微调。

Result: LoRA-v9c-b模型取得58.46 dev chrF++，双向测试chrF++为58.20/57.90；CTranslate2 int8量化将CPU单请求延迟从137.5秒降至1.8–2.6秒。

Conclusion: 变体专用化+形态分析引导可在极低资源下获得可用翻译质量，量化后支持成本可控的Cloud Run部署；揭示了"变体碎片化"这一混合语料的结构性风险。

Abstract: In minoritized (low-resource) language technologies, a common response to data sparsity is to aggregate text across multiple varieties and treat the combined data as a single corpus. However, mixed corpora of closely related indigenous variants can produce an artificial register that is accountable to no single speaker community, a structural failure we call variant fragmentation. This issue is acute for minoritized languages native to Mexico, such as Nawatl. Building on a 70,000-pair multi-variant foundation, we specialize an mT5-large checkpoint to Masewalkopa (nhn), the Nawatl variety spoken in Santa Ana Tlacotenco. We curate 2,665 parallel pairs, reserve all sentence-level data for evaluation, and incorporate 192 elder-transcribed target sentences via asymmetric backtranslation. A custom finite-state analyzer reduces unanalyzed surface forms from 82.0% to 19.9% and supplies functional syntax tags as plain-text prefixes, allowing the model to reuse existing subword embeddings rather than relying on frozen special tokens. The resulting LoRA-v9c-b model achieves 58.46 dev chrF++ and 58.20/57.90 directional test chrF++. Finally, CTranslate2 int8 quantization reduces CPU latency from 137.5 to 1.8-2.6 seconds per request, enabling cost-bounded Cloud Run deployment.

</details>


### [224] [Explaining the Roles of Experts in Mixture-of-Experts LLMs for Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22127)
*Sekh Mainul Islam,Pepa Atanasova,Isabelle Augenstein*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出对混合专家（MoE）大语言模型进行个性化适配，利用MoE稀疏路由降低神经元多义性，从而可定位、理解并因果控制个性化特征所对应的专家与潜变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往LLM个性化主要集中在稠密模型上，而稠密模型的多义神经元（单个神经元编码多个无关概念）阻碍了对个性化组件的定位，进而难以理解与控制个性化机制。

Method: 在三个开源MoE LLM上基于大规模个性化数据集进行适配；在个性化与非个性化模型的配对激活上训练crosscoder，学习可解释的个性化潜变量，并据此识别编码不同个性化特征的专家。

Result: 个性化MoE模型仅激活一小部分参数即可与稠密模型表现相当；在相近激活参数量下多义性更低；同一模型家族内个性化潜变量与非个性化模型共享更少。因果干预表明这些潜变量足以恢复个性化模型行为，增强其关联专家可将非个性化模型推向个性化模型，并揭示不同个性化特征对应不同路由路径。

Conclusion: MoE架构通过降低多义性实现个性化的可定位与因果可控，为可解释、可控制的LLM个性化提供了新路径。

Abstract: Personalization of Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasingly important for user-centric applications, yet prior methods mainly adapt dense LLMs, whose polysemantic neurons, each encoding multiple unrelated concepts, hinder localizing the components behind personalization, and thus understanding and controlling it. We propose to personalize Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs, which sparsely route each token to a few specialized experts, reducing polysemanticity and enabling such localization. We adapt three open-weight MoE LLMs on a large-scale personalization dataset and train crosscoders on paired activations of the personalized and non-personalized models to learn interpretable personalized latents, from which we identify the experts encoding distinct personalization features. The personalized MoE LLMs perform competitively with dense LLMs while activating only a fraction of their parameters, exhibit lower polysemanticity than dense LLMs with similar active parameters, and, within the same model family, yield personalized latents that are less shared with the non-personalized model. Causal interventions show that these latents suffice to recover the personalized model's behavior and that boosting their associated experts moves the non-personalized model toward it, revealing distinct routing paths for different personalization features.

</details>


### [225] [Intern-Decision: Efficient Multimodal Decision Making with Autoregressive Masked Language Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22131)
*Tong Zhu,Zhe Xu,Zefeng He,Yunkai Chai,Xuyang Hu,Dehong Zheng,Yun Luo,Yafu Li,Qi Zhang,Yu Cheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Intern-Decision系列（0.8B/2B/4B）多模态决策模型，通过"自回归掩码语言建模"在单个因果前向中并行输出结构化选择及候选概率，兼顾精度、低延迟与校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式智能体需在有限动作/标签/序数结果中反复做选择；对每个选择生成自由文本响应会引入额外延迟，并使模型与环境之间的接口复杂化。目标是让决策输出成为结构化、低成本、可校准的一步。

Method: 在完整助手JSON骨架中为每个字段放置一个决策占位符（placeholder），采用自回归掩码语言建模目标；真值符号仅出现于监督信号中，推理时所有字段在单次因果前向中并行评估，直接复用骨干网络原生语言模型头输出候选概率；支持文本与可选图像输入；规模为0.8B/2B/4B。

Result: 4B模型在7个评测套件上取得90.02%非加权平均准确率，Jev v1.13.0为88.74%；固定289 token、3字段请求在单张RTX 4090上平均时延44.16 ms（4B），小模型约33–34 ms。96例已知分布试点中，温度缩放将期望多分类Brier从0.628降至0.550、ECE从0.213降至0.089。基于置信度的handoff在111条Jevbench-Hard上将准确率由82/111(73.87%)提升至97/111(87.39%)，其中42条被路由至Atria-Dawn-Preview。另给出游戏、视觉界面与浏览器演示。

Conclusion: 紧凑型决策模型可作为大型智能体系统的实用组件：单次前向即完成多字段结构化决策，具备低延迟、可校准与可组合（置信度路由）特性。

Abstract: Interactive agents repeatedly choose among a finite set of actions, labels, or ordinal outcomes. Generating a free-form response for each choice adds latency and complicates the interface between a model and its environment. We present Intern-Decision, a family of 0.8B, 2B, and 4B multimodal decision models that return structured choices and candidate probabilities from text and optional images. Our autoregressive masked language modeling objective places one decision placeholder per field in a complete assistant JSON skeleton. Ground-truth symbols appear only in supervision, while all fields are evaluated in a single causal forward pass using the backbone's native language-model head. The 4B model achieves a 90.02% unweighted average accuracy across seven evaluation suites, compared with 88.74% for Jev v1.13.0. For a fixed 289-token request with three fields on one RTX 4090, mean latency is 44.16 ms for the 4B model and approximately 33--34 ms for the smaller models. On a separate 96-case known-distribution pilot, temperature scaling reduces expected multiclass Brier from 0.628 to 0.550 and expected calibration error from 0.213 to 0.089. A confidence-based handoff study on 111 public Jevbench-Hard items improves accuracy from 82/111 (73.87%) to 97/111 (87.39%) by routing 42 items to Atria-Dawn-Preview. We also describe qualitative game, visual interface, and browser demonstrations. These results support compact decision models as a practical component of larger agent systems.

</details>


### [226] [PremiseSQL: Evaluating Premise Critique and Abstention in Text-to-SQL Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22158)
*Shuo Lin,Jinzhe Li,Chenlu Guo,Yanhan Li,Yuan Wu,Yi Chang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出NL2SQL中的"前提批判"能力，即识别有缺陷的用户查询并拒绝生成误导性SQL；构建了包含1800条有缺陷查询及其1800条原始查询的基准PremiseSQL（四类前提失败），并设计评估框架，在三种提示设置下衡量内在与提示诱导的前提感知行为。实验表明前沿LLM默认高度信任前提、很少批判缺陷；强化批判导向的提示能提升检测与弃答率，但也会增加误判为无效并抑制对原始查询的SQL生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有NL2SQL系统普遍假设用户查询合法且可回答，导致模型即便面对前提有缺陷的查询仍生成可执行SQL，产生误导性结果，缺乏对无效查询的识别与弃答能力。

Method: 提出PremiseSQL基准，含四类前提失败共1800条有缺陷查询及配对的1800条原始查询；设计评估框架，通过三种提示设置区分内在（intrinsic）与提示诱导（prompt-induced）的前提感知行为，并对前沿LLM进行实验。

Result: 前沿LLM默认强烈信任查询前提，极少批判缺陷前提；更强的批判导向提示可提升对有缺陷查询的检测与弃答，但同时提高误判为无效的比率，并抑制对原始合法查询的SQL生成，呈现明显的权衡。

Conclusion: NL2SQL系统需具备前提批判与合理弃答能力，而非一味生成可执行SQL；所提基准与评估框架为衡量该能力提供工具，并揭示当前模型在检测能力与生成效用之间的固有张力，提示未来需在提示设计与模型训练中兼顾二者。

Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have substantially improved Text-to-SQL performance, yet existing NL2SQL systems largely assume that user queries are valid and answerable. As a result, models often generate executable SQL even for queries with flawed premises. We introduce premise critique ability in NL2SQL, namely the ability to recognize flawed queries and abstain from generating misleading SQL. To evaluate this capability, we propose PremiseSQL, a benchmark containing 1,800 flawed NL2SQL queries across four categories of premise failures, along with their 1,800 original queries. We further design an evaluation framework to measure intrinsic and prompt-induced premise-aware behavior across three prompting settings. Experiments on frontier LLMs show that current models are strongly premise-trusting by default and rarely critique flawed premises. Stronger critique-oriented prompting improves detection and abstention on flawed queries, but also increases false invalid judgments and suppresses SQL generation on originals. The code is available at https://github.com/vegeet/PremiseSQL.

</details>


### [227] [EMO: A Closed-Loop Test-Time Computation Framework via Alternating Context Optimization and Logits Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22160)
*Wei Xia,Yehui Tang,Zhi-Hong Deng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: EMO是一个免训练框架，借鉴EM算法在测试时交替进行问题特定上下文估计（E步）与分布精炼（M步），通过置信约束的logit校正在生成过程中注入强化信号，在8个模型6个基准上优于零样本与TextGrad基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时上下文优化通过文本反馈适配冻结语言模型，但普通条件生成无法单独控制对上下文更新所引发分布变化的强化强度，缺乏对"上下文改进"与"生成时干预"两个环节的解耦控制。

Method: 受期望最大化启发，交替执行：E步借助外部评判者提供的文本梯度（无金标答案）修订系统上下文；M步在共享前缀处对比修订前后上下文下的下一词分布，构建置信约束的logit校正（steering vector由上下文引发的logit位移导出）；对引导后响应的反馈驱动下一轮上下文更新。理论上通过共享的target-KL目标与加性logit表示联系参数优化与上下文优化。

Result: 在上下文改进与忠实引导假设下，证明足够小引导强度下target KL散度单轮下降。贪心解码、8模型6基准下，40个聚合设置中39个优于零样本，平均+9.10个百分点；同评判者下较TextGrad平均+1.53点，MMLU-Pro跨模型一致提升；等目标模型生成预算下，Llama上相对best-of-N优势最明显，多数比较中oracle覆盖率更高但候选更少。

Conclusion: 将测试时计算联合分配给候选生成与验证（覆盖—选择差距）是提升效果的关键方向；EMO实现了上下文优化与生成时干预的耦合，且免训练、具理论保证。

Abstract: Test-time context optimization adapts frozen language models through textual feedback, but ordinary conditional generation provides no separate control over how strongly to reinforce the distributional changes induced by a context update. We introduce EMO, a training-free framework inspired by expectation--maximization that alternates question-specific context estimation (E-step) and distribution refinement (M-step). The E-step revises a system context using textual gradients from an external judge without access to gold answers. The M-step contrasts next-token distributions under the revised and preceding contexts at a shared prefix to construct a confidence-constrained logit correction. Feedback on the steered response drives the next context update, coupling adaptation across rounds with intervention within each generation. Theoretically, we connect parameter and context optimization through a shared target-KL objective and additive logit representations, and derive the steering vector from context-induced logit displacements. Under context-improvement and faithful-steering assumptions, we prove a one-round decrease in target KL divergence for sufficiently small steering strength. Under greedy decoding across eight models and six benchmarks, EMO improves the zero-shot baseline in 39 of 40 aggregated settings, averaging $+9.10$ percentage points. With the same judge, it adds $+1.53$ points on average over context-only optimization (TextGrad), with consistent MMLU-Pro gains across models. At matched target-model generation budgets, accuracy advantages over best-of-$N$ are strongest on Llama, while oracle coverage is higher in most comparisons despite fewer candidates. The coverage--selection gap motivates allocating test-time computation jointly to candidate generation and verification.

</details>


### [228] [CLUE: Uncovering Social Context for Pragmatic Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22167)
*Chengfei Wu,Zhaoqing Wu,Dan Goldwasser*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CLUE：两阶段训练框架，将监督式证据推理与由Grounded Information Utilization（IUG）引导的GRPO相结合，训练模型在会话中自主发现并利用关键线索做出社会性解读，无需额外提供上下文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解对话需将其与说话者的关系、期望及先前交流相联系。已有研究表明提供相关上下文可提升模型的社会判断能力，但这类信息大多已隐含在对话本身之中，因此有必要训练模型自行发现关键线索并据此支撑解读。

Method: 提出CLUE两阶段训练流程：第一阶段为监督式证据推理；第二阶段为GRPO强化学习，奖励函数为Grounded Information Utilization（IUG），该奖励对新颖且由证据支持的社会推断给予正向激励，同时计入推理开销。训练使用小规模对话样本，评估有效性及跨任务、跨语言、跨体裁的泛化能力；推理阶段模型以自包含方式对给定交互进行推理。

Result: 相较基座Qwen，CLUE在平均加权F1上域内相对提升17.3%，域外相对提升9.3%，并在5项域外评测中的4项取得更高F1；两个域的推理token数平均减少逾80%。人工评估显示CLUE的解释更常基于具体对话内容，其引用证据与人工标注上下文更一致。

Conclusion: 显式训练模型发现并利用对话内已有线索，可同时提升社会判断性能与跨域泛化性，并显著降低推理开销、增强解释的证据性。

Abstract: Understanding a conversation requires connecting what is said to the speakers' relationships, expectations, and earlier exchanges. Prior work shows that supplying relevant context can improve models' social judgments, but much of this information may already be present in the conversation. This motivates training models to discover the cues that matter and use them to support an interpretation. We propose CLUE, a two-stage training pipeline that combines supervised evidence reasoning with GRPO guided by Grounded Information Utilization ($\mathrm{IU}_{\mathrm{G}}$). This reward credits new, evidence-supported social inferences while accounting for reasoning effort. We train on a small set of conversational examples to assess effectiveness and generalization across tasks, languages, and genres. At inference time, the trained model reasons over the supplied interaction in a self-contained manner. Compared with base Qwen, CLUE achieves relative gains of 17.3% in-domain and 9.3% out-of-domain in average weighted F1, with higher F1 on four of five out-of-domain evaluations. These gains are accompanied by over 80% fewer reasoning tokens on average in both domains. Human evaluation further finds that CLUE more often grounds its explanations in specific conversational content, with closer alignment between its quoted evidence and human-selected context.

</details>


### [229] [Lexical Reference Frames: Interpreting LM Residual Streams in Native Semantics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22169)
*Jian Gu,Hongyu Zhang,Chunyang Chen,Aldeida Aleti*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"词汇参考系"(lexical reference frame)：每个隐状态存在一个由后续读取它的层诱导、随上下文自适应的"原生参考系"，可用模型自身剩余层读出一个状态来解释。一阶版本 LexFrame[1] 在 SmolLM3-3B/OLMo3-7B 中层相干度达 0.97，输出偏差仅 0.16 nats，并支持更忠实的归因、可选择性引导以及提前退出（跳过 0.45/0.42 的层）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型的词汇表（embedding/unembedding）只固定了残差流两端的语义，中间隐状态缺乏与模型阅读方式一致的解读方式。现有方法要么复用固定 lens（每层固定方向），要么把状态视为点云，都无法"像模型那样"读取状态，导致中间表示难以解释、归因与操控。

Method: 提出词汇参考系：以读取该状态之后各层诱导的、上下文自适应的参考系为目标；用模型自身剩余层近似——位置间做指定轮数的注意力、其余部分用一个典型注意力输出代替，且不拟合模型的输出。定义一阶版本 LexFrame[1]（首阶近似），并给出理论界：任意固定方向 lens 的相干度上界为原生参考系相干度的平方根。

Result: 固定 lens 在 SmolLM3-3B 与 OLMo3-7B 中层相干度仅 0.30 与 0.35（受 √coherence 上界限制），LexFrame[1] 达到 0.97 与 0.97，读出与模型输出差距在 0.16 nats 内；其系数比 attribution patching 更忠实地归因预测，词汇基可在引导某一预测时基本不干扰其他 token，其高置信读出可使提前退出跳过 0.45 与 0.42 的层（lens 几乎无法跳过）。

Conclusion: 词汇参考系使模型的每个隐状态都可读、可归因、可引导，为中间表示解释与控制提供了统一且与模型计算一致的框架。

Abstract: The vocabulary of a language model is its native semantics: the embedding and the unembedding fix the meaning of a state at the two ends of the residual stream. Between them, existing methods either reuse a fixed lens or treat the states as a point cloud, and neither reads a state the way the model does. We argue that every hidden state has a native reference frame, induced by the layers that read it next and adaptive to the context. Lexical reference frames approximate it by reading a state through the model's own remaining layers with a stated number of rounds of attention between positions and a typical attention output for the rest, without fitting to the model's output. No lens, with fixed directions per layer, can exceed the square root of the native frame's coherence, 0.30 and 0.35 at mid-depth of SmolLM3-3B and OLMo3-7B, whereas the first-order frame, LexFrame[1], reaches 0.97 and 0.97 and reads a state within 0.16 nats of the model's output. Its coefficients attribute predictions more faithfully than attribution patching, its lexical basis steers a prediction while sparing other tokens, and its confident readings would let an early exit skip 0.45 and 0.42 of the layers, where lenses skip almost none. In this way, lexical reference frames make every hidden state of the model readable, attributable and steerable.

</details>


### [230] [Mosaic: Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22174)
*Yilong Xu,Minrui Xu,Xinyu Zhou,Xiang Long,Haochen Tan,Zhijiang Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出多会话智能体强化学习设定（Multi-Session Agentic RL），并给出无评论器分层优化方法 Mosaic，在轨迹级与会话级分别建模优势，于 BrowseComp 上优于广播式基线并减少会话使用数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体强化学习普遍假设单会话轨迹（交互在单一持续累积的上下文中进行）。然而上下文压缩（context compaction）、子智能体分叉（subagent forking）等技术会产生跨多个会话的轨迹，使训练假设与推理执行不匹配。同时，常用的"轨迹级优势广播到所有会话"做法无法区分各会话贡献，也无法引导轨迹内的会话分配。

Method: 提出多会话智能体 RL 设定，支持一条轨迹内任意数量会话。方法 Mosaic 采用无评论器（critic-free）的分层优化：轨迹级将"会话使用信号"纳入优势估计；会话级依据估计的边际贡献对每个会话的优势进行塑形。

Result: 在 Qwen3.5-4B 上于 BrowseComp 的实验中，Mosaic 在上下文压缩与子智能体分叉两种场景下均优于优势广播基线，且平均使用的会话数更少。

Conclusion: 进一步分析表明该方法在会话效用与会话分配方面均有提升；作者认为会话效用与分配是多会话智能体 RL 未来进展的一个有前景的方向。

Abstract: Most existing agentic reinforcement learning methods assume single-session trajectories, where interaction proceeds within one continuously accumulated context. However, agentic techniques such as context compaction and subagent forking may produce trajectories spanning multiple sessions, creating a mismatch between the single-session training assumption and inference-time execution. Therefore, we introduce Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning, a more general setting that supports an arbitrary number of sessions within a trajectory. Under this setting, a widely adopted method is to broadcast trajectory-level advantages to all sessions, but this does not distinguish contributions from various sessions or guide session allocation within trajectories. To address this issue, we propose Mosaic, a multi-session agentic RL method with critic-free hierarchical optimization. At the trajectory level, it incorporates session-usage signals into advantage estimation. At the session level, it shapes each session's advantage according to the estimated marginal contribution. Experiments on BrowseComp with Qwen3.5-4B show that Mosaic outperforms broadcasting in both context compaction and subagent forking scenarios while using fewer sessions on average. Further analyses show that our method achieves improvements in session utility and allocation, which we suggested is a promising target for future advances in multi-session agentic RL.

</details>


### [231] [Change the Number, Change the Answer: Assessing Rating Scale Sensitivity in LLM-Based Text Scoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22187)
*Wonjeong Jo,Gyuwan Kim,Ming Shan Hee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文定义并系统研究了“量表敏感性”（rating scale design 引起的 LLM 打分变化），区分数值敏感性与语义敏感性，通过 2 格式×4 范围×2 正负号×3 任务×2 提示策略×5 模型的交叉实验发现：改变单一设计要素平均使归一化分数偏移约 0.10、并改变约 20% 文本的类别；毒性任务最敏感，rubric 提示不能降低敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 被广泛用于计算社会科学中为社会与心理构念赋分，但不同研究采用不同评分量表，跨量表设计的分数可比性缺乏研究，存在测量效度隐患。

Method: 形式化定义量表敏感性并拆分为数值敏感性（归一化分数变化）与语义敏感性（分数解释变化）；采用全因子交叉实验设计：2 种格式（连续/序数）×4 种范围（3/5/11/21 点）×2 种正负号（有符号/无符号），覆盖 3 个任务（政治倾向、情感、毒性）、2 种提示策略（zero-shot、rubric-based）与 5 个 LLM。

Result: 改变单一量表设计要素平均使归一化分数偏移约 0.10，并使约 20% 文本的类别归属发生改变；敏感性在毒性任务（唯一单极构念）上最强；rubric-based 提示相较 zero-shot 并未降低敏感性。

Conclusion: 量表设计显著影响 LLM 文本打分的数值与解释层面可比性，单极构念尤甚，且提示工程难以缓解；建议在 LLM 打分研究中报告量表设计细节、进行跨替代量表的稳健性检验，并据此提供量表设计实践指南。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in computational social science to assign scalar scores to social and psychological constructs. However, studies use different rating scales, and whether their scores remain comparable across scale designs is understudied. To address this gap, we define and systematically investigate scale sensitivity, the variation in LLM-generated scores caused by rating scale design. We distinguish numerical sensitivity, changes in normalized scores, from semantic sensitivity, changes in score interpretation. To assess both, our experimental design crosses 2 formats (continuous vs. ordinal), 4 ranges (3, 5, 11, and 21 points), and 2 signs (signed vs. unsigned) across 3 tasks (political leaning, sentiment, and toxicity), 2 prompting strategies (zero-shot and rubric-based), and 5 LLMs. We find that changing one design element shifts normalized scores by about 0.10 on average and changes the category of roughly 20% of texts. Sensitivity is greatest for toxicity, the only unipolar construct examined. Also, rubric-based prompting does not reduce sensitivity compared with zero-shot prompting. We provide practical guidance for designing more reliable LLM-based text scoring and highlight the need for robustness checks across alternative scales.

</details>


### [232] [Hy-Memory-30B-A3B: Attributed Reinforcement Learning for Long-Term Memory Writing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22196)
*Tianxiang Fei,Jiazheng Kang,Mao Zheng,Xingyan He,Xiang Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出统一跨记忆框架的长期记忆写手 Hy-Memory-30B-A3B，通过 On-Policy 蒸馏与记忆强化学习实现跨 Mem0/MemOS/Hy-Memory 的写路径统一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 外部记忆系统效果依赖模型的"写路径"（保留什么、如何表示、如何更新），而现有方案多用通用大模型配框架专用提示，成本高且单一协议写手难以迁移，缺少跨框架统一模型。

Method: 紧凑型 30B-A3B 模型，跨三个框架训练；先做 Memory On-Policy Distillation 在学生自生成状态上学习各框架写协议，再用 Memory RL（稠密分块探针、跨块归因奖励、过度存储控制、chunk-level GRPO）优化下游可答性；跨窗口携带策略写入的记忆库以对齐训练与部署。

Result: 在固定 20% 基准子样本上，于四个评测框架（含留出集 EverMemOS）全部排名第一，宏平均 55.49% 对比 Claude Opus 5 的 54.62%。

Conclusion: 专门化的小型写手模型可跨记忆框架统一并超越通用大模型，训练-部署一致性设计有效。

Abstract: External-memory systems extend language-model applications beyond a context window, but their quality depends critically on the model executing the write path: deciding what to retain, how precisely to represent it, and how new evidence should update persistent state. Existing frameworks typically place a general-purpose large language model behind framework-specific prompts. This raises serving cost, and a writer specialized for one protocol does not transfer directly to another; a unified model that can operate across established memory frameworks remains largely unexplored. We present Hy-Memory-30B-A3B, a compact long-term-memory writer trained across Mem0, MemOS, and Hy-Memory. Memory On-Policy Distillation teaches framework-specific write protocols on student-generated states; Memory RL then optimizes downstream answerability using dense per-chunk probes, attributed cross-chunk rewards, over-storage controls, and chunk-level GRPO. Carrying policy-written banks across windows keeps training aligned with deployment. On fixed 20% benchmark subsamples, Hy-Memory-30B-A3B ranks first on all four evaluated harnesses, including held-out EverMemOS, with a 55.49% macro average versus 54.62% for Claude Opus 5.

</details>


### [233] [Beyond Downstream QA: Rethinking How We Evaluate Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22209)
*Sebastian-Antonio Toma,Jean de Kernier,Mike Ply,Oliviu Matei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出FEB-30基准，用"范式反转"从已知事实演化轨迹生成文档以获得确定性真值，揭示仅用下游问答准确率评估Agent记忆是不完整的，内在与外在评估平均分歧达16个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Agent记忆基准以下游问答准确率作为记忆质量的代理指标，混淆了记忆正确性与检索、生成质量，既产生"正确答案掩盖记忆损坏"的假阳性，也产生"错误答案误伤正确记忆"的假阴性，评估范式不完整。

Method: 构建FEB-30基准：30条事实演化轨迹，覆盖6个诊断类别与3个难度层级；采用范式反转（paradigm inversion），由已知事实轨迹反向生成文档，从而无需人工标注即获得确定性真值。每条轨迹定义事实在多作者制品（文档、邮件、对话）间应如何演化，支持在每次摄取后直接检查记忆存储。并在代表性记忆系统上应用该基准进行诊断分解。

Result: 内在评估与外在评估平均分歧16个百分点，44%的轨迹超过显著分歧阈值；系统对记忆操作（create、update、reinforce、supersede）的正确分类率仅20%，该失败在外在评估中完全不可见；失效模式随类别和难度系统性变化。

Conclusion: 仅依赖下游问答准确率无法可靠衡量Agent记忆质量，需引入可直检记忆存储的内在评估。作者开源基准、文档生成流水线与评分框架，以支持可复现的Agent记忆系统评估。

Abstract: Agent memory benchmarks evaluate whether an agent's responses reflect correct knowledge, measuring downstream question-answering accuracy as a proxy for memory quality. We show this evaluation paradigm is incomplete: it conflates memory correctness with retrieval and generation quality, producing both false positives where correct responses mask broken memory and false negatives where incorrect responses blame correct memory for retrieval failures. We introduce FEB-30, a benchmark of 30 fact-evolution trajectories spanning 6 diagnostic categories and 3 difficulty levels, constructed via paradigm inversion: documents are generated from known fact trajectories, yielding deterministic ground truth without human annotation. Each trajectory defines how a fact should evolve across multi-author artifacts (documents, emails, conversations), enabling direct inspection of the memory store after each ingestion step. Applying FEB-30 to a representative memory system, we demonstrate that intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation diverge by an average of 16 percentage points, with 44% of trajectories exceeding meaningful divergence thresholds. Diagnostic decomposition reveals that the system correctly classifies memory operations (create, update, reinforce, supersede) only 20% of the time, a failure entirely invisible to extrinsic evaluation, and that failure modes differ systematically by category and difficulty. We release the benchmark, document generation pipeline, and scoring framework to support reproducible evaluation of agent memory systems.

</details>


### [234] [Not X, but When: Diagnosing a Mandarin LLM Writing Tic through Contextual Appropriateness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22249)
*Yihang Peng,Yi Jing,Dewen Liu,Weihan Meng,Ying Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型对"复用表达是否得体"的判断能力，以汉语纠正构式"不是X，而是Y"为案例，提出三分决策树（实质/可选/缺陷）标注307例模型用法，发现模型错误率仅1.30%，但"正确却非必要"的用法占52.8%，且奖励模型、LLM评委与训练流程均偏向鼓励该构式，说明模型在得体性上的欠缺远大于在正确性上的欠缺。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型生成的重复性表达常被当作机器文风的"签名"，但多数其实具有合理功能；判断其为"口头禅"还是合法用法，取决于模型是否知道该表达何时才恰当。这种"得体性判断"属于交际能力的核心，却鲜有研究。作者希望把评价焦点从"是否正确"转向"是否得体"。

Method: 以汉语纠正构式"不是X，而是Y"为研究载体，结合Gricean语用学与纠正性否定理论，构建决策树：检验语境是否使X成为"活的备选项"、以及否定X是否具有信息量，从而将用法分为实质性（substantive）、可选（optional）、缺陷（defective）三类。将五个商业模型的构式使用密度与人类参照文本对比，并对307条用例进行人工标注；同时考察奖励模型、LLM评委的偏好，以及SFT与偏好优化对开放权重模型中该构式频率的影响。

Result: 五个商业模型使用该构式的密度是人类参照的2.5–9.2倍。307条标注用例中仅1.30%为缺陷用法，而52.8%为"可选"——即语法正确但语境并不需要。多个奖励模型即使面对质量匹配的变体也偏好该构式；LLM评委在语境并不许可时仍偏好该构式；SFT与偏好优化均倾向于在开放权重模型中提高其使用频率。

Conclusion: 模型的失误主要不是"用错"，而是"不必用却用了"，即得体性缺陷显著多于正确性缺陷；而现有奖励模型、LLM评委与主流训练范式仍在系统性放大这一偏差。作者呼吁发展关注自身表达得体性的模型，并将构式层面的语用判断作为评估模型交际能力的一个可操作切口。

Abstract: Recurring expressions in model-written text are often treated as signatures of machine authorship, yet most of them serve legitimate functions. Whether such an expression is a tic depends on whether the model knows when it is called for. This judgment of appropriateness, central to communicative competence, remains largely unexamined for language models. We study it through the Mandarin corrective construction bushi X, ershi Y ("not X, but Y"). Drawing on Gricean pragmatics and corrective negation, we introduce a decision tree that classifies uses as substantive, optional, or defective by testing whether the context makes X a live alternative and whether rejecting X is informative. Five commercial models use the construction 2.5 to 9.2 times as densely as a human reference. Of 307 annotated uses, only 1.30% are defective while 52.8% are optional, that is, correct but unneeded, so models fall short in appropriateness far more often than in correctness. Several reward models favor the construction even over quality-matched variants, an LLM judge favors it even where the context does not license it, and both supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization tend to raise its frequency in open-weight models. We hope this work encourages the development of models attentive to the appropriateness of their expressions.

</details>


### [235] [Multi-Target Few-Shot Prompting with Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22294)
*Anton Xue,Alan Li,Rahul Saha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出多目标少样本提示（multiple masked infilling）结合扩散语言模型，并用选择性掩码构造似然比奖励以强化示例支持填充，提升示例编辑/API迁移等任务准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少样本提示在指令与奖励难以明确指定时有用（如按示例编辑格式、API迁移）。但这类编辑依赖左右上下文，因果自回归模型生成不便；且少样本提示中模型常难可靠遵循示例。

Method: 1) 多目标少样本提示：以扩散语言模型在共享画布上对多个掩码区域同时填充，示例作为引导；2) 选择性掩码画布导出似然比奖励，偏好示例支持的填充。

Result: 在少样本提示基准与软件重构案例中，示例提升填充准确率，似然比奖励式示例引导在多种设置下带来进一步增益。

Conclusion: 扩散式多目标填充天然适配双向上下文编辑任务，配合似然比奖励可更可靠地利用演示示例。

Abstract: Few-shot prompting is useful when instructions and rewards are hard to specify. One such application is editing by example, where a demonstrated formatting change or API migration may need to be applied across multiple sites. However, such edits often depend on both left and right context, making generation with causal autoregressive models awkward. We therefore introduce multi-target few-shot prompting with diffusion language models, where examples guide the infilling of multiple masked regions within a shared canvas. To address the known challenge of reliably following demonstrations in few-shot prompting, we further leverage selective masking of the canvas to derive a likelihood-ratio reward that favors example-supported infills. Across few-shot prompting benchmarks and software refactoring case studies, we find that demonstrations improve infilling accuracy, with example guidance yielding further gains in several settings.

</details>


### [236] [AI Consilium: a Benchmark of LLM Clinical Multidisciplinary Second Opinions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22298)
*Alexey A. Bokov,Ivan I. Panin,Nikolay B. Nechaev,Mikhail Yu. Valkov,Valeria Yu. Chernina,Natalia Gombolevskaya,Ayyaz Hussain,Vladimir M. Agafonov,Victor A. Gombolevskiy,Aleksandr V. Nesterov,Iaroslav R. Bespalov,Ivan V. Oseledets,Dmitry V. Dylov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究构建了基于NEJM-MedQA病例的多维基准，用医生校准的LLM评审评估八种单模型流水线生成的鉴别诊断报告，发现模型身份对报告质量的影响强于响应格式，结构化报告在管理建议等方面更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM可为复杂病例生成鉴别诊断，但有用的"第二意见"还须事实可靠、临床连贯、可操作且安全；现有评估难以在统一框架内区分模型能力、多学科综合的贡献、响应结构的效应与推理需求。

Method: 构建多维基准：选取300例已有诊断结论的NEJM-MedQA病例（110例用于医生参考评分与Judge校准，190例作留出评估）。八种单模型流水线在自由形式与结构化临床推理条件下生成角色专属独立意见与交互式会诊报告。由医生校准的LLM Judge评估3,040份最终报告及对应的结构化主角色输出。

Result: 模型身份比响应格式更能区分报告质量；八条流水线中七条的结构化最终报告总体均分更高，管理维度优势最明显（2.740 vs. 2.436）。相较结构化会诊前的主角色意见，完整结构化综合在全部五项共享标准上汇总得分更高，问题优先级、事实依据与推理连贯性提升最大。GPT-5.6-Sol在各评估组件中均领先，并以最少轮次达成共识。

Conclusion: 该基准可在同一常见病例评估中区分模型能力、多学科综合的贡献、响应结构的准则特异性效应、审议动态及推理需求，为临床第二意见的可靠评估提供多维框架。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate differential diagnoses for complex cases, but a useful second opinion must also be factually grounded, clinically coherent, actionable, and safe. We developed a multidimensional benchmark using 300 diagnostically resolved NEJM--MedQA cases: 110 for physician reference ratings and Judge calibration and 190 for held-out evaluation. Eight single-model pipelines generated independent role-specific opinions and interactive-consilium reports under free-form and structured clinical-reasoning conditions. A physician-calibrated LLM Judge evaluated 3,040 final reports and the corresponding structured primary-role outputs. Model identity separated report quality more strongly than response format. Structured final reports had higher overall mean scores in seven of eight model pipelines, with their clearest advantage in management (2.740 vs. 2.436). Compared with the structured pre-consilium primary-role opinion, the complete structured synthesis had higher pooled scores across all five shared criteria, with the largest increases in problem prioritization, factual grounding, and reasoning coherence. GPT-5.6-Sol led every evaluated component and reached consensus in the fewest review rounds. These findings show that the benchmark can distinguish model capability, the contribution of multidisciplinary synthesis, criterion-specific effects of response structure, deliberation dynamics, and inference requirements within one common-case evaluation.

</details>


### [237] [Knowledge That Is Linear Before Fine-Tuning Generalizes After It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22300)
*Faridoun Mehri,Hinrich Schütze*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出并研究"活跃事实"(支持跨样本泛化)与"惰性事实"(仅可回忆)的区分。通过将已有关系(如地点→大洲)的答案重新标记为新关系(如Paris→crab),在11个模型、70个关系上微调并测试对未见过但原关系答案相同的子句的泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型能回忆的事实并非都同等支持进一步学习。作者希望厘清"可回忆"与"可泛化"之间的区别,并找出预测新关系泛化能力的因素。

Method: 构造新关系:取原关系(Paris→Europe)并对其答案任意重标(Europe→crab),得到新关系(Paris→crab)。在子句子集上微调模型,不告知原关系与重标规则,测试对共享原答案的留出子句是否赋予对应标签。测量原关系在预训练表示中的线性可读性,并与泛化表现做跨关系相关分析;控制微调子句数与答案数、原关系准确率、子句预训练词频;做标签重随机化、微调种子、替换14类语义标签等稳健性检验;并将错误标签映射回原答案以检验线性探针的解释力。

Result: 原关系在预训练表示中的线性可读性强烈预测泛化能力,模型内跨关系Pearson r=0.87–0.92;该关联在单独及联合控制多个混淆因素后仍成立,且对标签重随机、种子更换、语义类别替换稳健。将错误标签映射回原答案后,恢复出的答案更多出现在线性探针对该子句的top答案中,而非预训练模型自身的top答案中。

Conclusion: 新关系能否泛化,较少取决于其事实是否可回忆,而更多取决于其共享结构是否能被线性读出。

Abstract: Not all facts a language model can recall support further learning equally well. We distinguish active facts, which support generalization beyond their own recall, from inert facts, which can be recalled but do not support such generalization in a given task. We study this distinction by constructing new relations from existing ones. Take the relation that maps a place to its continent (Paris -> Europe) and assign each of its answers an arbitrary new label (Europe -> crab, Asia -> zebra). The new relation then maps Paris -> crab. We fine-tune the model on the new relation for a subset of subjects, without telling it the original relation or the relabeling rule, and test whether it assigns the corresponding labels to held-out subjects that share an answer in the original relation. Having learned Paris -> crab, does it answer Munich -> crab? Across eleven language models and 70 relations, how linearly readable the original relation is in pretrained representations strongly predicts this generalization. Within each model, the two correlate across relations at Pearson r = 0.87 to 0.92. This association persists when controlling, separately and jointly, for the number of fine-tuning subjects and answers, the model's accuracy on the original relation, and how often the subjects occur in pretraining text. It is also robust to re-randomizing the label assignment and fine-tuning seed, and to replacing the animal labels with labels from thirteen other semantic categories. When we map a fine-tuned model's wrong label back to the original answer it was assigned to, Munich -> zebra becomes Munich -> Asia. Answers recovered this way are more often among the linear probe's top answers for the subject than among the pretrained model's own. Whether a new relation generalizes depends less on whether its facts can be recalled than on how readily their shared structure can be read out linearly.

</details>


### [238] [Grid-Bench: Can LLMs Predict How Discrete Worlds Change?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22312)
*Zixiang Xu,Zirui Song,Wanrong Zheng,Chiyu Zhang,Yue Huang,Yuyang Peng,Kexin Zhang,Jinkun Chen,Xiuying Chen,Xiangliang Zhang,Yan Liu,Laurent Itti,Frank Shyu,Xiaoqiang Luo,Sandeep Pandey,Xi Liu,Luke Simon,Xiyang Hu,Yue Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 Grid-Bench，一个可执行基准，用 2D/3D/4D 离散网格上的八类空间操作与事件历史文本，检验大语言模型能否从初始网格、显式规则和历史逐步预测完整最终网格，并对六个模型进行评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间指令会连续作用于已被先前改动塑形的中间配置，而现有评测缺乏对多步空间操作后整体状态可逐格验证的度量方式，因此需要厘清 LLM 对复合空间变换的推演准确度。

Method: 构建可执行基准 Grid-Bench：八类操作族在 2D/3D/4D 网格上变换离散世界；输入为初始网格、显式规则与文本形式事件历史，输出为完整最终网格；以参考执行器逐格校验预测值，从而在不同空间操作、历史长度与工作量下进行可比分析；评测六个 LLM。

Result: 随历史增长，全状态准确率急剧下降；单事件表现相近的模型在长历史上出现显著分化；精确匹配率相近的模型在同一实例上的错误单元数差异明显；即便历史很长，部分模型仍能正确恢复出多于"直接复制初始状态"的改动量。

Conclusion: Grid-Bench 使完整状态恢复能力及模型间返回状态的差异在多类空间条件下可度量，揭示了 LLM 在序列空间操作上的系统性局限，为后续评测与方法改进提供可执行、可验证的基准。

Abstract: Spatial instructions describe how to move objects, transform regions, or modify their surroundings. When several operations are applied in sequence, each acts on a configuration shaped by earlier changes. How accurately can large language models (LLMs) predict the resulting spatial state? We introduce Grid-Bench, an executable benchmark in which eight families of operations transform discrete worlds represented as two-, three-, and four-dimensional grids. Given an initial grid, explicit rules, and an event history expressed as text, a model predicts the complete final grid. Reference execution makes every predicted value checkable, supporting comparisons across spatial operations, history lengths, and workloads. Evaluating six LLMs shows that complete-state accuracy falls sharply as histories grow, with substantial divergence among models that perform similarly on single events. Models with similar exact-match accuracy can nevertheless differ substantially in the number of incorrect cells on shared instances. Even over long histories, some models recover many correct changes beyond what copying the initial state would yield. Grid-Bench makes both complete recovery and these differences in returned states directly measurable across a range of spatial conditions.

</details>


### [239] [MindEval2: Clinically Grounded Patients and Rubrics for Evaluating Language Models in Mental Health Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22314)
*John Mendonça,Daniel Tschernutter,José Pombal,Areti Vassilopoulos,Catarina Botelho,Ignacio Sarasua,Maya D'Eon,Nuno Guerreiro,Ricardo Rei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 MindEval2 评估框架，由可解释的心理健康质量量表 MHQR 与带记忆的患者模拟器 MindSim 组成，用于评测 AI 心理咨询聊天机器人，并发现引导校准是各模型的主要失效模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人们越来越多地使用 AI 聊天机器人获取心理健康支持，亟需可靠评估方法。现有基准通过合成患者模拟多轮对话并用 LLM-as-a-judge 打分，但模拟患者往往过于主动、自我反思过度，且评判依赖不透明、实用性不明的 Likert 量表，评估结果难以落地。

Method: MindEval2 包含两部分：(1) MHQR（Mental Health Quality Rubrics）——与博士级心理学家合作制定的量表，将回复质量拆解为明确、可操作的评判标准，比现有分类体系更可解释、可执行；(2) MindSim——LLM 脚手架，结合精心设计的患者画像与工具，生成更多样、更具挑战性且更真实的交互，并内置在各轮交互间更新的记忆组件，以刻画心理健康的纵向特征。

Result: 在 MindEval2 上评测了 18 个闭源与开源模型，发现前沿模型在表层质量与边界问题上已明显改善，但引导校准（guidance calibration）仍是所有模型的共同主导失效模式，占据质量差距的绝大部分。

Conclusion: 更贴近真实、且判定标准可解释的评估框架能更清晰地定位模型短板；引导校准应成为心理健康对话系统改进的核心方向。

Abstract: With people increasingly turning to AI chatbots for mental health support, the need to evaluate these tools is becoming more pressing. Recent benchmarks attempt to mimic a realistic setting by simulating multi-turn interactions with synthetic patients and evaluating them with an LLM-as-a-judge. However, the usefulness of these methods is limited because simulated patients can be overly forthcoming and self-reflective, and judgments typically involve opaque Likert scales with unclear practical utility. To bridge these gaps, we introduce MindEval2, an evaluation framework that consists of two components: Mental Health Quality Rubrics (MHQR), for evaluation, and MindSim, for patient simulation. For MHQR, we collaborate with PhD-level psychologists to develop a set of rubrics that break down response quality into explicit operational criteria that are more interpretable and actionable than existing evaluation taxonomies. MindSim, in turn, is an LLM harness that combines carefully-designed patient profiles with tools, enabling more varied, challenging, and realistic interactions than existing baselines. The harness also contains a memory component that is updated between each interaction, enabling MindEval2 to model the longitudinal aspect of mental health. We evaluate 18 proprietary and open-weight models on MindEval2, finding that while frontier models have largely improved on issues related to surface level quality and boundaries, guidance calibration remains the dominant failure mode across all models, accounting for most of the quality gap.

</details>


### [240] [Training Reasoning Models to Generate Diverse Scientific Ideas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22324)
*Manya Wadhwa,Pranav Narayanan Venkit,Hiroaki Hayashi,Yu Li,Tuhin Chakrabarty,Chien-Sheng Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究"基于文档的想法生成"，提出用集合级强化学习目标训练 LLM，在单次生成中产出 K 张有据可依的结构化想法卡片，并按"质量 × 与前序想法距离"联合打分，使 8B 模型在创意效用上超过 Claude Opus 4.8 与 GPT-6 Astra，且多样性提升不损失可执行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 自动化研究想法生成的工作多聚焦于单个想法的质量优化，忽视了想法集合的多样性；而实际研究流程需要一组既有高质量、又彼此明显不同、同时紧扣输入文档的想法。

Method: 提出文档基础的想法生成（document-grounded ideation）任务，并采用集合级强化学习目标：模型在一次生成中写出 K 张基于源论文的结构化 idea cards，对整个集合联合评分，每个想法的质量按其与先前想法的距离加权，从而引导模型将新想法推离其前驱想法。

Result: 在无污染的基准上，训练的 8B 模型创意效用（质量与多样性的综合指标）高于 Claude Opus 4.8 和 GPT-6 Astra；四位专家的人 pilot 研究中，其想法集合被评为与 Claude Opus 4.8 同样有前景，独特想法略多；由编码 agent 进行概念验证实验时，success@k 与 Claude Opus 4.8 相当。

Conclusion: 集合级强化学习可有效提升有据想法生成的多样性而不牺牲质量；新增的多样性不以可执行性为代价，说明小模型在该任务上可与大模型竞争。

Abstract: One of the first steps of a research pipeline is generating ideas. Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to automate this step, but most of this work optimizes the quality of individual ideas, while overlooking diversity. In our work, we study document-grounded ideation, focusing on increasing the diversity of LLM generated ideas and ensuring they are high quality. Given prior papers, a model must propose a set of ideas that are each high-quality and clearly distinct from one another, while also being grounded in the input documents. To optimize for this, we propose training with a set-level reinforcement learning objective. In our setup, in a single generation, the model writes K structured idea cards grounded in the source papers, and the set is scored jointly, where each idea's quality is weighted by its distance from the ideas written before it. This teaches the model to steer each new idea away from its predecessors. We show that our trained 8B model achieves higher creative utility (a measure combining quality and diversity) than Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-6 Astra on our contamination-free benchmark. In a pilot human study with four experts, our sets are judged as promising as Claude Opus 4.8's and contain marginally more unique ideas. When a coding agent runs proof-of-concept experiments on the ideas, our model's success@k is comparable to Claude Opus 4.8's, so we see that the added diversity does not cost any executability.

</details>


### [241] [OmniVerifier-C1: Decomposed Graded Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22355)
*Bowei Liu,Xinchen Zhang,Xuhuan Li,Tianlin Zhang,Kaian Jiang,Jingwei Liu,Congyang Zhao,Yifei Qian,Junhong Liu,Zhiheng Li,Yujiu Yang,Yang Cai,Ling Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出逐点分级（pointwise graded）生成式视觉验证器，将复杂提示/规则自动分解为细粒度子问题并给出连续评分，配合解耦强化学习训练策略，在文本到图像与规则驱动的世界建模任务上优于二元验证器，并从理论上论证了在有真值图像时成对（pairwise）验证更精确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统二元验证器仅输出True/False离散判断，在涉及组合性要求的复杂多模态场景中鲁棒性与信息量不足，缺乏可解释的细粒度反馈，且对域外多模态评判任务泛化能力有限。

Method: 1) 将复杂提示或环境规则自动分解为细粒度子问题，并对每个子问题给出逐点打分，输出结构化、可解释的连续评价信号；2) 提出解耦强化学习（Decoupled RL）训练策略，在通用RL框架下联合优化子问题级二元判断与全局对齐评分，以局部精确反馈支撑全局连续评分能力；3) 理论上分析逐点与成对验证范式的精度差异。

Result: 在传统文本到图像场景中，逐点分级验证器显著优于二元验证器；在规则驱动的生成式世界建模（如Maze、Sudoku等结构化任务）中同样验证了方法有效性；理论分析表明，当存在真值图像时，成对验证范式比逐点范式给出更准确的评价。

Conclusion: 结构化、可解释的逐点分级输出提升了验证器在域外评判任务上的泛化能力；从生成模型迈向结构化世界建模智能体的关键，在于具备准确的成对分级视觉验证器。

Abstract: Generative visual verifiers play a crucial role in advancing multimodal intelligence. To enhance the robustness of visual verifiers in complex multimodal scenarios involving compositional requirements, we move beyond conventional binary verifiers that produce only True/False discrete judgments and introduce a verifier that automatically decomposes complex prompts or environmental rules into fine-grained components and assigns pointwise scores to provide a continuous and more informative critique signal. Our experiments further demonstrate that these structured and interpretable outputs improve the verifier's generalization to out-of-domain multimodal critic tasks. To train this verifier, we introduce a Decoupled RL training strategy that jointly optimizes sub-question-level binary judgment and global alignment scoring, using precise local feedback to develop fine-grained verification capabilities that provide a foundation for reliable continuous scoring at the global level. Under a general reinforcement learning framework, we first empirically demonstrate that the proposed pointwise graded verifier significantly outperforms binary verifiers in traditional text-to-image scenarios. We then extend our investigation to rule-governed generative world modeling where generative models are leveraged for world simulation and world reasoning under explicit rules. From a theoretical standpoint, we further show that a pairwise verification paradigm yields more accurate critiques than the pointwise formulation when ground-truth images are available, with empirical results on diverse structured world-modeling tasks such as Maze and Sudoku further validating the effectiveness of our approach. Overall, our findings suggest a key insight: the transition from generative models to structured world-modeling agents critically hinges on the availability of accurate pairwise graded visual verifiers.

</details>


### [242] [KULTURE Bench: A Benchmark for Assessing Language Model in Korean Cultural Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.07251)
*Xiaonan Wang,Jinyoung Yeo,Joon-Ho Lim,Hansaem Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 KULTURE Bench，一个面向韩国文化的评估框架，包含文化新闻、成语与诗歌数据集，从词、句、段落三个层级考察语言模型的文化理解与推理能力。实验表明现有模型在深层韩国文化文本理解上仍有明显提升空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大模型生成内容愈发流畅连贯，其评测难度上升；现有多语言基准多直接使用英语版本的翻译文本，可能携带西方文化偏见，无法准确评估其他语言与文化。因此需要构建原生文化导向的评测基准以填补该空白。

Method: 构建 KULTURE Bench 评估框架，收集韩国文化新闻、成语和诗歌三类数据集，覆盖词级、句级和段落级三个粒度，用于评测模型的文化理解与文化推理能力；并在该基准上对不同语料训练的模型进行系统评测与综合分析。

Result: 评测结果显示，各模型对涉及韩国文化深层内涵的文本理解仍存在显著不足，尚有较大改进空间；不同语言语料训练的模型表现存在差异。

Conclusion: 翻译式多语言基准存在文化偏差，原生文化基准对真实评估模型文化能力具有必要性；KULTURE Bench 为韩语文化能力评估提供了多维框架，并揭示当前模型在深层文化理解上的短板。

Abstract: Large language models have exhibited significant enhancements in performance across various tasks. However, the complexity of their evaluation increases as these models generate more fluent and coherent content. Current multilingual benchmarks often use translated English versions, which may incorporate Western cultural biases that do not accurately assess other languages and cultures. To address this research gap, we introduce KULTURE Bench, an evaluation framework specifically designed for Korean culture that features datasets of cultural news, idioms, and poetry. It is designed to assess language models' cultural comprehension and reasoning capabilities at the word, sentence, and paragraph levels. Using the KULTURE Bench, we assessed the capabilities of models trained with different language corpora and analyzed the results comprehensively. The results show that there is still significant room for improvement in the models' understanding of texts related to the deeper aspects of Korean culture.

</details>


### [243] [Bridging the Gap: Converting Read Text to Conversational Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18001)
*Parshav Singla,Agnik Banerjee,Aaditya Arora,Shruti Aggarwal,Anil Kumar Verma,Vikram C M,Raj Prakash Gohil,Gopal Kumar Agarwal*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出PACC方法，利用深度神经网络与HiFi-GAN将朗读语音转换为自然对话语音，通过调整语调、重音与节奏等韵律特征，在提升自然度的同时在MOS评测上取得更优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 朗读语音缺乏自然对话所需的细腻韵律变化（语调、重音、节奏），而虚拟助手、客服、语言学习等应用需要自然且可实时处理的对话语音，现有方法难以兼顾自然度、可懂度与计算开销。

Method: PACC（Prosodic Adjustment with Conversational Context）：采用先进深度神经网络分析并修改韵律特征（语调、重音、节奏），并结合HiFi-GAN高保真生成对抗网络进行语音合成，以对话上下文指导韵律调整。

Result: 实验显示语音转换效果显著提升，自然度增强；在更多语音数据集上训练后模型准确率进一步提高，并在语音转换任务及MOS评测上建立了新的基准。

Conclusion: 该方法可有效将朗读语音转换为自然对话语音，并可成功扩展至其他语音转换应用。

Abstract: In recent advancements within speech processing, converting read speech to conversational speech has gained significant attention. The primary challenge in this domain is maintaining naturalness and intelligibility while minimizing computational overhead for real-time applications. Traditional read speech often lacks the nuanced prosodic variation essential for natural conversational interactions, posing challenges for applications in virtual assistants, customer service, and language learning tools. This paper introduces a novel approach, Prosodic Adjustment with Conversational Context (PACC), aimed at converting read speech into natural conversational speech used in various modern applications. PACC utilizes advanced deep neural networks to analyze and modify prosodic features such as intonation, stress, and rhythm. Unlike conventional methods, our approach uses High-Fidelity Generative Adversarial Networks (HiFi-GAN) for speech synthesis. Our experimental results demonstrate significant improvements in speech conversion, enhancing naturalness and achieving better model accuracy with additional training on speech datasets. This research establishes new benchmarks in speech conversion tasks and Mean Opinion Score (MOS) evaluation for testing model accuracy, and we show that our approach can be successfully extended to other speech conversion applications.

</details>


### [244] [Truth for Believable AI: Expressed Doubt, Provenance, and Belief Revision as an Engineerable Stance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26035)
*Sebastian Cochinescu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文将"表达不确定性、来源感知断言、显式信念修订"实现为固定语言模型之上的行为层，用构造的多轮基准评测：合成模型通过全部五项检查；Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct 上仅"构造性审计保证"与"依赖存储的部分纠错判别"成立，基于平均答案token概率的表达门控失败（AUC 0.41），改用采样一致性门控后（AUC 0.66）仅在特定选择下满足标准，结论受基准与模型限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话代理通常以统一自信的语气作答，缺乏不确定性表达、来源区分与信念修订能力。作者希望检验这些认知行为能否作为独立行为层叠加在固定（不微调）的语言模型之上，而非检验其可信度或被信任程度。

Method: 构建行为层：三种认知状态、逐声明置信度与带类型来源标注、来源门控的表达规则、持久化修订存储（含可审计确认与对虚假纠正的部分抵抗）。在机械打分、多会话的构造基准上，用合成模型与 Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct 评测，并预设多项指标边际；后续披露的事后分析比较平均token概率门控与采样一致性门控。

Result: 合成仪器通过全部五项检查；真实模型上确认可靠性（构造性保证）达100%，真实纠正接受率高于虚假纠正（0.44 vs 0.15；含规则接受未持有事实纠正时为0.875 vs 0.420），但预设的表达保真度、矛盾分离度与来源边际均未达标。事后分析：token概率门控端到端排序低于随机（AUC 0.41，按会话聚类），采样一致性门控有判别力（AUC 0.66）；依此选出的配置在独立承诺协议下达标并在重抽会话集上复现。

Conclusion: 结论受限于三点：构造性审计保证、依赖存储的部分纠错判别、以及token概率门控在特定基准与模型上的失败。操纵效应依赖配置选择；当不确定性在60个事实上聚类时两项标准仍无法判定，需扩大事实库后方可开展人类评估。

Abstract: Conversational agents often express answers in a uniformly confident register. We test whether expressed uncertainty, provenance-aware assertion, and explicit belief revision can be implemented as a behavior layer over a fixed language model; we do not test believability or trust. The layer combines three epistemic states, per-claim confidence and typed provenance, a provenance-gated expression rule, and a persistent revision store with auditable acknowledgments and partial resistance to false corrections. We evaluate it on a constructed, mechanically scored multi-session benchmark using a synthetic model and Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct. The synthetic instrument passes all five checks. On the real model, acknowledgment soundness, a by-construction guarantee, holds in 100% of cases, and true corrections are accepted more often than false ones (0.44 vs. 0.15 on held beliefs; 0.875 vs. 0.420 including rule-accepted corrections of unheld facts), but the pre-specified expression-fidelity, contradiction-separation, and provenance margins fail. A disclosed post hoc analysis shows that expression gated on mean answer-token probability ranks correctness below chance end to end (AUC 0.41, conversation-clustered), whereas gating on sampling consistency discriminates (AUC 0.66). A consistency-gated configuration selected from this finding and evaluated under a separately committed protocol meets the conversation-level manipulation and capability-equivalence criteria and replicates on a redrawn conversation set. The manipulation result is selection-dependent, and both criteria remain unresolved when uncertainty is clustered over the 60 facts. The supported conclusions are limited to the by-construction audit guarantee, store-dependent partial correction discrimination, and a benchmark- and model-specific failure of token-probability gating; scaling the fact base is required before human evaluation.

</details>


<div id='cs.AR'></div>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [245] [A LoRa-Compatible Receiver with Programmable Noise-Power Trade-Off and Integrated Wake-Up Mode](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20677)
*Marco Gonzalez,Pol Maistriaux,Jérôme Louveaux,David Bol*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出首个集成唤醒模式、具备可编程噪声-功耗折衷的LoRa兼容接收机，实现主接收机与WuRX的无缝集成，避免额外功耗、面积、复杂度与成本开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可编程接收机可适应无线信道的多变条件；通过对噪声-功率折衷的深入分析，可将唤醒电路嵌入主接收机，从而无缝集成唤醒接收机（WuRX），避免系统在功耗、面积、复杂度与成本上的额外开销。

Method: 对接收机噪声-功率折衷进行全面分析，设计带内嵌唤醒电路的主接收机，实现LoRa兼容的双模式（主接收机模式与唤醒模式）接收机，并支持可编程的噪声-功率折衷配置。

Result: 主接收机模式下，功耗4.57 mW、灵敏度-138 dBm，可节省至多62.6%功耗但灵敏度下降8.3 dB；唤醒模式下，32 ms延迟内灵敏度达-126 dBm，功耗1.5 mW；因PLL设计次优，唤醒模式功耗仍偏高，但比主接收机最低噪声配置低3倍。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了主接收机与唤醒模式集成及可编程噪声-功率折衷的可行性，唤醒模式功耗较主接收机最低噪声配置降低3倍；后续可通过优化PLL设计进一步降低唤醒模式功耗。

Abstract: Programmable receivers allow an optimal performance in the variable conditions of the wireless channel. An extensive analysis of their noise-power trade-off enables the development of a main receiver with embedded wake-up circuitry. This makes the seamless integration of wake-up receivers (WuRXs) in RF receivers possible, avoiding power, area, complexity, and cost overheads in the system. In this paper, we propose the first LoRa-compatible receiver with an integrated wake-up mode and a programmable noise-power trade-off. In main-receiver mode, it consumes 4.57 mW for a sensitivity of -138 dBm, but it can save up to 62.6% of power consumption at the cost of an 8.3-dB sensitivity degradation. In wake-up mode, sensitivity down to -126 dBm is achieved for a 32-ms latency and 1.5 mW of power consumption. The power consumption remains relatively high due to a sub-optimal design of the the phase-locked loop (PLL). In the end, the wake-up mode consumes 3X less than the lowest-noise configuration in main-receiver mode.

</details>


### [246] [Helix: A Unified Programmable Accelerator for Diverse Krylov Subspace Solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21096)
*Wei Chen,Yizhi Yuan,Linghao Song*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: Helix 提出一种面向 Krylov 子空间方法族的系统化加速器设计方法，通过抽象通用计算原语、构建可编程原语内核与可编程数据通路，并用 DSL 编译器将多种求解器映射到同一架构，在 Alveo U55C 上实现八种求解器的零切换延迟复用与高能效执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 领域专用加速器虽高效但缺乏对可扩展算法族的支持；现有 Krylov 方法 FPGA 加速器通常只支持单一求解器（如仅 JPCG），或需为不同求解器重新配置硬件，导致复用性差、切换开销大。

Method: 1) 系统化算法族设计方法：从多种 Krylov 求解器中抽象共性计算原语；2) 围绕高效、可编程的原语内核构建架构，并引入可编程数据通路协调原语调用；3) 架构解耦硬件实现与求解器特定执行，实现 HBM 复用与零求解器切换延迟；4) 提供 DSL 编译器，将不同求解器映射到架构上并针对各求解器优化向量运算性能。

Result: 在 Xilinx Alveo U55C FPGA 上原型验证，编译并执行八种求解器：相比仅支持 JPCG 的 Xilinx XcgSolver 与 SOTA 加速器 Callipepla 分别取得最高 7.91x 和 1.16x 加速；八种求解器吞吐达 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU 的 47.5%–96.9%，能效高 2.29x–4.66x，单位峰值内存带宽吞吐高 1.89x–3.85x；可编程组件带来 0.25%–0.57% 执行时间开销及 4.7% LUT、4.0% FF 资源开销。

Conclusion: Helix 证明了以"原语抽象+可编程数据通路+DSL 编译"为核心的方法能在单一 FPGA 架构上高效支持多样化 Krylov 求解器族，可编程性带来的性能与资源开销可忽略，兼顾了专用加速器的高效率与算法族的可扩展性。

Abstract: Domain-specific accelerators deliver high performance and energy efficiency through specialization but often lack support for extensible algorithm families. Existing FPGA accelerators for Krylov subspace methods, which iteratively solve sparse linear systems, typically support a single solver or require separate hardware configurations. Helix follows a systematic algorithm-family design methodology that first abstracts common computational primitives from diverse Krylov solvers and builds the architecture around efficient, programmable primitive kernels. Helix then introduces programmable datapaths to coordinate these primitives. Its architecture decouples hardware implementation from solver-specific execution, enabling HBM reuse and zero solver-switching latency. Finally, Helix provides a DSL compiler that efficiently maps different solvers onto the architecture while optimizing vector-operation performance for each solver. We prototype Helix on a Xilinx Alveo U55C FPGA and evaluate Helix's practicality and performance by using it to compile and execute eight solvers. Helix achieves up to 7.91x and 1.16x speedups over Xilinx XcgSolver and the state-of-the-art FPGA accelerator Callipepla, respectively, both of which support only JPCG. Across the eight solvers, Helix sustains 47.5% - 96.9% of the throughput of an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU while delivering 2.29x - 4.66x higher energy efficiency and 1.89x - 3.85x higher throughput per unit peak memory bandwidth. The programmable components incur 0.25% - 0.57% execution-time overhead and 4.7% LUT and 4.0% FF overhead, demonstrating negligible overhead for programmability.

</details>


### [247] [PSA: A Pruning-Friendly Sparse-Aware Accelerator for Efficient Sparse Convolution in SNNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21313)
*Sanhe Fu,Kainan Wang,Bo Wang,Aili Wang*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出PSA，一种面向脉冲神经网络（SNN）剪枝友好、稀疏感知的卷积加速器，联合支持稀疏输入执行、低开销稀疏卷积下变换与剪枝友好执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SNN凭借事件驱动稀疏计算具备能效潜力，神经元剪枝可进一步减少冗余运算；但实际硬件加速器中，脉冲稀疏性与剪枝诱导的稀疏性造成高度不规则的稀疏负载，难以高效执行。现有方案无法同时支持稀疏输入执行、低开销稀疏卷积lowering以及剪枝友好的执行方式。

Method: 1) Sparse-Aware Merge-Accumulation（SAMA）数据流：对齐稀疏脉冲索引，将不规则激活转换为连续计算流以高效执行稀疏卷积；2) Sparse Implicit Group-wise im2col（SIG-im2col）卷积下变换机制：以低映射代价与低内存开销在片上将稀疏卷积转为SpMM；3) 轻量级剪枝友好门控机制，直接支持已剪枝的SNN。

Result: 在ResNet-18/CIFAR-10上，相比稠密基线，能效提升4.45倍，能量-延迟积（EDP）降低18.52倍。

Conclusion: PSA通过数据流、卷积下变换与门控机制的协同设计，有效应对SNN中不规则稀疏负载，显著提升能效与EDP表现，验证了稀疏感知与剪枝友好加速器设计的可行性。

Abstract: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) are promising for energy-efficient artificial intelligence due to their event-driven sparse computation, and neuron pruning can further reduce redundant operations. However, in practical hardware accelerators, spike sparsity and pruning-induced sparsity produce highly irregular sparse workloads that are difficult to execute efficiently. Existing approaches do not jointly support sparse-input execution, low-overhead sparse convolution lowering and pruning-friendly execution. This paper presents PSA, a Pruning-friendly Sparse-aware Accelerator for efficient sparse convolution in SNNs. PSA features a Sparse-Aware Merge-Accumulation (SAMA) dataflow that aligns sparse spike indices and converts irregular activations into continuous computation streams for efficient sparse convolution execution. It further introduces a Sparse Implicit Group-wise im2col (SIG-im2col) convolution lowering mechanism that converts sparse convolution into SpMM on-chip with low mapping cost and memory overhead. In addition, PSA integrates a lightweight pruning-friendly gating mechanism to directly support pruned SNNs. Results on ResNet-18/CIFAR-10 show that PSA achieves a 4.45x improvement in energy efficiency and an 18.52x reduction in energy-delay product (EDP) over the dense baseline.

</details>


### [248] [Minimum RISC-V: Maximum FPGA Efficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21552)
*Martin Langhammer,Bogdan Pasca,Gregg Baeckler*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文设计了一款可在中端FPGA上运行于700 MHz以上、理想情况下每周期退休一条指令的深度流水轻量RISC-V核，并提出将应用二进制与专用处理器实例同时编译的优化方法：把每条指令展开为应用专用编码，综合时移除未用数据通路与译码逻辑，所得核仍与原程序汇编兼容但不再是通用RISC-V二进制兼容。在RV32I/RV32M/RV32F配置上，优化核最小仅170 ALM，在Altera Agilex-5上时序收敛于775 MHz，并可按确定性面积连续步进复用、性能无明显损失，便于多核密度规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FPGA厂商普遍以RISC-V替代专有软CPU，但软处理器系统（含存储）占用面积过大、性能相对器件潜力偏低，需要兼顾面积效率与高频性能的轻量核及面向应用的定制化优化手段。

Method: 先设计深度流水、单发射、可高频运行的轻量RISC-V核；再提出应用二进制与专用处理器实例的协同编译方法，对每条指令做应用专用编码展开，在综合阶段裁剪未使用的数据通路与译码逻辑，保持汇编兼容但放弃通用二进制兼容；在RV32I、RV32M、RV32F三种配置上实现示例设计。

Result: 优化核最小达170 ALM，在Altera Agilex-5器件上以775 MHz闭合时序；核可在确定性面积下封装并连续步进复用，性能无实质影响，支持可预测的多核密度规划；设计可在中端器件上超过700 MHz运行。

Conclusion: 深度流水轻量核与应用专用指令编码协同编译相结合，可显著降低FPGA软处理器面积并维持高主频，同时获得确定性的面积与时序特性，适合可预测的多核系统密度规划。

Abstract: RISC-V processors are now widely available for FPGAs, with most FPGA vendors replacing their proprietary soft-CPU architectures with this instruction-set architecture (ISA). Although contemporary FPGAs are increasingly resource- and feature-rich, a soft processor system---including memory---often occupies a disproportionately large footprint and delivers only modest performance relative to the potential of the target device. In this work we first design a lightweight but deeply pipelined RISC-V core that can run above 700 MHz in a mid-range device and that is capable of retiring one instruction per clock under ideal conditions. We then develop and demonstrate a new optimization method that compiles the final application binary and a specialized processor instance contemporaneously.
