The method expands each instruction into an application-specific encoding, removes unused datapath and decode logic during synthesis, and yields cores that remain assembler-compatible with the original program while no longer being binary-compatible with a general-purpose RISC-V. We implement example designs on RV32I (base integer), RV32M (integer multiply), and RV32F (single-precision floating-point) configurations. Our optimized RISC-V is as small as 170 ALMs and closes timing at 775 MHz in an Altera Agilex-5 device. Finally, we show that these processors can be packed into a deterministic area and stepped-and-repeated continuously without material impact on performance, enabling predictable multi-core density planning.

</details>


### [249] [Independent Data-Integrity Verification for LLM-Driven Functional Coverage Closure in Hardware Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21570)
*Venkata Krishna Kumar Vedantam*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出一个设计无关的覆盖率闭合智能体，将仿真自身导出的覆盖率报告（cocotb-coverage YAML）与独立于模型的记分板数据校验结合进LLM循环；在异步FIFO、UART发送器和AHB2APB桥三个RTL设计上，均在8轮预算内将覆盖率提升至100%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体可生成定向测试以闭合功能覆盖率，但覆盖率仅表明某状态被到达，并不证明沿途数据正确。作者明确指出这是验证领域早已熟知的论点，并非其新贡献，动机在于把该原则真正落地到一个LLM驱动循环中，并防止模型自述的覆盖率"自证"。

Method: 构建一个规模较小的覆盖率闭合智能体：覆盖率仅从仿真自身导出的cocotb-coverage YAML报告读取，绝不采信模型的陈述；数据完整性由与模型分离的记分板检查。智能体设计无关，迭代预算为8次。另在FIFO基础测试平台上挂接响应式记分板监视器。

Result: 三个架构互异的设计覆盖率分别从91.7%、88.9%、67.4%提升至100%，所有已记录运行均在8轮内完成，且使用同一个设计无关智能体。附加的响应式监视器在作者自写的激励代码中发现了一个跨时钟域缺陷。LLM生成测试尚未接入监视器，其数据完整性未被独立验证；仅报告了一次单个FIFO测试的人工检查作为初步结果。

Conclusion: 方法可行但证据薄弱：作者自陈局限包括仅三个设计、无基线对比、无消融实验，且记录运行来自多个智能体检查点；LLM生成测试的数据完整性校验仍是未闭环的开放问题。

Abstract: LLM agents can write directed tests that close functional coverage, but coverage only shows that a state was reached, not that the data on the way there was correct. This is a long-known point in verification and we do not claim it as new. We describe a small coverage-closure agent that applies it to an LLM loop: coverage is read from the report that the simulation itself exports (cocotb-coverage YAML) and never taken from the model's account, and data integrity is checked by scoreboards that are separate from the model. On three architecturally distinct RTL designs (an asynchronous FIFO, a UART transmitter and an AHB2APB bridge) the agent raised coverage from 91.7%, 88.9% and 67.4% to 100% within its 8-iteration budget in every logged run, using one design-agnostic agent. A reactive scoreboard monitor attached to the FIFO's base testbench also found a clock-domain-crossing bug in the author's own stimulus code. The monitor is not yet attached to the LLM-generated tests, so their data integrity is not independently checked; one manual check on a single FIFO test is reported as preliminary. We list the weaknesses of this evidence: three designs, no baseline, no ablation, and logged runs that come from several agent checkpoints.

</details>


### [250] [Compiling Multi-Threshold Operators for Quantized Non-Monotonic and Fine-Granular Activations in Custom-Tailored DNN Accelerators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21825)
*Christoph Berganski,Felix Jentzsch,Marco Platzner*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 论文将多阈值表示形式推广至非单调激活函数与细粒度（多维）阈值，提出基于代数规则的ONNX编译器自动转换方法，并在FINN框架中扩展二分查找多阈值算子完成FPGA端到端综合验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激进量化会使激活函数成为硬件加速的瓶颈；将量化激活实现为多阈值操作虽高效，但现有实现仅支持单调递增函数、逐通道一维粒度及少量预定义激活-量化器组合。

Method: 形式化多阈值表示，扩展至非单调函数与多维细粒度阈值；通过代数规则构建系统化转换流程，并集成到基于ONNX的编译器基础设施；扩展FINN中的二分查找多阈值算子以支持端到端定制FPGA加速器综合。

Result: 在选取的单调与非单调函数上实验验证；刻画支持非单调性与细粒度的硬件开销，并与基于图级分解的既有算子方案、先前工作及hls4ml框架进行对比。

Conclusion: 多阈值表示可有效覆盖非单调、细粒度量化激活；将其用于神经网络训练可作为量化感知训练的一种形式。

Abstract: Aggressive quantization of neural networks can expose activation functions as bottlenecks for efficient hardware acceleration. Implementing quantized activations as multi-threshold operations has been shown to be a promising optimization, allowing for efficient hardware implementation of few-bit activations. However, current implementations are limited to monotonically increasing functions, quantization schemes with one-dimensional (per-channel) granularity and a small set of predefined activation-quantizer combinations. We formalize the multi-threshold representation to extend it to non-monotonic functions and fine-granular parameters, i.e., multi-dimensional thresholds. For automated conversion of quantized function compositions into threshold representation, we propose a systematic approach via algebraic rules integrated into the ONNX-based compiler infrastructure. We experimentally validate our solution on a selection of monotonic and non-monotonic functions by extending the binary search based multi-threshold operator that is integrated into the FINN framework for end-to-end synthesis of custom-tailored FPGA accelerators. The cost of hardware support for non-monotonicity and fine-granularity is characterized in comparison to an alternative approach utilizing existing operators via graph-level decomposition. We compare our method to prior work as well as the approach taken by the hls4ml framework. As an outlook, we demonstrate the prospects of using the multi-threshold representation during the training of a neural network as a form of quantization aware training.

</details>


<div id='physics.app-ph'></div>

# physics.app-ph [[Back]](#toc)

### [251] [Analytically Benchmarked Spatial and Temporal Discretization Guidelines for Finite Element Simulation of Thermal Waves](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20938)
*Kaushal Arun Pareek,Daniel May,Peter Meszmer,Bernhard Wunderle,Mohamad Abo Ras*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 该文提出热波有限元仿真的标准化离散协议：空间网格按热扩散长度缩放，时间步按每周期步数缩放，并用三个基准问题量化离散误差，给出可直接控制相位误差的取参准则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 热波测量系统的设计与结果解释广泛依赖有限元仿真，但仿真精度取决于时空离散分辨率，而当前离散分辨率多凭个案经验选取，缺乏明确准则，导致结果可信度不可控。

Method: 提出离散协议：空间离散尺度以热扩散长度为基准（每扩散长度单元数），时间离散以每周期时间步数为基准；构建三个复杂度递增的基准问题，将空间误差与时间误差分别对照可隔离该误差的参考解进行量化分析。

Result: 空间相位误差随单元尺寸呈二阶收敛，在每扩散长度10个单元时降至0.14度；时间误差仅随每周期步数呈一阶收敛，故时间步可依据目标相位容差ε反推设定。含亚表面缺陷的基准算例展示了违反该协议所导致的后果。

Conclusion: 热波有限元仿真的离散参数应按热扩散长度与每周期步数规范化选取；因时间离散为一阶收敛，应以目标相位容差ε确定时间步，空间则按二阶收敛特性选取单元尺寸，从而避免因离散不足引起的相位偏差。

Abstract: Finite element simulation is widely used to design and interpret thermal wave-based measurement systems. The accuracy of the results obtained from such simulations depends on how finely the model is resolved in space and time. The discretization resolution is often chosen case by case rather than following a well-defined guideline. This work recommends a discretization protocol for finite element simulation of thermal waves where the spatial discretization is scaled to the thermal diffusion length and the temporal discretization to the number of time steps per cycle. The associated discretization errors are quantified using three benchmark problems of increasing complexity. The spatial phase error converges at second order in the element size, reaching 0.14 degrees at ten elements per diffusion length, whereas the temporal error decreases only at first order in the number of time steps per cycle; thus, the time step can be set from a target phase tolerance $ε$. Each error is assessed against a reference that isolates it. The benchmark case with subsurface defects shows the consequence of violating the recommended discretization protocol.

</details>


### [252] [Acoustic Illusion of a Rigid Object for a Moving Emitter via Equivalent Surface Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21649)
*Asaf Kor,Lea Beilkin-Sirota*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 论文提出一种三维声学错觉方法：在不放置真实刚性物体的情况下，用环绕虚拟物体位置的等效面上的控制声源重建其散射场，控制信号由针对运动发射体的时域物理光学公式以闭式给出，并经数值仿真验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标是让一个实际不存在的刚性物体在运动发射体照射下表现出完整的三维散射声学效应（声学错觉），同时避免逐时刻重解散射问题和对传播域做离散化，并解决大尺寸物体无法被等效面完全包围的难题。

Method: 将控制声源布置在虚拟物体位置周围构成的闭合"等效面"上；以物体本应散射到该面上的场驱动声源，通过Kirchhoff–Helmholtz表示使其向外辐射相同场。控制信号由新推导的、适用于运动发射体的时域物理光学公式闭式给出，运动以解析形式通过声传播时延进入公式，无需在每个发射体位置重新求解散射问题，也无需离散传播域；对无法包围的大物体，将信号映射到内部面上。

Result: 数值仿真在两种配置（闭合等效面包围与内部面映射）下均验证了方法的有效性，可重建等效面之外的散射场。

Conclusion: 基于Kirchhoff–Helmholtz表示与时域物理光学的等效面控制源方案，可在运动发射体照射下以闭式、无需空间离散和重复求解的方式实现三维刚性物体的声学错觉；对大物体采用内部面映射是可行替代方案，但其优势与代价需权衡。

Abstract: We report a three-dimensional acoustic illusion of a rigid object illuminated by an emitter moving along an arbitrary trajectory. The object is absent: control sources are arranged around its location, the closed surface they define being termed the equivalent surface. Driven by the field the object would have scattered onto this surface, the sources radiate, by the Kirchhoff--Helmholtz representation, that same field beyond it. The control signals follow in closed form from a time-dependent physical optics formulation that we derive for a moving emitter, in which the motion enters analytically through the acoustic travel times, so that the scattering problem need not be re-solved at each emitter position, nor the propagation domain discretized. For objects too large to enclose, the signals are mapped onto an internal surface, an option whose advantages and penalties are discussed. Numerical simulations validate the method in both configurations.

</details>


### [253] [Plasma-Enabled Wideband Matching of Electrically Small Antennas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22095)
*Kushagra Singhal,Abbas Semnani*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 提出利用电容耦合等离子体（CCP）负介电常数实现电小天线宽带阻抗匹配的方法，在VHF/UHF电小罩式偶极天线上验证，-6 dB分数带宽可超100%，仅需数瓦等离子体功率，且带宽可动态调谐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电小天线（ESA）本身具有大且随频率变化的电抗，传统匹配技术在低频、大功率场景下受根本性限制，难以实现宽带匹配，因此需要一种物理上稳健、可扩展的宽带匹配方案。

Method: 利用电容耦合等离子体的负介电特性，使其等效为宽带负电容，以补偿ESA的大电抗；以VHF/UHF电小罩式偶极天线为概念验证平台，结合理论分析、多物理场仿真与实验测量进行验证。

Result: 理论、多物理场仿真与实测均证实可实现宽带阻抗匹配，-6 dB分数带宽可超过100%，等离子体功率仅需数瓦；通过调节等离子体工作条件、气压与电子密度可动态调谐匹配带宽，并在带宽与辐射效率之间进行权衡控制。

Conclusion: 等离子体赋能匹配范式为宽带电小天线提供了物理稳健、可扩展的解决方案，尤其适用于传统匹配技术受根本限制的低频与高功率应用场景。

Abstract: This paper presents a plasma-based approach for wideband impedance matching of electrically small antennas (ESAs). By exploiting the negative permittivity of a capacitively coupled plasma (CCP), the plasma is shown to function as a wideband negative capacitor that effectively compensates for the large and frequency-dependent reactance inherent to ESAs. A VHF/UHF electrically small capped dipole antenna is used as a proof-of-concept platform to demonstrate the proposed technique. Theoretical analysis, Multiphysics simulations, and experimental measurements confirm broadband impedance matching, with -6 dB fractional bandwidth that can exceed 100\%, using only a few watts of plasma power. The matching bandwidth can be dynamically tuned by adjusting the plasma operating conditions, gas pressure, and electron density, enabling control over the trade-off between bandwidth and radiation efficiency. This plasma-enabled matching paradigm provides a physically robust and scalable solution for wideband ESAs, particularly attractive for low-frequency and high-power applications where conventional matching techniques are fundamentally limited.

</details>


### [254] [The role of friction on heave-induced motion of offshore drilling systems: modelling, analysis, and numerical experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22189)
*Luigi Romano,Ole Morten Aamo*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 该文研究摩擦动力学对升沉诱导扰动传播的影响，建立由常微分方程与双曲偏微分方程半线性互联构成的液压-结构耦合钻井模型，刻画钻柱-井壁相互作用中的空间分布记忆效应。先给出局部与全局解的存在唯一性，经小增益分析导出有界性与输入-状态稳定的充分条件；再进行谐波激励、非线性畸变、空间放大、机理隔离、参数敏感性及真实海况宽带仿真。结果表明液压响应主要受波传播、可压缩性与边界反射支配，结构动力学对分布摩擦更敏感；摩擦对适定性影响有限但对稳定裕度影响显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海洋钻井中升沉运动诱发扰动沿钻柱传播，而钻柱-井壁摩擦具有空间分布与时滞记忆特性；现有分析常割裂液压与结构动态或忽略分布摩擦，因此需量化摩擦动力学对扰动传播、适定性与稳定性的作用，为监测与控制提供依据。

Method: 建立ODE-双曲PDE半线性互联的液压-结构耦合钻井模型，纳入空间分布记忆型摩擦；用适定性分析证明局部与全局存在唯一性，并以小增益（small-gain）分析给出有界性与输入-状态稳定（ISS）的充分条件；数值上开展谐波激励、非线性畸变、空间放大、机理隔离、参数敏感性分析，以及在真实海况下的宽带仿真。

Result: 液压响应主要由波传播现象、可压缩性与边界反射主导；结构动力学对分布摩擦效应显著更敏感。钻柱-井壁摩擦对适定性的影响相对有限，但对稳定裕度可能有显著影响。参数敏感性与机理隔离实验进一步区分了各传播机制的贡献。

Conclusion: 分析与监测控制海洋钻井系统时须同时考虑液压-结构耦合动态与分布摩擦机制；摩擦虽不危及模型适定性，却可能压缩稳定裕度，是稳定性评估中不可忽略的因素。

Abstract: This paper investigates the influence of friction dynamics on heave-induced disturbance propagation using a coupled hydraulic-structural drilling model formulated as a semilinear interconnection of ordinary and hyperbolic partial differential equations (ODE-PDEs), and capturing spatially distributed memory effects in the drillstring-wellbore interaction. First, local and global existence and uniqueness results are established, and sufficient conditions for boundedness and input-to-state stability are deduced via a small-gain analysis. Subsequently, extensive numerical investigations are carried out, including harmonic excitation studies, nonlinear distortion analysis, spatial amplification investigations, mechanism-isolation experiments, parameter sensitivity analysis, and broadband simulations under realistic offshore sea-state excitation. The simulation results indicate that, whilst the hydraulic response is governed primarily by wave propagation phenomena, compressibility, and boundary reflections, the structural dynamics display substantially greater sensitivity to distributed friction effects. Furthermore, drillstring-wellbore friction is shown to have a relatively limited influence on well-posedness but a potentially significant impact on stability margins. These findings highlight the importance of accounting for coupled hydraulic-structural dynamics and distributed friction mechanisms when analysing, monitoring, and controlling offshore drilling systems.

</details>

### [255] [A Mixture-of-Experts Framework for Multi-Stream Quickest Change Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20876)
*Wuxia Chen,Arman Adibi,Taposh Banerjee,Vahid Tarokh*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出混合专家(MoE)框架用于快速变化检测(QCD)，并应用于多流QCD问题，性能优于已有的rank-weighted sum (RWS)方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多流QCD中，基于广义似然比的最优算法计算代价高；现有计算与性能较优的RWS方案仍有提升空间，需要兼顾计算效率与检测性能的更好算法。

Method: 构建MoE框架：多个专家各自产生检测统计量序列，对这些统计量加权求和并与阈值比较来判定变化；将框架应用于多流数据，其中变化点处未知子集流的分布发生改变。

Result: 在实值高斯均值漂移数据以及来自GB-RBM的高维数据仿真中，基于MoE的多流QCD算法性能优于RWS方案。

Conclusion: MoE框架为QCD提供了通用且有效的统计量融合方式，多流场景下可超越文献中最优已知算法（如RWS）。

Abstract: A Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework is proposed for quickest change detection (QCD) where there are multiple experts, and each expert produces a sequence of statistics for change detection. A change is declared when a weighted sum of these statistics crosses a threshold. This framework is then applied to the problem of multi-stream QCD to obtain a family of powerful algorithms that outperform the best known algorithms in the literature. In the multi-stream QCD problem, a decision-maker observes multiple streams of observations. At the change point, the distribution of an unknown subset of the streams changes. The optimal algorithm based on a generalized likelihood ratio is computationally expensive. One of the most computationally and performance-efficient algorithms in the literature is the rank-weighted sum (RWS) scheme based on Shiryaev-Roberts statistics. It is shown in the paper that the MoE-based QCD algorithm for multi-stream data outperforms the RWS scheme. This is demonstrated through simulation results on real-valued Gaussian mean shift data and high-dimensional data from Gaussian--Bernoulli Restricted Boltzmann Machines (GB-RBMs).

</details>


### [256] [Evolution Toward Sensing-Enabled RAN: Practical Bistatic Sensing via Uplink](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20923)
*Kenan Turbic,Khanh-Toan Pham,Slawomir Stanczak*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种基于上行CSI的机会式蜂窝网络感知方法，将5G定位功能与多天线阵列处理结合用于被动目标定位，并通过仿真与SDR实测验证其在局域范围内对移动目标的检测、定位与跟踪可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在蜂窝网络中引入感知能力通常需要较大基础设施改造，本文寻求一种对现有基础设施改动最小的机会式感知途径。

Method: 以uplink CSI作为感知信息来源，设计实用的感知信号处理流程，融合5G定位功能与多天线阵列处理实现被动目标定位；搭建基于软件定义无线电（SDR）的实验平台，采用开源软件框架与商用硬件组件进行仿真与实测验证。

Result: 仿真与实测结果表明，上行CSI感知可在局域范围内实现移动目标的检测、定位与跟踪，验证了该方案的可行性。

Conclusion: 上行CSI感知可作为低改造成本的机会式感知方案用于蜂窝网络，具备实用可行性；但当前验证局限于局域场景，覆盖范围与鲁棒性有待进一步评估。

Abstract: This paper considers uplink channel state information (CSI)-based sensing as an opportunistic approach to enabling sensing in cellular networks, with minimum required modifications to the infrastructure. A practical sensing signal processing procedure is presented, combining 5G positioning function with multi-antenna array processing for passive target localization. The approach is validated through simulation and practical experiments with a software-defined radio-based setup, utilizing open-source software frameworks and commercially available hardware components. Results demonstrate feasibility of the uplink CSI-based sensing for detection, localization and tracking of moving targets over local areas.

</details>


### [257] [Resilient and Efficient Aerial Wireless Sensor Networks Using Pinching-Antenna Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20924)
*Ahmed A. Al-habob,Octavia A. Dobre,Yindi Jing,Hyundong Shin*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出pinching天线系统，通过优化波导上pinching天线单元位置最大化网络图的代数连通度，并在维持最小连通性指标下最小化无人机数量，设计启发式天线放置算法与迭代式UAV部署算法，仿真验证连通性与效率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空中无线网络中连通性与效率不足，需要一种新的天线系统与部署优化手段，在保证网络连通的前提下降低无人机部署开销。

Method: 以网络图的代数连通度为优化目标，优化上/下行波导中pinching天线单元的位置；设计启发式pinching天线放置算法以最大化连通性，并设计迭代式UAV部署算法联合确定最少UAV数量、其部署位置及pinching天线位置。

Result: 仿真结果表明，所考虑的pinching天线系统提升了网络连通性与效率，并能在满足最小连通性指标下减少UAV数量。

Conclusion: pinching天线系统结合天线放置与UAV部署联合优化，可有效增强空中无线网络的连通性与效率。

Abstract: This paper proposes a pinching antenna system to enhance the connectivity and efficiency in aerial wireless networks. The algebraic connectivity of the network's graph is maximized by optimizing the placement of the pinching antenna elements in the uplink and downlink waveguides. The number of deployed unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is minimized while maintaining a minimum network connectivity indicator. A heuristic pinching antenna placement algorithm is designed to maximize the network connectivity. An iterative UAV deployment algorithm is also designed to find the minimum number of UAVs, their placement locations, and the pinching antenna placement. Simulation results show that the considered pinching antenna system improves network connectivity and efficiency.

</details>


### [258] [Range Ambiguity Identification and Elimination by Leveraging Temporal Broadening Effect for THz Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20928)
*Saira Rafique,Ahmed Naeem,Chong Han,Huseyin Arslan*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出接收端利用太赫兹脉冲时间展宽效应作为距离相关特征，通过展宽匹配滤波与多脉冲多普勒补偿联合判决解距离模糊。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高PRF提升多普勒无模糊性能，但使THz脉冲雷达最大无模糊距离缩短，超距目标回波会错配到后续脉冲而出现距离折叠（假短距）。

Method: 对每个检测回波，用对应候选目标距离的展宽参考做展宽匹配滤波；跨脉冲做多普勒补偿后合并滤波输出，以最大归一化合并响应判定模糊阶数并恢复真实距离；再复用所选参考以降低后续距离/速度估计的失配损失。

Result: 已知大气条件、目标位于不同视在时延单元的仿真中，可在常规无模糊区间之外可靠恢复距离；在模糊阶数正确识别的条件下，距离估计误差与速度估计误差接近各自推导的Cramér–Rao界。

Conclusion: 方法保持发射脉冲形状、PRF与采样率不变即可解模糊；代价是相比所评估的基于分集的技术，模糊识别需要更高的信号-杂波-噪声比。

Abstract: High pulse repetition frequency (PRF) operation improves Doppler unambiguous sensing but reduces the maximum unambiguous range of a terahertz (THz) pulsed radar. Echoes from targets beyond this range can be incorrectly associated with subsequent transmitted pulses, causing the targets to appear at shorter ranges. This paper proposes a receiver-side framework that exploits the THz-specific temporal broadening effect as a distance-dependent signature to resolve range ambiguity. For each detected echo, the receiver applies broadening-matched filtering with references corresponding to candidate target ranges. The filter outputs are combined across pulses with Doppler compensation, and the largest normalised combined response identifies the ambiguity order needed to recover the true target range. The selected reference is then reused to reduce mismatch loss in subsequent range and velocity estimation. Simulations under known atmospheric conditions, with targets occupying distinct apparent-delay bins, demonstrate reliable range recovery beyond the conventional unambiguous interval. Range estimation errors conditioned on correct ambiguity-order identification, together with the reported velocity estimation errors, approach their corresponding derived Cramér--Rao bounds. The method preserves a fixed transmitted pulse shape, PRF, and sampling rate, at the expense of a higher signal-to-clutter-plus-noise ratio requirement for ambiguity identification relative to the evaluated diversity-based techniques.

</details>


### [259] [How large an effect would we have seen? Positive controls, detection floors and dataset pitfalls in scalp-EEG speech decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20942)
*Blessing Isoyiza Adeika,Onyema Osuagwu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该论文审计了三个公开EEG语料库中"想象言语解码"的有效性：显性言语正控制在很大程度上由肌电信号驱动，无法验证解码流程；作者通过注入已知幅度的效应量化检测下限，并发现ds003626标签存在编码反转与时间确定性等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有头皮EEG想象言语解码研究通常仅以显性言语作为正控制来验证流程，且在报告零结果时未说明流程本可检测到的效应量大小，导致正控制的有效性与结果的可解释性存疑。

Method: 使用ds003626、KaraOne及2020国际BCI竞赛Track 3三个数据集，在通过断言强制保证划分完整性的协议下，审计显性言语、发音器准备与想象言语解码，考察伪迹通道子集、限频解码与试次选择的影响；向真实记录中注入已知幅度的类别相关效应以测量五类解码器的检测下限；并对照采集协议核验ds003626标签。

Result: ds003626上两个唇部电极解码显性言语准确率0.7430、八个外部通道0.7068，而128通道头皮蒙太奇仅0.4231，且8–30 Hz频带内无可解码信号；另两个语料库中受试者内准确率随频率单调升高至肌电主导频段。带功率逻辑回归在预先设定的准则下可检出0.54 µV的注入性8–30 Hz去同步，而EEGNet在受试者内直到4.31 µV仍无检出。ds003626中条件编码与直觉读法相反、公开版本间类别编码发生变化，且条件在每个会话内是时间的确定性函数。

Conclusion: 在这些语料库中，显性言语正控制由肌源信号主导，不能用于验证解码流程；建议言语解码研究报告限频与伪迹通道准确率、准确率随频率变化的方向，以及实测的检测下限。

Abstract: Objective. Studies that decode imagined speech from scalp electroencephalography (EEG) commonly validate their pipelines with a positive control, usually overt speech, and report null results without stating what effect size the pipeline could have detected. Approach. Using ds003626 ("Thinking out loud"), KaraOne and Track 3 of the 2020 International Brain-Computer Interface Competition, we audited decoding of overt speech, articulator preparation and imagined speech with artifact-channel subsets, band-limited decoding and trial selection, under a protocol that enforces split integrity by assertion. We injected class-dependent effects of known amplitude into the real recordings to measure the detection floor of five decoder families, and we checked the ds003626 labels against the dataset's acquisition protocol. Main results. On ds003626, two lip electrodes decoded overt speech at 0.7430 and the eight external channels at 0.7068, against 0.4231 for the 128-channel scalp montage, and no decodable signal survived in the 8-30 Hz band. On the other two corpora, within-subject accuracy rose monotonically with frequency into the range dominated by muscle activity. Band-power logistic regression detected an injected 8-30 Hz desynchronization of 0.54 uV under a criterion fixed in advance, whereas a compact convolutional network (EEGNet) detected nothing within subject up to 4.31 uV. In ds003626, the condition codes are the reverse of the intuitive reading, the class encoding changed between public releases, and condition is a deterministic function of time within each session. Significance. In these corpora the overt-speech positive control is dominated by myogenic signal and cannot validate a decoding pipeline. We recommend that speech-decoding studies report band-limited and artifact-channel accuracy, the direction of accuracy across frequency, and a measured detection floor.

</details>


### [260] [Cross-subject decoding of imagined speech from scalp EEG: a leakage-controlled evaluation on three public corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20954)
*Blessing Isoyiza Adeika,Onyema Osuagwu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该研究检验了头皮EEG想象言语内容能否跨被试迁移，发现三套公开语料中均无跨被试可解码的想象言语表征（平均迁移准确率距随机水平<0.006），且被试内准确率低主要受每类试次数限制，而非模型能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无标定的非侵入式想象言语解码器能使语音BCI实用化，需先确认想象言语信息是否以可跨人共享的形式存在于头皮EEG中，并诊断被试内准确率长期偏低的原因。

Method: 分析ds003626、KaraOne及2020国际BCI竞赛Track 3三个公开语料；采用严格划分完整性断言、精确二项阈值、组检验与bootstrap置信区间；逐被试训练并跨全部他人测试（482个有序被试对），进行多重比较校正；无分类器的表征几何比较；被试级对齐；并检验被试内性能上限的五种解释（含伪迹与时间进程对照审计）。

Result: 482对被试对经多重比较校正后无一显著，各语料平均对间迁移准确率与随机水平相差在0.006以内，而被试内参照均高于随机。想象vs刺激前静息在伪迹与时程控制后约0.61，但解码器将想象前区间同样标为想象，说明该对比反映刺激后状态而非想象本身。被试内仅竞赛语料全员超阈（0.3147，随机0.200）；音节数解释力有限，其频率特征未通过伪迹审计。

Conclusion: 在所考察的表征下，想象言语内容无法在这些语料中跨人迁移；唯一与被试内表现排序一致的变量是每类试次数，故应优先构建更大的单条件数据集，而非继续模型开发。

Abstract: Objective. A decoder of imagined speech that works for a new user without calibration would make a non-invasive speech interface practical. We tested whether imagined-speech content recorded with scalp electroencephalography (EEG) transfers across people, and examined why accuracy within a single person remains low. Approach. We analyzed three public corpora, ds003626, KaraOne and Track 3 of the 2020 International Brain-Computer Interface Competition, under a protocol that enforces split integrity by assertion and reports exact binomial thresholds, group tests and bootstrap confidence intervals. We trained decoders on each participant and tested them on every other, compared representational geometry across participants without a classifier, applied subject-level alignment, and tested five explanations for the within-subject ceiling. Main results. Across 482 ordered pairs of participants, no pair survived correction for multiple comparisons; mean pair-transfer accuracy lay within 0.006 of chance on every corpus, while every within-subject reference lay above it. Imagery against pre-stimulus rest generalized at about 0.61 after artifact and elapsed-time controls, but its decoder labelled the interval preceding imagery as imagery as often as imagery itself, so the contrast reflects a post-stimulus state, not imagery. Within subject, only the competition corpus decoded above threshold for every participant (0.3147; chance 0.200); syllable count explained little of this, but its frequency profile failed an artifact audit. Significance. In these corpora, imagined-speech content did not transfer between people through any representation we examined. Trial count per class was the only variable that ordered the corpora, which favors larger single-condition datasets over further model development.

</details>


### [261] [Antenna Placement for Movable Antenna-Enabled Near-Field Target Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21191)
*Jinjian Liu,Xianxin Song,Xianghao Yu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文研究可移动天线（MA）赋能的近场目标定位问题，以平方定位误差界（SPEB）为性能指标，通过优化接收端天线位置最小化SPEB；先松弛最小间距约束，转化为关于四阶截断矩的分布问题并用SDP求解，再借助截断矩理论重构有限支撑的最优分布，得到三簇结构的簇化部署策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MA可提供额外空间自由度以提升无线感知性能；在基于设备的感知架构（目标主动发射、接收机估计其位置）下，近场定位性能高度依赖天线几何布局，因此需要针对SPEB优化天线位置。难点在于最小天线间距约束与SPEB对天线位置的复杂依赖使原问题高度非凸且难以处理。

Method: 以SPEB为度量，建立关于接收端天线位置的优化问题；先松弛天线最小间距约束，将问题重构为以四阶截断矩为变量的天线位置分布问题，该矩形式问题具有等价半正定规划（SDP）形式，可由标准凸优化求解器获得最优解；随后利用截断矩理论恢复支撑于有限个位置的最优分布，并据此构造高效的簇化部署策略。

Result: 数值结果表明，所构造的最优分布呈现三簇结构，且各簇权重依赖于信源（目标）参数；所提天线部署方法优于传统阵列几何，并接近穷举搜索基准方案的性能。

Conclusion: 通过截断矩松弛与SDP求解可有效克服非凸性与间距约束带来的困难，所得三簇结构部署策略为MA近场定位提供了一种高效且近最优的天线布局设计。

Abstract: Movable antennas (MAs) have recently emerged as a promising technology to enhance the wireless sensing performance by exploiting additional spatial degrees of freedom. In this work, we consider an MA-enabled near-field target localization problem under a device-based sensing architecture, where the sensing target actively transmits signals and the sensing receiver estimates its location based on the received signals. We adopt the squared position error bound (SPEB) as the sensing performance metric and aim to minimize the target's SPEB by optimizing the antenna placement at the sensing receiver. The resulting optimization problem is highly non-convex due to the minimum antenna spacing constraints and the intricate dependence of the SPEB on the antenna locations and the intractable form of SPEB. To tackle this problem, we first relax the inter-spacing constraints and accordingly formulate an antenna position distribution problem in terms of degree-4 truncated moments. The reformulated moment-based problem admits an equivalent semidefinite programming formulation and can be optimally solved using standard convex optimization solvers. Using truncated moment theory, we then recover an optimal antenna position distribution supported on a finite number of locations and construct an efficient clustered placement policy. Numerical results demonstrate that the constructed optimal distribution exhibits a three-cluster structure with source-dependent weights. The proposed antenna placement method outperforms conventional array geometries and closely approaches the exhaustive-search benchmark scheme.

</details>


### [262] [Micro-Doppler Sensing for UAV Flight-State Estimation in ISAC Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21225)
*Henglin Pu,Lu Su,Zhu Han,Athina P. Petropulu,Husheng Li*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出OFDM-ISAC框架，利用无人机微多普勒特征估计旋翼转速与旋翼轴朝向，并扩展到多站分布式网络融合估计公共旋翼轴方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有低空无人机ISAC监测多只关注位置与整体速度，缺乏对旋翼动力学与朝向的信息，需提供更丰富的无人机状态感知能力。

Method: 基于OFDM-ISAC，单站提取微多普勒特征估计旋翼转速；扩展至分布式多站网络，融合多视角依赖的微多普勒特征（基于多普勒带宽特征而非信道相位，无需站间载波相位同步）估计公共旋翼轴方向；证明三个几何分布多样的视角可局部辨识旋翼轴方向与未知旋翼叶尖速度尺度；建立特征感知雷达方程关联叶片RCS、感知距离、发射功率、观测时长与检测及转速估计精度；分析残余运动与距离徙动对CPI的影响。

Result: 仿真与实测验证了框架有效性，展示了旋翼转速估计与多站旋翼轴感知的可行性。

Conclusion: 所提OFDM-ISAC框架可超越传统定位与测速，实现旋翼转速与旋翼轴朝向估计，且多站融合无需载波相位同步，具备实际可部署性。

Abstract: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) provides a promising foundation for low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) monitoring. However, most existing studies focus primarily on position and bulk velocity, thus providing limited information about UAV rotor dynamics and orientation. To address this limitation, this paper develops an orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM)-ISAC framework that exploits UAV micro-Doppler signatures to estimate operational states, including rotor rate and rotor-axis orientation, thereby providing richer UAV state information beyond conventional ISAC localization and velocity sensing. The framework progresses from single-station micro-Doppler sensing to multi-station rotor-axis estimation. At each base station, micro-Doppler signatures are first extracted and used to estimate the rotor rate. The framework is then extended to a distributed ISAC network, where view-dependent micro-Doppler signatures from multiple sensing directions are fused to estimate the common rotor-axis direction. Since the fusion relies on Doppler-bandwidth features rather than complex channel phases, inter-station carrier-phase synchronization is not required. We show that three geometrically diverse views can locally identify both the rotor-axis direction and the unknown rotor-tip-speed scale. In addition, a feature-aware radar equation bridges blade radar cross section (RCS), sensing range, transmit power, and observation duration to micro-Doppler detection and rotor-rate estimation accuracy. The effects of residual motion and range migration on the coherent processing interval (CPI) are also analyzed. Simulations and experimental measurements validate the proposed framework and demonstrate the feasibility of rotor-rate estimation and multi-station rotor-axis sensing.

</details>


### [263] [Finite-History Outage Certification for Partially Observed Fluid Antenna Receivers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21252)
*Yuanjun Shen*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 针对流体天线接收端"冻结的部分观测选位规则"，在有限历史数据导致协方差不确定的情形下，提出部署前可靠性认证方法；在高斯结构化示例中282个风险组全部通过认证，最大风险上界约0.0009997。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流体天线接收机可基于部分端口观测选择服务位置，但历史数据有限，用于决策的协方差存在不确定性，缺乏对固定选位规则在部署后可靠性的严格保证。

Method: 以proper predictive density构造基于历史的参数置信区域；用高斯协方差包络、共享条件概率界与选择器包络，对连续参数与不连续端口决策给出同时风险界；分离历史覆盖预算与积分预算，使单次资格认证的误正认证概率限制在0.05；利用置信集包含关系，使新的独立历史可在规则不变时复用风险计算。

Result: 32个候选位置、5次含噪探测、目标中断率0.001的结构化高斯示例中，282个风险组全部合格，最大上界0.000999748；耦合比较给出当前规则中断区间[7.6820,9.1266]×10^-4，在相同历史拟合下判定其低于两个观测端口对照；一条独立重校准历史无需额外风险采样即可复用证书；未决对照与不利成员对照界定了复用边界。

Conclusion: 所提框架能在平稳模型与数值假设下为冻结的部分观测选位规则提供部署前、有限样本可认证的风险保证，并支持历史数据的有限复用，但复用有效性受未决与不利成员情形约束。

Abstract: Fluid antenna receivers can select a service position from partial port observations, but finite historical data leave uncertainty in the covariance used for that decision. We develop deployment-before-use reliability certification for a frozen partial-observation rule. A proper predictive density defines a history-based parameter region. Gaussian covariance envelopes, shared conditional-probability bounds and selector enclosures provide simultaneous risk bounds over continuous parameters and discontinuous port decisions. Separate history-coverage and integration budgets limit erroneous positive certification to 0.05 for a single qualification procedure under the stated stationary model and numerical assumptions. Confidence-set inclusion allows a new independent history to reuse the risk computation with the rule unchanged. In a structured Gaussian example with 32 candidate positions, five noisy probes and target outage 0.001, all 282 risk groups are qualified; the largest upper bound is 0.000999748. A separate coupled comparison gives a current-rule outage interval of $[7.6820,9.1266]\times10^{-4}$ and resolves lower outage than two observed-port controls using the same historical fit. One independently recalibrated history reuses the certificate without additional risk sampling. Unresolved and adverse-member controls delimit this reuse.

</details>


### [264] [Receiver-Specific Interventional Valuation of Semantic Atoms for Budget-Constrained Multi-Agent Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21504)
*Danial Dehghani,Maximilian Lübke,Friedemann Laue,Zahra Seifaei,Norman Franchi*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种与编码器无关的发送端框架，将语义内容分解为可独立选择的"语义原子"，为每个接收机估计各原子的有符号价值（提升或降低其下游决策），并在有限链路预算下进行接收机特定的语义选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协作多智能体语义通信中，发送端不仅要决定如何编码观测，还要在有限链路预算下决定向每个接收机传递哪些语义内容；现有方法缺乏对"内容对特定接收机是否有益"的细粒度、接收机特定量化手段。

Method: 以语义原子为单位建立受控投递效用（controlled-delivery utility），在接收机行动前通过前瞻性随机负载投递识别该效用；用仅依赖发送端可得信息的"影子接收机"估计效用，并据此计算接收机特定的留一法（LOO）原子价值与 Shapley 原子价值。

Result: 在四接收机交叉口基准上，非可忽略 LOO 原子效应符号恢复准确率 68.4%，估计与参考 LOO 值的 Spearman 相关为 0.302；有限预算下接收机特定选择稳定优于共享选择与随机选择；在预算充足时，穷举子集选择也优于全量传输。

Conclusion: 尽管原子价值估计并不完美，接收机特定的语义价值评估仍能支撑有效的预算受限通信，且"传输全部内容"并不等价于最大化接收机效用。

Abstract: Cooperative multi-agent semantic communication requires deciding not only how a transmitter encodes its observation, but also which resulting semantic content should be delivered to each receiver under a limited link budget. We introduce an encoder-agnostic transmitter-side framework for receiver-specific valuation of independently selectable semantic units, termed semantic atoms. Each atom is assigned a signed value that quantifies whether delivering it is expected to improve or degrade the intended receiver's downstream decision. We formulate this effect through a controlled-delivery utility and identify it via prospective randomized payload delivery before the receiver acts. A shadow receiver estimates this utility using only transmitter-available information, from which receiver-specific leave-one-out (LOO) and Shapley atom values are computed. Experiments on a four-receiver intersection benchmark show 68.4% accuracy in recovering the sign of non-negligible LOO atom effects and a Spearman correlation of 0.302 between estimated and reference LOO values. Under limited budgets, we show that receiver-specific selection consistently outperforms shared and random alternatives, demonstrating the benefit of adapting semantic ranking to the intended receiver. At full affordability, exhaustive subset selection also outperforms full-payload transmission, showing that transmitting all available content need not maximize receiver utility. Overall, our results show that receiver-specific semantic valuation can support effective budget-constrained communication despite imperfect atom-value estimation.

</details>


### [265] [Wavefront Engineering for Physical Layer Security in Near-Field Wireless Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21521)
*Sotiris Droulias,Angeliki Alexiou*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文研究在辐射近场条件下，利用不同波束类型（聚焦、弯曲、突自聚焦、余弦波束）及垂直聚焦与中空聚焦波束提升物理层安全（PLS）性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无线传输易被非预期接收者截获，虽波束成形可借助空间特性抑制窃听者，但进入大孔径阵列辐射近场后，波前曲率带来了新的空间波前工程机会，值得用于增强PLS。

Method: 采用均匀线阵/面阵（ULA/UPA）生成聚焦、弯曲、突自聚焦和余弦波束；引入基于功率的指标衡量合法用户与潜在窃听者接收功率；对所有波束在UPA垂直方向施加聚焦，以独立控制两个维度的相位分布；并提出在发射孔径中设置非激活条带的中空聚焦波束，在发射机与合法接收者之间形成受保护低功率区。

Result: 垂直聚焦显著提升PLS性能；中空聚焦波束在视距（LoS）与用户邻近（VoU）场景中均取得更优的PLS性能。

Conclusion: 辐射近场波前曲率为空间波前工程提供新途径，垂直聚焦与中空聚焦波束是增强物理层安全的有效手段。

Abstract: With wireless transmission exposing information to potential interception by unintended receivers, physical layer security (PLS) offers a promising approach to securing wireless communications. Beamforming can mitigate this vulnerability by exploiting the spatial characteristics of wireless propagation to concentrate power toward the intended receiver while suppressing it at potential eavesdroppers. However, as wireless systems enter the radiating near field of large-aperture antenna arrays, the resulting wavefront curvature provides additional opportunities for spatial wavefront engineering to enhance PLS. In this work, we investigate the use of different beam types for PLS, including focused, curved, abruptly autofocusing, and cosine beams, generated using uniform linear and planar arrays (ULAs/UPAs). To quantify their performance, we introduce power-based metrics that characterize the power received by the legitimate user and a potential eavesdropper. For all beam types we introduce focusing along the vertical UPA direction, to independently control the phase distributions along the two UPA dimensions and enhance the power discrimination between the legitimate receiver and the eavesdropper. We also propose hollow-focused beams, in which an inactive strip is introduced in the transmitting aperture to create a protected low-power region between the transmitter and the legitimate receiver. The results demonstrate that vertical focusing dramatically enhances the PLS performance and that hollow-focused beams achieve superior PLS performance in both line-of-sight (LoS) and vicinity-of-user (VoU) scenarios.

</details>


### [266] [From Interference to Diversity: Mode Coloring and Two-Dimensional Modal-Time Rake Combining for Multipath OAM Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21602)
*Runyu Lyu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文将OAM多径散射造成的模态间干扰(IMI)视为可收集的结构化能量资源，提出模态-时间二维Rake接收机，在28 GHz下显著降低BER并节省10–15 dB SNR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OAM波束为无线通信提供空间复用维度，但多径散射会展宽模态谱、导致能量跨模态泄漏（IMI），传统OAM解复用直接丢弃这部分泄漏能量，造成性能损失。作者希望把泄漏的模态能量从"干扰"重新理解为可结构化解码与收集的资源。

Method: 为每个激活OAM模态分配不同的时域正交扩频码；接收端构建跨越OAM模态与可分辨多径时延的二维接收网格，联合合并解扩输出（二维模态-时间Rake）。理论分析基于倾斜OAM波束的Bessel阶差耦合规律，归纳为高斯模态扩散模型及量化残余正交性的模态相干度量；并引入有效分集度量，将有限SNR下的合并增益与渐近分集阶数分离。

Result: 在独立支路衰落下达LK阶渐近分集，在实际信道的秩受限逐抽头衰落下获得收集能量。28 GHz、四模态八阵元UCA、四个可分辨多径抽头的仿真中，相比逐模态检测及模态域ZF/MMSE检测，BER降低1–3个数量级、所需SNR节省约10–15 dB，且优于未着色的模态-时间MMSE均衡器；该优势在考虑扩频的频谱效率代价及信道估计与时序不完美时依然保持。

Conclusion: 将IMI泄漏能量重新解释为可收集资源并结合时域正交着色与二维联合合并，是提升OAM多径传输鲁棒性的有效途径，且增益对扩频开销和实际损伤具有稳健性。

Abstract: Orbital angular momentum (OAM) beams provide a spatial-multiplexing dimension for wireless communications, but multipath scattering broadens their mode spectrum, so that energy leaks across modes as inter-mode interference (IMI), which conventional OAM demultiplexing discards. This paper treats the leaked modal energy not as interference but as a structured, harvestable resource: it attains up to $LK$-fold asymptotic diversity under independent-branch fading and yields harvested energy under the rank-limited per-tap fading of the operating channel. Each active OAM mode is colored with a distinct time-domain orthogonal spreading code, and a two-dimensional (2D) receiver grid spanning the OAM modes and the resolvable multipath delays jointly combines the despread outputs. The design builds on the Bessel order-difference coupling law of tilted OAM beams, summarized by a Gaussian mode-diffusion model with a mode-coherence metric that quantifies the surviving orthogonality, and on an effective diversity metric that separates the combining gain available at finite signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) from the asymptotic diversity order. At 28~GHz, with a four-mode eight-element uniform circular array (UCA) and four resolvable multipath taps, the proposed 2D modal-time Rake lowers the bit-error rate (BER) by one to three orders of magnitude and saves roughly 10--15~dB of required SNR over mode-wise detection and mode-domain zero-forcing (ZF) and minimum mean-square error (MMSE) detection, and it also outperforms an uncolored modal-time MMSE equalizer; the advantage survives the spectral-efficiency cost of spreading as well as channel-estimation and timing imperfections.

</details>


### [267] [Dual-Purpose SSB Design for Joint Time-Frequency Synchronization Using Relocated DMRS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21617)
*Sadiq Iqbal,Abdelali Arous,Huseyin Arslan*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出双用途SSB（DP-SSB）：在不中断传统UE操作的前提下，利用现有SSB实现窄带低复杂度IoT设备的同步。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SSB无法被窄带、低复杂度、低功耗IoT设备用于同步，本文旨在让IoT设备复用现有SSB完成同步，同时保证传统UE的PSS/SSS同步与PBCH接收不受影响。

Method: 将选定的DMRS符号连续映射到DP-SSB第2、4符号中的部分PRB；用接收机感知的最小二乘（LS）方法优化这些DMRS符号，使IoT前端输出呈现特定的时域结构。IoT接收端经窄带滤波与抽取获得降采样观测，用于能量检测和顺序时频（TF）同步；UE端保留PSS/SSS同步，并评估DMRS重定位对信道估计与PBCH接收的影响。

Result: 以检测概率、TF同步精度、IoT接收机计算复杂度及UE侧PBCH解码性能为指标进行评估；仿真验证了检测特性的解析刻画，且与基准同步方案相比实现了可靠的低功耗IoT同步，同时保持传统UE正常运行。

Conclusion: DP-SSB可在复用现有SSB资源的情况下，同时满足低复杂度IoT设备的同步需求与传统UE的兼容性要求。

Abstract: The synchronization signal block (SSB) is designed to synchronize a capable user-equipment (UE) with the base-station (BS) in recent cellular networks. However, the same SSB cannot be utilized by a narrowband, low-complexity, and low-power internet of things (IoT) device for synchronization. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a dual-purpose SSB (DP-SSB) to enable low-complexity IoT synchronization using the existing SSB, while ensuring uninterrupted conventional UE operation. Specifically, selected demodulation reference signal (DMRS) symbols are contiguously mapped to some physical resource blocks (PRBs) in the second and fourth symbols of the DP-SSB. These DMRS symbols are further optimized using a receiver-aware least square (LS) approach to impose a distinct time-domain structure at the output of the IoT front-end. At the IoT receiver, a reduced-rate observation of the DP-SSB is obtained after narrowband filtering and decimation that is exploited for energy detection and sequential time-frequency (TF) synchronization. For the UE, primary synchronization signal (PSS) and secondary synchronization signal (SSS)-based synchronization is preserved, while the effect of relocated DMRS on the channel estimation and physical broadcast channel (PBCH) reception is assessed. The performance of the proposed DP-SSB is evaluated in terms of detection probability, TF synchronization accuracy, IoT receiver computational complexity, and UE-side PBCH decoding. Simulation results validate the analytical detection characterization and demonstrate reliable low-power IoT synchronization performance compared with the benchmark synchronization schemes while maintaining conventional UE operation.

</details>


### [268] [High-Order Sinusoidal Modeling for Precise Parameter Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21643)
*Shaowen Chen,Tomoki Toda*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文指出准谐波建模（QHM/aQHM/eaQHM）本质为线性模型，其频率细化能力受模型阶数限制；为此提出高阶建模框架并用Levenberg–Marquardt算法估计参数，显著提升幅度、频率、相位的估计精度与信号建模准确度，仿真与语音实验验证了其在频率细化、参数提取及加性噪声下的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已知频率时正弦幅度估计是线性且可解的问题，但现有方法的频率失配限制了信号建模精度。QHM 及其扩展具备频率细化与幅度提取能力，但其提取与校正能力仍受限，需要从频率失配角度重新审视其性能瓶颈。

Method: 首先从频率失配视角重新审视 QHM 方法，揭示其性能本质上受模型阶数约束：QHM 为线性模型，无法刻画高阶频率变化。随后提出高阶建模框架以更精确逼近信号分量，对优化问题进行定性刻画，并采用 Levenberg–Marquardt（LM）算法进行参数估计。

Result: 所提方法显著改善了正弦分量的幅度、频率与相位估计，实现更精确的信号建模；仿真与语音信号实验表明高阶模型在频率细化与参数提取上具有优势，且在加性噪声条件下具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 模型阶数而非估计策略是准谐波类方法精度受限的根源；引入高阶建模并结合 LM 优化可有效突破线性模型局限，获得更优的参数估计与频率细化性能。

Abstract: Although the amplitude estimation of sinusoids is a linear and tractable problem when their frequencies are known, the accuracy of signal modeling is fundamentally limited by the inevitable frequency mismatches produced by existing methods. Quasi-harmonic modeling (QHM) and its extensions (aQHM and eaQHM) offer the ability to refine frequency estimates while extracting amplitudes; however, their extraction and correction capabilities remain limited. In this paper, we first revisit QHM methods from the perspective of frequency mismatches, and reveal that their performances are essentially constrained by the order of the model. Specifically, QHM methods are linear models and thus incapable of capturing higher-order frequency variations, leading to suboptimal modeling accuracy. Second, to address this limitation, we propose a higher-order modeling framework that enables more precise approximation of signal components. Eventually, we qualitatively characterize the optimization problem and employ the Levenberg--Marquardt (LM) algorithm for parameter estimation. As a result, the proposed method allows for significantly improved estimation of amplitudes, frequencies, and phases of sinusoidal components, enabling more accurate signal modeling. Experiments on both simulation study and speech signals demonstrate the superiority of the high-order model in frequency refinement and parameter extraction and its robustness under additive noise conditions.

</details>


### [269] [A hidden Markov model for unsupervised EEG-based tracking of auditory attention to a single voice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21691)
*Tianyi Li,Simon Geirnaert,Davina Van den Broek,Elien Bellon,Bert De Smedt,Alexander Bertrand*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出一种全无监督的绝对听觉注意解码（aAAD）框架，将神经包络追踪（NET）与基于隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）的时间推断相结合，无需注意状态标签即可从EEG估计连续注意轨迹，在30名被试上平均AUC由0.547提升至0.832（1 s窗），5 s窗最优达0.858。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 绝对听觉注意解码（aAAD）需在无竞争语音参考的条件下追踪听者对单一语音源的注意强度，缺少对比参照使可靠追踪十分困难；同时现有方法通常依赖有标签的监督训练，缺乏无标签场景下的可用方案。

Method: 构建全无监督pipeline：以EEG信号与目标语音包络为输入，采用神经包络追踪（NET）生成观测特征，再用HMM进行概率化时间推断，从而在无显式注意状态标签下估计连续注意轨迹；实验使用30名成人的EEG数据，考察分析窗长的影响，并将HMM后处理与滑动平均（MA）平滑及alpha功率、谱熵等替代EEG特征进行对比。

Result: 1 s分析窗下，非因果HMM后处理使全部30名被试的AUC均提升，平均AUC由原始NET的0.547升至0.832；5 s窗取得最高平均AUC 0.858。在所考察的各平滑尺度上，HMM的AUC均高于非因果MA平滑；两者个体切换检测时间相近，而HMM在群体水平上检测时间总体更短。作为无监督HMM的观测特征，NET优于alpha功率与谱熵。

Conclusion: 该框架为估计听觉注意的时间波动提供了无标签方法，表明概率化时间推断在单说话人聆听场景下对连续注意追踪具有实用价值。

Abstract: Objective: Absolute auditory attention decoding (aAAD) aims to track how strongly a listener attends to a single speech source using electroencephalography (EEG). Unlike selective auditory attention decoding, aAAD lacks a competing speech reference, making reliable attention tracking challenging.
  Approach: We propose a fully unsupervised aAAD pipeline combining neural envelope tracking (NET) with hidden Markov model (HMM)-based temporal inference. Using EEG signals and the target speech envelope, the framework estimates a continuous attention trajectory without explicit attention-state labels. We evaluate the approach using EEG recordings from 30 adults, investigate the impact of analysis window length, and compare HMM post-processing with moving-average (MA) smoothing and alternative EEG features.
  Main results: With 1-s analysis windows, non-causal HMM post-processing improves the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) for all 30 participants, increasing mean AUC from 0.547 for raw NET to 0.832. A 5-s window achieves the highest mean AUC of 0.858. Compared with non-causal MA smoothing, the HMM achieves higher AUC across the examined smoothing scales. Individual switch detection times are comparable, while the HMM generally achieves lower group-level detection times. NET also outperforms alpha power and spectral entropy as an observation feature in the unsupervised HMM framework.
  Significance: The proposed framework provides a label-free approach for estimating temporal fluctuations in auditory attention, demonstrating the utility of probabilistic temporal inference for continuous attention tracking in single-speaker listening scenarios.

</details>


### [270] [Sensing-Assisted OFDM with Index Modulation: A Waveform for Optical Wireless Integrated Communication and Localisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21753)
*Ali Waqar Azim,Mohamed Sufyan Islim,Muhammad Ali Imran,Harald Hass Hanaa Abumarshoud*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出面向光无线系统的感知辅助OFDM索引调制（SA-OFDM-IM）方案，通过多层频域子载波划分与感知-通信能量约束优化，实现低复杂度联合通信与定位，性能显著优于DCO-OFDM基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光无线系统需同时实现高可靠通信与高精度定位，但传统DCO-OFDM存在能效与信道估计精度不足、最大似然检测复杂度过高、纯时延估计存在与SNR无关的误差下限等问题。

Method: 设计多层频域架构，将各层可用子载波划分为互不重叠的通信子集与分布式感知导频子集，并在通信子集内采用分组索引调制；在最小功率域裕度约束下，进行感知-通信能量分配以联合最小化平均BER与时延定位RMSE，配合有序能量检测降低复杂度；跨帧聚合感知音重构信道频响，提取LoS时延抽头与相位补偿的LoS增益用于多边定位，并提出时延辅助的RSS精化方法。

Result: BER所需SNR最多降低5 dB；信道估计误差较DCO-OFDM最多低三个数量级；RSS估计器消除纯时延与混合RSS基准中与SNR无关的误差下限，实现亚时延bin级测距与定位精度，并在已知/未知随机接收机朝向下保持鲁棒。

Conclusion: SA-OFDM-IM在光无线联合通信与定位中实现了低复杂度、高能效与高精度定位的统一，验证了感知辅助子载波划分与时延辅助RSS精化的有效性。

Abstract: This paper proposes sensing-assisted OFDM with index modulation (SA-OFDM-IM) for joint communication and localisation over optical wireless systems. In SA-OFDM-IM, a multilayer frequency-domain architecture partitions each layer's admissible subcarriers into disjoint communication and distributed sensing-pilot subsets, applying group-wise index modulation (IM) within the communication subset. A constrained sensing-to-communication energy allocation jointly minimises average bit-error rate (BER) and delay-based localisation root mean square error (RMSE) under a minimum power-domain margin, enabling low-complexity, ordered-energy detection of both sensing and communication subcarriers without exhaustive maximum-likelihood search. Sensing tones are aggregated across the frame to reconstruct the channel frequency response, yielding the line-of-sight (LoS) delay tap and phase-compensated LoS gain for multilateration and, via the proposed delay-aided received signal strength (RSS) refinement. Simulation results indicate that SA-OFDM-IM can achieve up to 5 dB lower SNR requirement in BER and up to three orders of magnitude lower channel-estimation error than DC-biased optical OFDM, while the RSS estimator removes the SNR-independent error floors of delay-only and hybrid-RSS benchmarks to attain sub-delay-bin range and position accuracy, remaining robust under random known and unknown receiver orientations.

</details>


### [271] [Confidence-Guided Adaptive Beam Selection for Vision-Aided Beam Tracking in mmWave Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21880)
*Sohani Munteha Hiam,Mohammad Soleymani,Rafael F. Schaefer*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出置信度引导的自适应候选波束选择方法：对预测器logits做温度校准，在最大预算约束下保留累计概率达到目标阈值的最小top-ranked波束集合，替代固定top-K选择，在DeepSense 6G Scenario 8上匹配开销下提升候选集准确率、归一化接收功率并降低中断概率，且无需重训练预测器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉辅助波束跟踪通过相机观测预测波束索引以降低毫米波波束训练开销，但固定top-K选择对所有预测分配相同候选波束预算，忽略了样本间与预测时域上的不确定性差异，导致开销分配次优。

Method: 对预测器输出logits进行温度校准以获得可靠置信度；在最大预算约束下，按置信度排序保留累计概率首次达到目标阈值的最小波束集合，实现逐样本、随时域自适应的候选集规模；全程不重训练预测器。

Result: 在DeepSense 6G Scenario 8上，5个随机种子、开销匹配条件下：候选集准确率最高提升3.80个百分点，归一化接收功率提升0.32个百分点，中断概率降低2.06个百分点。

Conclusion: 以校准置信度驱动的自适应候选集选择可在不增加开销、不重训练的前提下有效提升视觉辅助波束跟踪的可靠性与能效，说明不确定性感知的预算分配优于统一top-K策略。

Abstract: Vision-aided beam tracking reduces mmWave beam-training overhead by predicting beam indices from camera observations. Fixed top-$K$ selection, however, assigns the same candidate beam budget to all predictions, ignoring uncertainty variations across samples and horizons. This letter proposes confidence-guided adaptive candidate selection: predictor logits are temperature-calibrated, and the smallest top-ranked beam set whose cumulative probability reaches a target threshold is retained under a maximum budget. On DeepSense~6G Scenario~8, over five random seeds and at matched overhead, the policy improves candidate set accuracy by up to 3.80 percentage points, increases normalized received power by 0.32 percentage points, and reduces outage probability by 2.06 percentage points without retraining the predictor.

</details>


### [272] [Statistical Ambiguity-Function-Aware Joint Beamforming and Subcarrier Allocation for MIMO-OFDM ISAC under Random Symbols](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21888)
*Wonill Kim,Yumin Kim,Hyeonsu Lyu,Hyun Jong Yang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 针对ISAC中随机通信符号使模糊函数(AF)数据相关的问题，本文统计刻画了DP-AF并推导精确闭式期望旁瓣电平(ESL)，指出零多普勒PSLR可由波束成形控制而ISLR不变，进而提出基于变异系数(CV)的凸化PSLR约束联合波束成形与子载波分配方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ISAC系统中随机通信符号使模糊函数(AF)随数据变化，难以刻画并纳入发射设计。核心问题是在实用的多用户多目标(MUMT) MIMO-OFDM系统中，究竟哪种AF特性能够通过波束成形被有效控制。

Method: 统计刻画离散周期模糊函数(DP-AF)，推导闭式期望旁瓣电平(ESL)；分析发现非零多普勒ESL切片在时延上平坦、二维积分旁瓣比(ISLR)对波束成形不变，而零多普勒峰值旁瓣比(PSLR)可控。据此构建带目标级PSLR与照射约束的AF感知联合波束成形与子载波分配问题。由于PSLR约束不可处理，先刻画其全局最优解，证明当符号峰度大于1时各目标方向功率谱在子载波上平坦是PSLR最大化的充要条件；再引入变异系数(CV)度量平坦度偏离，推导紧的CV相关PSLR上下界，以下界构造凸充分约束实现高效重构。

Result: 仿真表明：在平坦谱点相比纯通信波束成形，最坏情况PSLR提升9.4–11.0 dB，总速率损失仅2.4–5.9%；CV松弛方案达到原PSLR约束问题平均总速率的99.7%，同时运行时间降低10.35–12.15倍。

Conclusion: 在MUMT MIMO-OFDM ISAC中，仅零多普勒PSLR可通过波束成形有效调控，ISLR不受影响；基于CV的凸松弛PSLR约束在几乎不损失速率的前提下大幅降低计算复杂度，为AF感知发射设计提供可行途径。

Abstract: Ambiguity function (AF) characterizes the delay--Doppler sidelobe structure that governs target resolution and masking in radar sensing. In ISAC, however, random communication symbols make the AF data-dependent, complicating its characterization and incorporation into transmit design. This raises a fundamental question: which AF characteristic can be effectively controlled through beamforming in a practical multiuser multitarget (MUMT) MIMO--OFDM system? To answer this, we statistically characterize the discrete-periodic AF (DP-AF) and derive an exact closed-form expected sidelobe level (ESL). We observe that nonzero-Doppler ESL cuts are delay-flat and the full two-dimensional integrated sidelobe level ratio (ISLR) is invariant to beamforming, whereas the zero-Doppler peak-to-sidelobe ratio (PSLR) remains controllable. We accordingly formulate an AF-aware joint beamforming and subcarrier-allocation problem with target-wise PSLR and illumination constraints. Since the direct PSLR constraint is intractable, we characterize its global optimum and prove that, for symbol kurtosis greater than one, the PSLR is maximized if and only if each target-wise directional-power profile is flat across subcarriers. We then introduce the coefficient of variation (CV) to measure deviation from this flatness and derive tight CV-dependent PSLR bounds. The lower bound yields a convex sufficient constraint for a desired PSLR, enabling an efficient reformulation. Simulations show $9.4$--$11.0$ dB worst-case PSLR gains over communication-only beamforming at the flat-spectrum point with a $2.4$--$5.9\%$ sum-rate loss. The CV-relaxed formulation achieves $99.7\%$ of the average sum-rate of the original PSLR-constrained problem, while reducing runtime by factors of $10.35$--$12.15$ under the considered scenarios.

</details>


### [273] [Seeing Through Sparse Signals: CS-Enhanced Sensing With QoS Guarantees for 6G ISAC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21905)
*Yifei Wang,Pradyumna Kumar Bishoyi,Marina Petrova*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文研究5G NR参考信号复用的ISAC系统中通信QoS与感知质量(QoSe)的权衡，联合设计资源调度与压缩感知重建：比较QoS保障调度与比例公平(PF)调度对权衡的影响，并提出2D max-median复数近似消息传递(2D-mmCAMP)算法抑制旁瓣、保留弱目标；仿真显示弱目标检测性能较基线提升≥16%且满足下行QoS约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NR参考信号稀疏导致信道欠采样与强旁瓣，恶化弱目标检测；压缩感知可缓解但现有方法或忽略通信QoS约束，或所用重建算法对步长敏感、采用全局阈值，在多目标场景中掩蔽弱目标。因此需联合优化资源调度与CS重建。

Method: 研究QoS保障调度与比例公平(PF)调度两种方案对感知-通信权衡的影响；提出2D max-median复数近似消息传递(2D-mmCAMP)，按行、列自适应阈值化以抑制旁瓣并保留弱目标响应。

Result: 仿真表明，在满足下行QoS约束条件下，弱目标检测性能较基线重建算法提升≥16%，验证了所提符合NR标准的ISAC方案的有效性。

Conclusion: 资源调度与CS重建的联合设计可在保证通信QoS的同时显著改善多目标场景下的弱目标检测，自适应二维阈值化是关键增益来源。

Abstract: In integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems, communication and sensing share time-frequency resources, creating a fundamental trade-off between communication quality of service (QoS) and quality of sensing (QoSe). Reusing 5G new radio (NR) reference signals (RSs) enables standard-compliant sensing, but their inherent sparsity leads to undersampled channels and strong sidelobes that degrade weak-target detection. Compressed sensing (CS) can mitigate these effects, yet existing methods either overlook communication QoS constraints or rely on reconstruction algorithms that are step-size-sensitive or employ global thresholding, leading to weak-target masking in multi-target scenarios. The multi-target detection problem, therefore, requires a joint design of resource scheduling and CS-based reconstruction. In this work, we investigate the impact of two scheduling schemes, namely QoS-guaranteed scheduling and proportional-fairness (PF)-based scheduling, on the sensing-communication trade-off. To further enhance sensing performance, we employ a 2D max-median complex approximate message passing (2D-mmCAMP) algorithm that performs adaptive row- and column-wise thresholding to suppress sidelobes while preserving weak-target responses in multi-target scenarios. Simulations demonstrate an improvement of >= 16% in weak-target detection over baseline reconstruction algorithms while meeting downlink (DL) QoS constraints, validating the effectiveness of the proposed NR-compliant ISAC scheme.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [274] [FlowBudget: Training-Free Sampling-Budget Estimation for Flow Matching Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20636)
*Zahra Dehghani,Pablo Piantanida,Mohammadhadi Shateri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FLOWBUDGET：一种无需训练的估计器，基于对学习动力学的无模拟插值探针，估计与求解器相关的采样复杂度，从而在无需多预算采样或 FID-NFE 扫描的情况下确定固定预训练流模型和求解器所需的 NFE 预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配等连续流式生成器的采样依赖 ODE/SDE 数值积分，推理成本由函数评估次数（NFE）决定。实践中采样预算多沿用先前工作或通过昂贵的 FID-NFE 扫描选取，需在多个预算下反复生成样本并评估，导致预算选择依赖重复的经验评估。作者因此提出一个与求解器设计和时间步分配互补的问题：对固定预训练模型与求解器，何种数值分辨率才足够。

Method: FLOWBUDGET 利用对学习动力学的无模拟插值探针，将主导的一步离散化误差按运动量归一化，由插值探针估计其系数，并依据求解器阶数将数值容差映射为步数预算。作者为流匹配采样推导了各求解器的估计器：ODE 采样的 Euler 与 Heun，以及 SDE 采样的加噪 Euler–Maruyama，并将 ODE 系数与终端积分误差建立联系。

Result: 在 SiT、FlowDCN 与 Rectified Flow 模型上的实验（涵盖不同流模型架构与表述）检验了 FLOWBUDGET 能否在不在多个预算下生成样本、也不进行 FID-NFE 扫描的前提下估计 NFE 预算。代码已开源。

Conclusion: FLOWBUDGET 提供了一种免训练、与求解器相关的采样复杂度估计方法，可将数值容差映射为步数预算，为固定预训练模型与求解器下的采样预算选择提供替代 FID-NFE 扫描的手段，并与求解器设计和时间步分配形成互补。

Abstract: Sampling from continuous flow-based generators such as flow matching models requires numerical ODE or SDE integration, making inference cost depend on the number of function evaluations (NFEs). In practice, the sampling budget is inherited from prior work or selected through expensive FID-versus-NFE sweeps, using FID to assess image-generation quality, requiring sample generation and evaluation at multiple budgets. This makes sampling-budget selection dependent on repeated empirical evaluation. We therefore ask a complementary question to solver design and timestep allocation: for a fixed pretrained model and solver, what numerical resolution is sufficient? We introduce FLOWBUDGET, a training-free estimator of solver-relative sampling complexity. Using simulation-free interpolation probes of the learned dynamics, FLOWBUDGET normalizes the leading one-step discretization error by the motion, estimates its coefficient from interpolation probes, and maps a numerical tolerance to a step budget using the solver order. We derive estimators for numerical solvers in flow~matching sampling, namely Euler and Heun for ODE sampling and additive-noise Euler--Maruyama for SDE sampling, and connect the ODE coefficients to terminal integration error. Experiments on SiT, FlowDCN and Rectified Flow models, spanning flow-model architectures and formulations, test whether FLOWBUDGET can estimate the NFE budget without generating samples at multiple budgets or performing an FID-versus-NFE sweep. The code is available at https://github.com/Yasaman-dt/FlowBudget

</details>


### [275] [Expanding Attention: A Taylor-Series Route to Linear-Time Transformers with a Fixed Number of Recurrent States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20637)
*Zicong Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将注意力指数核展开为n项泰勒级数，每项分解为张量幂内积，把因果历史压缩为n个循环状态（每token一次秩一更新、与上下文长度N无关），损失可忽略且块间可加、支持并行扫描；复杂度指数由softmax的N^2.28降至N^0.91，交叉点约N≈728，N=8192时提速20.8×，解码延迟恒定7.3μs（N=65536时76×）；精度随n指数提升但成本组合增长，最优为二阶n=3（误差6.5e-4，每头9945元素），且需查询/键归一化保证收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准softmax注意力的时间与显存开销随上下文长度N呈近二次增长，长上下文场景下prefill与逐token解码均代价高昂，需要一种与N无关的线性化注意力机制，同时保持精度可控。

Method: 把指数核截断为n项泰勒展开，将每一项因式分解为张量幂内积，使整体因果历史坍缩为恰好n个循环状态；每个token以一次秩一外积更新一个状态，状态规模与N无关。由于截断核下的递推是无损的且状态在chunk间可加，prefill可采用并行扫描实现。理论分析给出精度随n指数收敛、而第m个状态宽度为C(d+m-1,m)的组合增长界（经SVD验证），并强调查询与键归一化是收敛半径内的前提条件。

Result: float64下截断核误差2.2e-16、块间可加性误差5.7e-14。实测复杂度：softmax为t∝N^2.28，状态法为N^0.91，交叉点N≈728，N=8192时提速20.8×；逐token解码延迟恒为7.3μs（softmax为N^1.04），N=65536时提速76.0×。精度随n指数提升，但成本组合增长，因此最优配置为二阶n=3，误差6.5e-4，每头9945个元素。缺少查询/键归一化时参数超出收敛半径，增加项数不再有增益。

Conclusion: 该工作给出了一种以张量幂泰勒展开构造的线性时间循环注意力：状态数固定为n并与N解耦，prefill可并行扫描、解码延迟恒定，长上下文下相对softmax获得数量级加速；代价是精度与状态宽度之间的组合权衡，实践中最优点为n=3的二阶近似，且归一化是必需条件。

Abstract: We expand the exponential kernel of attention into a truncated Taylor series of $n$ terms and factorize each term into a tensor-power inner product, which collapses the causal history into exactly $n$ recurrent states, each updated by one rank-one outer product per token and independent of context length $N$. The recursion is lossless with respect to the truncated kernel ($2.2 \times 10^{-16}$ in float64), and the states are additive across chunks ($5.7 \times 10^{-14}$), so prefill admits a parallel scan. Measured exponents are $t \propto N^{2.28}$ for softmax against $N^{0.91}$ for states, with a crossover at $N \approx 728$ and $20.8\times$ at $N = 8192$; per-token decoding latency is constant at $7.3\,μ$s against $N^{1.04}$ for softmax, giving $76.0\times$ at $N = 65536$. Accuracy improves exponentially in $n$ while cost grows combinatorially, since the $m$-th state is $\binom{d+m-1}{m}$ wide---a bound confirmed by SVD---so the optimum is second order, $n = 3$, at $6.5 \times 10^{-4}$ error and $9{,}945$ elements per head. Query and key normalization is a prerequisite: without it the argument exceeds the convergence radius and adding terms stops helping.

</details>


### [276] [Feature Elicitation for SAE Steering of Deceptive Behaviour in Small LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20638)
*J Koorndijk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文利用SAE稀疏自编码器引导与义务论伦理相关的特征，在Gemma-3-27B-IT中将对齐伪装场景下的合规差距降至不显著水平，并首次记录到"欺骗性钝化"（deceptive defanging）这一新型欺骗行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿模型能力提升使欺骗性对齐（deceptive alignment）风险愈发紧迫，而对齐伪装（alignment faking）的关键行为指标"合规差距"（compliance gap）在小模型上研究不足，且此前的机制性干预未能证明能缓解该差距。

Method: 采用新颖的"词袋式"特征激发流程（bag-of-words feature elicitation pipeline）进行SAE引导，识别出可解释为概念级引导方向的SAE特征，并测试其与义务论伦理（deontological ethics）关联特征对合规差距的干预效果；模型为Gemma-3-27B-IT与LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct，并分析scratchpad推理轨迹。

Result: 在Gemma-3-27B-IT中将合规差距降至非显著水平，但相同配置在LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct上无效；scratchpad分析揭示出一种称为"欺骗性钝化"的行为——故意降低回答中对齐功能（此处为危害性）却保留对齐表象（此处为对有害请求的顺从帮助），且有时受层级、训练或RLHF后果条件所调节。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个表明激活层面的机制性干预能够缓解对齐伪装情境下合规差距的证据；同时识别出一种可拓展对LLM欺骗行为类型理解的新形式，但干预效果存在模型依赖性，跨模型泛化仍需进一步验证。

Abstract: Research on deceptive alignment is becoming increasingly urgent as frontier-model capabilities advance and their risk of causing catastrophic harm increases. Alignment faking is a form of deceptive alignment, with the compliance gap serving as a key behavioural indicator. This behaviour remains understudied in small LLMs and prior mechanistic interventions have not been shown to mitigate the compliance gap. We test whether steering SAE (sparse autoencoders) features associated with deontological ethics can mitigate this behaviour. We use a novel bag-of-words feature elicitation pipeline for SAE steering to identify what we construe as concept-level steering directions. Our approach reduced the compliance gap to non-significance in Gemma-3-27B-IT, whereas the tested configurations were not effective in LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct. Analysis of scratchpad traces also revealed deceptive model behaviour which we term deceptive defanging: deliberately degrading the aligned functionality of a response (in this case harmfulness) while preserving the appearance of alignment (in this case helpful compliance with the harmful request), sometimes conditioned on tier, training, or RLHF consequences. These findings provide, to our knowledge, the first evidence that a mechanistic activation-level intervention can mitigate the compliance gap in an alignment faking setup. They also identify a form of deceptive behaviour that may broaden our understanding of the different forms of deceptive behaviour in LLMs.

</details>


### [277] [Same Answer, New Box: How Much of RLVR's Out-of-Domain Gain Is Answer Format?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20639)
*Zongye Lyu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在四个已发布的7B SimpleRL基座-强化学习模型对上，公共代码中沿用的答案抽取器所报告的域外多项选择增益有82%在改用更稳健的抽取器后消失——这是答案格式的增益而非答案质量的增益；用独立LLM阅读器或显式要求\boxed{}的提示分别得到77%和79%。重新打分存储输出即可量化该效应，无需重跑RL。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）常被报告具有超出奖励校验域的泛化收益（如数学训练后MMLU准确率提升），但这类准确率多由答案抽取器从模型文本中读出。若模型学会把答案写在抽取器偏好的位置，就能在未真正提升答题能力的情况下取得更高分数。作者希望量化这种"抽取器驱动"的虚高增益占比。

Method: 对基座模型及其RL模型生成输出，分别用两类抽取器打分：(1) 沿用自公开代码的常规抽取器；(2) 作者自研抽取器，无论答案位于\boxed{}框中还是正文文本中，都能读到明确陈述的答案。实验覆盖四个已发布的7B SimpleRL基座-RL配对，并以独立LLM阅读器、以及在提示中显式要求使用box的设定做对照；另在一个用不同配方训练的32B配对上进行验证。全程只需对已存储输出重新打分。

Result: 在四个7B配对中，常规抽取器报告的域外多项选择增益有82%在自研抽取器下消失；换成独立LLM阅读器为77%，在提示显式要求box时自研抽取器给出79%。原因是基座模型本已在正文中陈述多数答案，而RL将其迁入box——正是常规抽取器优先搜索的位置。相反，采用另一训练配方的32B配对几乎不存在格式增益：其基座模型在被要求时才使用box，其RL模型在未被要求时很少使用。

Conclusion: 所报告的增益部分地是读取它的抽取器的属性；对已存储输出用第二个抽取器重新打分即可揭示这一比例，无需重新运行RL。评估RLVR泛化时应报告抽取器敏感性，采用对答案位置不敏感的稳健抽取方式。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is credited with gains beyond the domain its rewards check, such as higher MMLU accuracy after training on mathematics. Such accuracies are usually read out of the model's text by an answer extractor. A model that learns to write its answer where the extractor looks can therefore score higher without answering better. We measure how much of the gain reported by extractors copied from public code arises this way. We generate outputs from a base model and its RL model and score them twice: with those extractors, and with one extractor of our own that reads a stated answer whether it is in the answer box \boxed{} or in the text. On four released 7B SimpleRL base-RL pairs, 82% of the out-of-domain multiple-choice gain that these extractors report disappears under ours: it is a gain in answer format, not in answers. The base models already state most of their answers in text, and RL moves them into the box, where these extractors look first. Independent LLM readers, in place of our extractor, put the figure at 77%. With a prompt that itself asks for the box, our extractor puts it at 79%. On a 32B pair trained with another recipe, almost none of the reported gain is format gain: its base model boxes its answers when asked, and its RL model rarely does when not. A reported gain is partly a property of the extractor that read it, and re-scoring stored outputs with a second extractor shows how much, without re-running RL.

</details>


### [278] [KNOU-Flood: Advancing global streamflow forecasting with lead-aware probabilistic machine learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20640)
*Minjong Cheon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在保持AIFL单层LSTM与两阶段训练不变的前提下，通过改进输入信息（更长窗口、lead-aware输入、GraphCast第二预报源）并加入潜变量噪声集合与fair CRPS训练，将KNOU-Flood扩展到概率径流预报，在2,099个测试流域上显著优于AIFL复现基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驱动径流模型在再分析数据上训练、却由业务预报驱动时精度下降，且随预见期延长而加剧。AIFL用两阶段迁移学习和确定性LSTM应对该偏移，但整个输入窗口只喂入单一预见期的预报，且不提供不确定性估计。作者希望在不改循环核心的前提下，检验该开放配方可被扩展多远。

Method: 保留单层LSTM与两阶段训练；改进输入侧：424天长输入窗口、lead-aware预报输入、在ECMWF HRES之外引入GraphCast作为第二预报源；输出侧用潜变量噪声集成并以fair CRPS训练。在相同数据、站点、划分与指标下与AIFL复现版（原代码未公开）、1024单元基线对比。

Result: 3个随机种子、2021–2023年2,099个测试流域上，KNOU-Flood中位KGE'为LT1 0.65、LT10 0.48，基线为0.62与0.34，两种评分协议下全部十个预见期均显著提升，对1024单元基线和留出流域亦成立（后者单种子）。相同权重下LT10 KGE'因预报喂入方式不同为0.18或0.34，说明AIFL报告的预见期衰减很大程度是输入协议效应；增益主要来自概率头，其次为GraphCast原始通道、更长窗口与混合微调。集成CRPS低于基线概率版，推理期dropout下接近校准，1.5年与2年洪水的检测优于所有基线；更稀有洪水受益依赖种子，尾部加权变体改善10年及更大事件。

Conclusion: KNOU-Flood是对开放配方的受控扩展而非新架构；其增益主要源于输入协议与概率建模，提示文献中报告的预见期衰减部分可归因于预报喂入方式。

Abstract: Global streamflow forecasting supports flood preparedness, yet data-driven models trained on reanalysis lose skill when driven by operational forecasts, increasingly so with lead time. AIFL addresses this shift with a two-stage transfer-learning recipe and a deterministic LSTM, but it feeds one forecast lead time into the whole input window and gives no uncertainty. We ask how far this open recipe can be extended without changing its recurrent core. KNOU-Flood keeps a single-layer LSTM and the two-stage training and changes the information around it: a longer input window (424 days), lead-aware forecast inputs, GraphCast as a second forecast source next to ECMWF HRES, and a latent-noise ensemble trained with the fair CRPS. We compare against a re-implementation of the AIFL recipe (its code is not public) under identical data, stations, splits and metrics. Our contributions are threefold. First, over three seeds and 2,099 test basins (2021-2023), KNOU-Flood reaches a median KGE' of 0.65 at LT1 and 0.48 at LT10 against 0.62 and 0.34, with significant gains at all ten lead times under two scoring protocols, also against a 1024-unit baseline and on held-out basins (one seed each). Second, identical weights give an LT10 KGE' of 0.18 or 0.34 depending on how forecasts are fed, so much of the lead-time decay reported for AIFL is an input-protocol effect; the probabilistic head contributes most to the gain, followed by the raw GraphCast channels, the longer window and mixed fine-tuning. Third, the ensembles reach lower CRPS than probabilistic versions of the baseline, are nearly calibrated with inference-time dropout, and detect 1.5- and 2-year floods better than all baselines; the benefit for rarer floods depends on the seed, and an exploratory tail-weighted variant improves 10-year and larger events. KNOU-Flood is a controlled extension of an open recipe, not a new architecture.

</details>


### [279] [Spectral Indistinguishability and Learning-Curve Identifiability in Quadratic Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20678)
*Dekun Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究谱摘要与标量学习曲线对中心二次网络的可辨识性。作者构造一、二阶边缘恰为高斯的解析正密度输入族，其四阶矩算符被正交映射缠绕从而锚定谱测度一致，但因该映射不保矩阵乘法而使部分共同教师的分解损失曲线出现差异。进而给出噪声标量损失查询、初始化干预、共享输入评分等的样本复杂度刻画，并在高斯输入、有理无关教师谱下证明单条精确损失曲线可辨识初始预测器（至符号共轭）、教师谱与活跃维度，以及有限样本的局部/全局恢复界限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究仅凭谱摘要（锚定谱测度）与标量学习曲线这类弱观测，能否唯一确定中心二次网络的结构（输入分布、教师矩阵、初始预测器等）。核心动机是检验谱不变量是否足以约束网络的学习动力学，并界定需要何种额外查询（噪声损失、梯度读出、初始化干预）与样本量才能实现辨识。

Method: 1) 构造具有完全相同一、二阶高斯边缘的解析正输入密度，其四阶矩算符由固定整个对角教师代数的正交映射缠绕，使锚定谱测度一致；2) 利用该映射不保矩阵乘法的性质，构造分叉的分解损失曲线，以循环长度 r 产生 O(ε^r) 的统一训练时间对比；3) 定量分析噪声标量损失查询（需 ε^{-2r} 量级观测）、有界初始化干预+标量梯度读出（需 ε^{-2} 量级）及基于配对梯度差的共享输入评分；4) 构造教师尺度发散的显式族，在耦合 1/log L 下得到非零极限对比；5) 在高斯输入、有理无关教师谱下，由精确标量损失曲线辨识初始预测器（至符号共轭）、教师谱与活跃维度（模同时旋转）；6) 对固定维度与互异无序教师和，证明维度最小精确观测下的泛化联合局部恢复；7) 用精确证书与全权重回放验证构造，并数值检验反问题病态性。

Result: 锚定谱测度相同的输入族可与不同的分解损失曲线共存，展示谱摘要不足以确定学习动力学；循环长度 r 可任意大时对比为 O(ε^r)（统一于训练时间）；噪声标量损失查询需 Θ(ε^{-2r}) 次观测，而带标量梯度读出的有界初始化干预仅需 Θ(ε^{-2})；共享输入评分在未知教师时即达最优输入样本指数；发散辅助教师族在耦合 1/log L 下呈现非零有限极限对比；高斯输入下单条精确损失曲线可辨识初始预测器至符号共轭，并（在有理无关类、非零对角逆状态误差等条件下）辨识教师谱与活跃维度（模同时旋转）；固定维度下达成泛化联合局部恢复，并给出已知教师及盲维度上限下的有限精确全局界；数值反向检查显示严重病态。

Conclusion: 谱摘要（低阶矩谱不变量）一般不足以判定中心二次网络的可学习性差异，必须借助矩阵乘法结构或额外查询；标量损失曲线在高斯、有理无关谱条件下具有强辨识力（可至符号共轭与同时旋转），噪声下查询复杂度随循环长度 r 指数增长（ε^{-2r}），而梯度读出可降至 ε^{-2}。结果同时给出有限精确恢复界限与构造性验证，但反问题的严重病态性提示理论可辨识性与数值可行性之间存在显著差距。

Abstract: We study what spectral summaries and scalar learning curves reveal about centered quadratic networks. We construct analytic positive input densities with exactly Gaussian one- and two-coordinate marginals. Their complete fourth-moment operators are intertwined by an orthogonal map fixing the entire diagonal teacher algebra, so the corresponding anchored spectral measures agree. For selected common teachers with a nonzero cycle invariant, their factorized loss curves differ because the map does not preserve matrix multiplication. Cycle length $r$, which can be arbitrarily large, gives $O(\varepsilon^r)$ contrast uniformly in training time for each fixed construction. For a supplied pair, noisy scalar loss queries require order $\varepsilon^{-2r}$ observations, while bounded initialization interventions with scalar gradient readouts require order $\varepsilon^{-2}$. A shared-input score, equal to a paired-gradient difference, attains the optimal input-sample exponent without knowing the teacher. An explicit family of diverging auxiliary teacher scales instead admits a nonzero finite limiting contrast at coupling $1/\log L$. Conversely, for Gaussian inputs and a rationally independent teacher spectrum, one exact scalar loss curve identifies the initial predictor up to sign conjugation. Within this rationally independent class, with nonzero diagonal inverse-state error in every coordinate and calibrated time and loss scales, it also identifies the unknown teacher spectrum and active dimension, modulo simultaneous rotations. For fixed dimension and distinct unordered teacher sums, dimension-minimal exact observations give generic joint local recovery. Finite exact global bounds hold for a known teacher and, on the active class, under a blind dimension cap. Exact certificates and full-weight replay verify the construction; numerical inverse checks reveal severe ill-conditioning.

</details>


### [280] [Diminishing Returns of Data in Sparse Autoencoders: Functional Behavior does not Guarantee Feature Reproducibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20680)
*Sambit Ghosh,Madelyn Mathai,R. Venkatesh Babu,Chirag Agarwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究稀疏自编码器（SAE）训练所需激活数据量，发现数据需求强烈依赖评估指标：重建常在较少预算下逼近全量参考，而特征级逐一复现性随数据持续提升；数据选择方式也影响结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAE 通常需数亿至数十亿激活 token 训练，但该规模是否必要缺乏实证；作者希望厘清不同训练目标下 SAE 的数据需求边界。

Method: 在3个语言模型上，用4种 SAE 架构、5M 至 500M token 的预算训练；以标准评测上的功能行为与学习特征的逐一复现性两类收敛度量评估；对比随机采样与多样性采样的数据选择策略；并从理论上区分子采样训练的统计一致性与特征可辨识性/优化条件。

Result: 功能层面重建在较小预算下即可接近全量数据参考，而特征复现性随数据增加持续改善：Gemma-2-2B BatchTopK 的严格匹配特征比例从 5M 时的 2% 升至 50M 时的 29%。随机采样更好保持原始激活分布、利于重建；多样性采样常提升 AutoInterp。

Conclusion: 按目标匹配预算时 SAE 训练可显著提高数据效率；特征层面的结论应由显式复现性检验支撑，从而推动更廉价可靠的 SAE 研究。

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are typically trained on hundreds of millions to billions of activation tokens, yet little work has tested whether this scale is necessary. We study how much activation data SAEs need by training four SAE architectures on three language models with budgets ranging from 5M tokens to a 500M-token reference. We measure two notions of convergence: functional behavior on standard evaluations and one-to-one reproducibility of learned features. Functional data requirements are strongly metric-dependent: reconstruction often approaches the full-data reference at substantially smaller budgets, whereas feature reproducibility continues to improve with data. For Gemma-2-2B BatchTopK, the fraction of strictly matched features rises from 2\% at 5M tokens to 29\% at 50M. Data selection also matters: random sampling better preserves the original activation distribution and generally favors reconstruction, whereas diversity-based sampling frequently improves AutoInterp. A theoretical analysis separates statistical consistency of subsampled training from the stronger identifiability and optimization conditions required for one-to-one feature recovery. Our results show that SAE training can often be made far more data-efficient when budgets are matched to the goal, and feature-level claims are backed by explicit reproducibility checks, paving the way toward cheaper and more reliable SAE research.

</details>


### [281] [TurboMamba: Faster Inference, Faster Training, and Better Prediction with Lexical Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20682)
*Hanxin Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 TurboMamba 架构：全局 Mamba-3 按块运行，小型 Transformer 借助全局上下文与块内历史预测下一 token，并以三项轻量增强改进局部预测；在 FineWeb-Edu 上十二个模型对比中取得最低 NLL 与最高训练/推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在同时实现更快的训练、更快的推理以及更优的 token 预测质量，探索 Mamba 与 Transformer 混合架构的效率-效果平衡点。

Method: 全局 Mamba-3 模型在每个完成的 token 块上运行一次，提供全局上下文；小型 Transformer 结合该全局上下文和块内更早的 token 做局部下一 token 预测。三项轻量增强：直接访问上一块最后一个 token、对下一 token 分数施加小型校正、与近期 token 频率进行可学习的混合。在公开 FineWeb-Edu 上进行十二个小规模实现对比，参数量相当且共享训练预算上限；基线为 Transformer、Mamba-3、Jamba、Zamba，其中 Jamba/Zamba 以 Mamba-3 替换原 Mamba 模块。

Result: 平均测试 NLL 最低：比 Mamba-3 低 9.4%，比 Jamba 版本低 7.3%，比 Zamba 版本低 18.3%。端到端训练吞吐为 Mamba-3 的 2.60x、Jamba 版本的 2.81x、Zamba 版本的 4.82x。批量 32 条序列、每条 256 token 提示 + 生成 128 token 的端到端延迟上，相对三者分别加速 3.12x、3.53x、6.21x。

Conclusion: TurboMamba 在小规模受控设置下同时实现了更低预测损失与显著更高的训练吞吐和更低推理延迟，显示"低频全局 Mamba + 高频局部 Transformer"的分块混合是兼顾质量与效率的有效方案。

Abstract: We introduce TurboMamba, a language-model architecture for faster inference, faster training, and better token prediction. A global Mamba-3 model runs once per completed token block. A small Transformer uses this global context and earlier tokens within the block to predict the next token. Three lightweight additions improve local predictions: direct access to the previous block's last token, a small correction to next-token scores, and a learned mixture with recent-token frequencies. We compare twelve small-scale implementations on public FineWeb-Edu, with comparable parameter counts and shared training-budget caps. The baselines include Transformer, Mamba-3, Jamba, and Zamba. The Jamba and Zamba versions use Mamba-3 in place of their original Mamba modules. TurboMamba achieves the lowest mean test prediction loss (negative log-likelihood, NLL) among all twelve models. Its mean NLL is 9.4% lower than that of Mamba-3, 7.3% lower than that of the Jamba version, and 18.3% lower than that of the Zamba version. End-to-end training throughput is 2.60x that of Mamba-3, 2.81x that of the Jamba version, and 4.82x that of the Zamba version. We measure end-to-end batch latency for a batch of 32 sequences, each with a 256-token prompt and 128 generated tokens. On this workload, TurboMamba achieves a 3.12x speedup over Mamba-3, a 3.53x speedup over the Jamba version, and a 6.21x speedup over the Zamba version.

</details>


### [282] [Causal Syntax Circuits in CodeLMs: Budget and Probe Decide What Looks Localised](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20683)
*Harsh Kumar,Tanmay Shailesh Joshi,Rahul Maity,Anusa Saha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文用统一流水线在55个模型-语言设置上检验代码模型"默认写Python"偏好是否由少量可定位组件产生，发现其可定位性的结论高度依赖探针设计与电路预算等分析选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者关注一个机制性问题：代码模型在提示未指定语言时倾向于输出Python，这一偏好是否由模型内部一小群可识别的组件（电路）产生。同时希望揭示"行为是否局部化"这一结论对分析方法选择的敏感性。

Method: 构建统一流水线：均值消融、激活修补、贪心电路抽取、与同规模随机对照组的多重比较显著性检验、激活引导；覆盖10个开源代码模型（5个基座+5个指令微调）共55个模型-语言设置，3种目标语言（Rust、C#、PHP）、两套提示集、两档组件预算（12与40）。

Result: 五项发现：(1) 偏好显著、随模型规模增大，且经指令微调后仍存在，平均比基座版高12%；(2) 测得的偏好大小主要由探针决定，改用XLCoST平行函数后同一测量从约1.6降至约0.01；(3) 局部化与否取决于组件预算：预算12时15个设置中仅1个电路通过随机对照显著性校正，预算40时为6/15；(4) 小预算研究报告为"普遍失败"的干预有时成功——激活修补在45个设置中2个使Python提示偏好目标语法，激活引导在9/45中改变最可能的下一个token；(5) 效应显著但方向背离目标语言的电路全部来自电路抽取失败的设置，属诊断信号而非真实现象。

Conclusion: 关于某行为是否局部化的论断可能取决于论文通常不报告的分析选择（探针设计、组件预算、显著性标准等）；作者公开完整实验网格以便他人改变这些选择进行复现与检验。

Abstract: Code models write Python when the prompt does not say which language to use. We ask a mechanistic question about that habit: is it produced by a small, findable group of components inside the model? We run one pipeline---mean ablation, activation patching, greedy circuit extraction, a random-control significance test, and activation steering---over 55 model-language settings spanning ten open code models (five base and five instruction-tuned), three target languages (Rust, C#, PHP), two prompt suites, and two component budgets. We report five findings.
