However, mapping channel measurements to the environment is a severely ill-posed problem: a measurement records only the structures that interact with the transmitted electromagnetic waves along its propagation paths, and even these observations can often be explained by multiple plausible scenes. We therefore formulate wireless scene reconstruction as posterior inference and develop a hierarchical framework with two complementary stages to approach this problem. A wireless foundation model, pretrained to respect propagation physics, transforms each channel measurement into a representation of the scene structure that shaped the observation. A diffusion model then jointly integrates representations from multiple measurements to model and sample the posterior over building occupancy, with consensus over samples producing the final reconstruction. We demonstrate that the framework can accurately recover building footprints from wireless channel measurements alone and show that its performance depends critically on both design components: physics-grounded representations expose scene-relevant information, while joint posterior inference coherently integrates complementary observations.

</details>


### [419] [Beyond Fixed Acquisition Functions: Temporal Difference Active Learning for Perturbation Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22122)
*Xudong Zhang,Jianzhe Li,Yitong Tang,Peijie Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TDAL：将预算受限的扰动发现建模为序贯决策问题，用时序差分学习在线学习采集函数，在八个公开筛选任务上平均排名1.63（11种方法中）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基因与药物扰动筛选成本高昂，只能测试有限候选。现有方法通常固定采集函数、仅用反馈更新代理模型，难以针对不同响应景观自适应调整选择策略；而实验反馈本身蕴含"如何选实验"的训练信号。

Method: 将预算受限扰动发现形式化为序贯决策问题；TDAL通过时序差分学习从单条筛选轨迹在线学习采集函数，兼顾当前命中与未来发现；以实验前后未测候选命中概率的Hellinger距离加权后继价值；并用leave-batch-out（LBO）复用已测结果构造虚拟转移，缓解训练数据稀缺。

Result: 在八个公开筛选数据集（单、双、三扰动，多种实验配置）上，TDAL在11种方法中平均排名1.63，并在四项任务上排名第一，显示其跨响应景观的自适应性。

Conclusion: 实验反馈可作为学习采集函数的有价值信号；基于TD学习、Hellinger加权的在线采集函数在预算受限扰动筛选中优于固定采集函数方法，且具备跨任务适应性。

Abstract: Genetic and drug perturbation screens are important tools for elucidating disease mechanisms and validating therapeutic targets, but experimental costs limit the number of candidates that can be tested. Existing perturbation screening methods typically update the surrogate model with feedback while keeping the acquisition function fixed, limiting their ability to adapt selection to different response landscapes. Experimental feedback reveals current hits and informs subsequent selection by updating candidate predictions, providing a training signal for learning how to select experiments. We formulate budgeted perturbation discovery as a sequential decision problem and propose Temporal Difference Active Learning (TDAL), which learns an acquisition function online through temporal difference learning from a single screening trajectory, accounting for current hits and future discoveries. TDAL uses the Hellinger distance between hit probabilities for unmeasured candidates before and after an experiment to weight successor value, and reuses measured outcomes through leave-batch-out (LBO) to construct virtual transitions and alleviate training data scarcity. Across eight public screens spanning single, double, and triple perturbations under varied experimental configurations, TDAL achieves an average rank of 1.63 among eleven methods and ranks first on four tasks, demonstrating its adaptability across response landscapes.

</details>


### [420] [Causal Integrated Gradients: Scalable Feature Attribution Along Causal Paths](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22126)
*Joran Michiels,Anis Ismail,Maarten De Vos,Alejandro Sifrim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出因果积分梯度(CIG)与因果期望梯度(CEG)，将因果图结构嵌入积分路径，从而高效、可扩展地进行考虑特征依赖的归因，并能分离直接效应与经因果后代的介导效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有考虑特征依赖的归因方法在高维下不可扩展；已有梯度方法无法利用已知因果结构，会把下游效应归给结果变量而非真正的上游原因（如把靶基因排在调控它的转录因子之上）。

Method: 关键思想是沿因果图路由积分路径，将因果结构嵌入到积分梯度框架中，并保持其计算效率和在因果图满足一定条件时的公理保证；该方法把每个特征的归因分解为直接效应与经因果后代介导的效应。CEG为其期望梯度版本。

Result: 三个递进真实度的实验中：(1) 已知因果模型的合成基准上，CIG 归因与 Pearl do-演算的真值因果效应最吻合，精度与 causal Shapley values 相当而计算成本低得多；(2) 已知基因调控网络的 Dyngen 单细胞模拟数据上，最准确恢复驱动模拟的转录因子；(3) 真实干扰素-β刺激数据（仅有近似因果图）上，对驱动响应的转录因子的排序优于 DeepSHAP 和积分梯度。

Conclusion: 将因果结构纳入基于梯度的归因可恢复现有方法遗漏的上游驱动因素，同时不牺牲可扩展性。

Abstract: Existing feature attribution methods that account for feature dependencies do not scale to high dimensions. We propose causal integrated gradients (CIG) and causal expected gradients (CEG), which extend integrated gradients to incorporate prior causal structure among input features while retaining its computational efficiency and, under conditions on the causal graph, its axiomatic guarantees. In many settings, some causal structure between features is already known, for example, that a transcription factor causally regulates a target gene's expression. Yet existing gradient-based methods cannot exploit this structure, instead crediting a feature's downstream effects over its true upstream cause, such as ranking the target gene above the transcription factor that regulates it. Our key idea is to embed this causal structure by routing the integration path along the causal graph. The method thereby decomposes each feature's attribution into a direct effect and effects mediated through its causal descendants. We evaluate CIG in three settings of increasing realism. First, on a synthetic benchmark with a known causal model, CIG's attributions best match the ground-truth causal effect from Pearl's do-calculus, matching the accuracy of causal Shapley values at a fraction of the computational cost. Second, on simulated single-cell gene expression data with a known gene regulatory network (Dyngen), CIG most accurately recovers the transcription factors driving the simulation. Third, on real interferon-$β$ stimulation data, where only an approximate causal graph is available, CIG better prioritizes the transcription factors driving the measured response than DeepSHAP and integrated gradients. Together, these results show that incorporating causal structure into gradient-based attributions recovers upstream drivers that existing methods miss, without sacrificing scalability.

</details>


### [421] [Specification Gaming and a Constrained Reinforcement Learning Mitigation in a Cleaning Gridworld](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22152)
*Hilda Adwubi Osei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在极简网格清洁机器人环境中构造可控的代理/真实目标差距，标准DQN完全陷入规范博弈（代理奖励接近最大、真实目标从不达成）；引入对利用行为的惩罚式约束强化学习方法，消除博弈行为并大幅恢复真实性能，并给出代理奖励、真实奖励与代价信号的精确核算恒等式，在硬约束变体下提供确定性保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关于规范博弈（specification gaming）的证据多为观察性的，缺少将"受控构造的代理/真实目标差距"与"具备可验证保证（而非仅经验提升）的缓解方法"配对展示的示范。作者希望建立这样一个最小可控案例，并对齐修复给出可证明的保证。

Method: 构造最小网格世界：清洁机器人可真正清除污渍，或将其从廉价传感器视野中隐藏。仅用传感器代理奖励训练标准深度Q网络（DQN），观察其收敛到的策略；随后提出约束强化学习修复，对智能体利用差距所依赖的具体行为施加代价惩罚（并给出硬约束变体）。理论上推导代理奖励、真实奖励与代价信号之间的精确核算恒等式。

Result: 标准DQN收敛到完全博弈代理奖励的策略：代理奖励接近最大，而真实目标从未达成。加入约束惩罚后，最终策略中的博弈行为被消除，真实目标性能显著恢复。实验验证了核算恒等式成立：代价信号精确度量代理/真实差距，而非仅仅与之相关；在硬约束变体下给出确定性保证。

Conclusion: 该工作以最小可控环境提供了规范博弈的清晰因果演示，并给出一种带可验证保证（精确核算恒等式+硬约束下的确定性保证）的缓解方案，弥补了该领域以观察性证据为主、缺乏保证性修复的不足。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning agents optimize exactly the reward signal they are given, which can diverge sharply from an intended true objective when that signal is only a proxy for it; this failure mode is known as specification gaming. Existing evidence for this failure mode is largely observational, with comparatively few demonstrations pairing a controlled, deliberately constructed proxy/true gap with a mitigation that carries a verifiable guarantee rather than only an empirical improvement. We construct a minimal gridworld in which a cleaning-robot agent can either genuinely remove dirt or conceal it from a cheap sensor, and show that a standard deep Q-network trained only on the sensor's proxy reward converges to a policy that games it completely, reaching near-maximal proxy reward while never achieving the true objective. We then introduce a constrained reinforcement learning fix, penalizing the specific behaviors through which the agent exploits the gap, and show that it eliminates the gaming behavior from the final policy while substantially recovering true-objective performance. We further derive and empirically verify an exact accounting identity relating the proxy reward, true reward, and our cost signal for this environment, showing that the cost signal measures the proxy/true gap exactly rather than merely tracking it, and yields a deterministic guarantee under a hard-constrained variant of the method.

</details>


### [422] [The importance of tensor handling and implementation of physics-informed DeepONets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22157)
*Nahum Banks,Gustavo A. M. de Almeida,Sergio Maldonado*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种改进的PI-DeepONet架构，通过消除Branch网络在配点上处理输入函数的冗余，在不改变数学等价性的前提下降低训练成本，使其可用于更高维问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINN通过引入控制方程减少对大规模标注数据的需求，PI-DeepONet进一步学习解算子以实现跨问题族快速预测；但将其用于高维问题时，训练计算成本过高，成为主要瓶颈。

Method: 改进PI-DeepONet架构：针对Branch网络在不同配点（collocation points）上重复处理同一输入函数的冗余，重构输入张量组织方式，减少输入张量规模与Branch网络调用次数；该形式与原架构数学等价。同时对两种架构进行计算复杂度分析，推导训练时间关于配点数量与输入函数数量的理论标度律。在1D、2D、3D线性对流问题上评估。

Result: 在所有案例中预测精度与原PI-DeepONet相当，训练时间持续下降；2D实验中最大加速3.75倍，实测训练时间标度与预测的关于配点和输入函数的线性依赖一致；3D模型在NVIDIA A100上仅改进架构可行，原架构超出显存限制。

Conclusion: PI-DeepONet的实现方式对其实际性能有显著影响，细致优化可带来可观收益，提升实用性并使原本难以处理的物理信息学习问题变得可行。

Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) reduce or eliminate the need for large labelled datasets by enforcing governing equations during training. Physics-informed Deep Operator Networks (PI-DeepONets) extend this approach to learning solution operators, enabling rapid prediction across families of problems. Despite these advantages, we show that their application to higher-dimensional problems remains limited by the computational cost of training. To address this issue, we propose a modified PI-DeepONet architecture that reduces this cost by removing redundancy in how the Branch network processes input functions across collocation points. The proposed formulation is mathematically equivalent to the original architecture but reduces input tensor sizes and the number of Branch network evaluations. We analyse the computational complexity of both architectures and derive theoretical scaling laws for training time with respect to the number of collocation points and input functions. The proposed architecture is evaluated on 1D, 2D, and 3D linear advection problems. In all cases, it achieves comparable predictive accuracy to the original PI-DeepONet while consistently reducing training time. In 2D experiments, a maximum speed-up of $3.75\times$ is observed, with empirical training-time scaling agreeing with the predicted linear dependence on collocation points and input functions. Furthermore, training a 3D model on an NVIDIA A100 GPU is only feasible using the proposed architecture, as the original formulation exceeds memory limits. These results demonstrate that careful consideration of how PI-DeepONets are implemented can yield substantial gains, enhancing the practical performance of PI-DeepONets and enabling their application to otherwise intractable physics-informed learning problems.

</details>


### [423] [LCT: Losslessly Compressed Tensors with GPU friendly execution for Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22179)
*Max Zhu,Bohang Sun,Pietro Lio,Jialin Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LCT 是一个面向训练中反复编码-解码场景的 GPU 无损张量压缩执行框架，利用浮点数据的自然冗余对权重、激活和优化器状态进行 Huffman 编码压缩，最高压缩比 1.455×，在 NanoGPT-162M 上以 7.2% 步时开销换取 24.6% 显存下降，在 Qwen3-4B 微调中节省 23.8% 峰值显存并支持 3.5× 更长上下文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无损张量压缩可降低训练显存占用，但训练过程要求张量被反复重新编码，传统压缩方案的编解码开销难以承受。因此需要一个专门针对"重复编码-解码"模式设计的 GPU 执行框架。

Method: 提出 Losslessly Compressed Tensors（LCT）框架：利用浮点数据的天然冗余，压缩权重、激活与优化器状态的存储；采用带预计算码本（precomputed codebooks）的 Huffman 编码，并以高度优化的 GPU kernel 实现，以降低压缩/解压开销；同时对 LCT 的存储代价及对数值幅值漂移（magnitude shifts）的自适应能力进行分析刻画。

Result: 最高达到 1.455× 压缩比；在 162M 参数的 NanoGPT 上，显存占用降低 24.6%，步时仅增加 7.2%；在 Qwen3-4B 微调中峰值显存节省最高 23.8%，同款 GPU 上可支持 3.5× 更长的训练上下文长度；并在训练与微调两种场景下得到验证。

Conclusion: LCT 表明无损浮点张量压缩在训练循环内是可行的：借助定制的 GPU Huffman 编解码与静态码本，可在较小的步时代价下显著降低显存占用，并直接转化为更长上下文或更大模型的可训练性。

Abstract: Lossless tensor compression could reduce memory usage during training, but training requires tensors to be repeatedly re-encoded. We introduce Losslessly Compressed Tensors (LCT), a GPU execution framework designed for this repeated encode-decode regime. LCT exploits the natural redundancy in floating point data to reduce storage for weights, activations and optimizer states. Highly optimized GPU kernels implement Huffman coding with precomputed codebooks for low compression and decompression overhead, essential for training. Our analysis characterizes LCT's storage costs and adaptation to magnitude shifts. LCT achieves a compression ratio of up to $1.455\times$, and is demonstrated in training and finetuning settings. On a 162M-parameter NanoGPT, LCT reduces memory usage by $24.6\%$ for a $7.2\%$ step-time increase. In Qwen3-4B fine-tuning, LCT saves up to $23.8\%$ of peak memory, enabling a $3.5\times$ larger context length in training on the same GPU.

</details>


### [424] [OS-Helix: Unifying GUI Interaction and Code Execution in Native Computer-Using Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22234)
*Bowen Yang,Kaiming Jin,Zichen Ding,Zhenyu Wu,Zehao Li,Zhoumianze Liu,Kanzhi Cheng,Fangzhi Xu,Yanan Sun,Qiushi Sun,Yu Qiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OS-Helix 是一个端到端训练的多模态电脑操作智能体，将 GUI 操作与代码执行统一到同一动作空间，并通过混合数据 SFT 冷启动 + 在线强化学习（Step-balanced GSPO）实现 GUI/代码协调能力的内化，在 OSWorld-Verified 上达到 66.44% 成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实桌面自动化既非纯视觉也非纯编程：智能体需理解用户界面，同时高效操作文件、脚本与系统状态。然而原生 GUI/代码协调无法通过提示级工具组合获得——初步实验显示，朴素地加入代码工具反而会削弱 GUI 智能体，说明 GUI/代码路由必须通过高质量混合数据训练来内化。

Method: 1）提出 OS-Helix，端到端训练的多模态电脑使用智能体，统一 GUI 动作与代码执行于单一动作空间；2）构建监督数据：应用—产物组合（将桌面应用与真实文件产物配对，实例化可执行的 Ubuntu 状态）+ 解耦的指令/评估器生成流水线，产出环境接地、且与解法模态无关的可验证终态任务；3）用过滤后的混合数据 SFT 冷启动策略，再在真实桌面环境中在线 RL 优化；4）提出 Step-balanced GSPO，按动作步而非原始 assistant token 聚合重要性权重，防止长代码动作在异构动作优化中占据主导。

Result: 在 OSWorld-Verified 上，OS-Helix-27B 与 OS-Helix-35B-A3B 相对匹配的 Qwen3.5 混合基线分别提升 35.0% 和 33.7%；OS-Helix-27B-RL 进一步提升 42.9%，成功率达 66.44%。消融实验支持三方面贡献：学习到的 GUI/代码协调、可扩展的可验证监督、动作步平衡优化；并在 WindowsAgentArena 上展示了跨平台迁移能力。

Conclusion: GUI/代码协调应作为模型内在能力通过混合数据训练获得，而非依赖提示级工具拼接；可验证的环境接地监督与动作步级别的优化平衡是端到端桌面智能体有效性的关键，且该范式具备跨平台泛化潜力。

Abstract: Real desktop automation is neither purely visual nor purely programmatic. Agents must understand user-facing interfaces while efficiently manipulating files, scripts, and system state. However, native GUI/code coordination cannot be obtained by prompt-level tool composition. In our preliminary experiments, naively adding a code tool degrades a GUI agent, revealing that GUI/code routing must be internalized through training on high-quality hybrid data. We present OS-Helix, an end-to-end trained multimodal computer-using agent that unifies GUI actions and code execution in one action space. To construct the required supervision, we introduce application-artifact composition, pairing desktop applications with authentic file artifacts to instantiate executable Ubuntu states, and a decoupled instruction/evaluator generation pipeline that produces environment-grounded tasks whose final states can be verified regardless of the solution modality. We cold-start the policy with SFT on filtered hybrid data and further improve it through online RL in live desktop environments. For RL, we propose Step-balanced GSPO, which aggregates importance weight by action step rather than raw assistant tokens to prevent long code actions from dominating heterogeneous-action optimization. On OSWorld-Verified, OS-Helix-27B and OS-Helix-35B-A3B achieve relative improvements of 35.0% and 33.7% over their matched Qwen3.5 hybrid baselines, while OS-Helix-27B-RL further improves by 42.9% to reach 66.44% success. Ablations provide evidence consistent with contributions from learned GUI/code coordination, scalable verifiable supervision, and action step balanced optimization, while demonstrating cross-platform transfer on WindowsAgentArena. Our project homepage is at https://os-copilot.github.io/OS-Helix/.

</details>


### [425] [Generalization Guarantees of Randomized Block Coordinate Descent for Nonconvex Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22213)
*Ruixi Hu,Liang Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为带非凸目标的随机块坐标下降（RBCD）建立了高概率泛化保证，涵盖一般非凸、梯度主导及特定结构损失三种设定，并通过调参刻画早停对总体梯度最优收敛率的作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RBCD的理论分析主要从优化角度关注收敛性，而其在非凸问题下的泛化行为理解不足，缺乏高概率的泛化界刻画。

Method: 在仅需标准光滑性假设下，推导经验风险与总体风险梯度的界；采用多项式衰减步长并调节迭代次数以平衡优化与泛化；在梯度主导设定下给出基于函数次优性的界；针对特定结构损失函数发展维度无关的界。

Result: 一般非凸设定下得到经验与总体风险梯度的界，并量化早停带来的总体梯度最优收敛率；梯度主导设定下的界在凸与低噪声情形下近乎匹配乐观率；对特定结构损失获得维度无关界，使泛化保证适用于高维问题。

Conclusion: RBCD在非凸目标下具备高概率泛化保证，早停可在优化与泛化间取得平衡，且所得结果可推广至高维问题。

Abstract: Randomized block coordinate descent (RBCD) is a popular optimization algorithm for many large-scale machine learning problems. The existing theoretical analysis of RBCD mainly focuses on its convergence behavior from an optimization perspective, while its generalization behavior remains less understood for nonconvex problems. In this paper, we establish high-probability generalization guarantees for RBCD with nonconvex objectives. In the general nonconvex setting, we derive bounds on the gradients of both empirical and population risks, requiring only standard smoothness assumptions. With polynomially decaying step sizes, we tune the iteration number to balance optimization and generalization, thereby quantifying how early stopping leads to the optimal convergence rate for the population gradients. In the gradient-dominated setting, we provide bounds in terms of functional suboptimality, which nearly match the optimistic rates in convex and low-noise settings. Finally, we develop dimension-independent bounds for loss functions of a specific structure, making the generalization guarantees applicable to high-dimensional problems.

</details>


### [426] [Training-Free On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22236)
*Bangji Yang,Jiajun Fan,Zhaoyu Zhu,Hongbo Ma,Ge Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的on-policy蒸馏方法：在专家共享基座的前提下，仅用前向传播即得到逐层精确最小二乘解，把多个专家能力融合进一个学生模型，效果平均优于任一专家。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有on-policy蒸馏需为每个教师付出rollout、教师前向与梯度步骤的代价来把专家整合为学生，开销大；作者希望说明能力整合并不一定需要训练。

Method: 当专家共享同一基座时，给出精确的逐层解：融合模型的每个线性层须在该专家按自身答案所接收的输入上复现该专家输出，构成最小二乘问题，仅依赖这些输入的二阶矩；只需对数百条rollout做一次前向即可估计这些二阶矩。方法称为training-free on-policy distillation。

Result: rollout内容比求解器更关键：数学专家rollout中因重复循环而截断的答案条数少但token占比高，剔除后融合模型在AIME25上从任务算术水平提升到与专家相当（同精度）。在Olmo 3 7B上，每专家数GPU小时前向计算得到的通用模型在七个数学与代码基准上保留了各专家大部分增益。

Conclusion: 专家能力的聚合可退化为一个仅需前向的最小二乘问题，训练并非必要；数据（rollout）质量尤其是重复截断样本的清理对融合效果影响显著。

Abstract: On-policy distillation consolidates specialist models into one student at the price of rollouts, teacher passes and gradient steps for every teacher. We show that the consolidation does not need training: with forward passes only, the capabilities of separately tuned specialists can be aggregated into one model that is, on average, more accurate than either specialist alone. When specialists share a base model, distillation has an exact layer-wise solution: each linear layer of the fused model must reproduce every specialist's output on the inputs that specialist receives while reading its own answers, a least-squares problem whose solution needs only the second moments of those inputs. One forward pass over a few hundred rollouts provides them. We call this training-free on-policy distillation (\method). What the rollouts contain matters more than the solver: answers truncated in repetition loops are few among a mathematics specialist's rollouts but carry a large share of their tokens, and removing them lifts the fused model on AIME25 from task arithmetic's level to the specialist's at matched precision. On Olmo~3 7B, a few GPU-hours of forward computation per specialist yield a generalist that keeps most of each specialist's gain on each of seven mathematics and code benchmarks.

</details>


### [427] [Query-Efficient Rejection Sampling for Parallel Masked Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22238)
*Shiyuan Zhang,Xuheng Li,Qiwei Di,Quanquan Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Single-Increment Rejection Sampler (SIRS)，用单次随机采样的"增量"估计对数接受概率（仅需一次查询），并借助 Bernoulli factory 将泊松数量的截断估计转化为接受/拒绝决策，同时通过 Rao-Blackwellization 在无额外开销下降低截断率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码扩散模型（MDM）并行解掩多个 token 可加速生成，但独立采样忽略了 token 间相关性导致输出有偏。Anari et al. (2026) 用拒绝采样纠正该偏差，将对数接受概率分解为 token 级项之和，但需对每个解掩 token 各做一次 score 查询，开销过大。

Method: 1) SIRS 以一次查询、一个随机采样的增量来估计对数接受概率；2) 将泊松数量的截断估计经改编自 Chen et al. (2026) 的 Bernoulli factory 转为接受/拒绝判定；3) 由于每次查询返回块内所有剩余 token 的条件分布，对每个增量按这些 token 做 Rao-Blackwell 平均，无额外成本地减小截断。

Result: 证明了数据分布与 SIRS 输出之间的 KL 散度被一个截断项加模型训练误差所界定；在精确 score 下，并行解码需付出完整的块内依赖代价，而 SIRS 仅付出超出截断范围的那部分。

Conclusion: SIRS 以单次查询成本实现了有偏并行解码的偏差修正，并给出 KL 散度上界，表明其代价仅与超出截断范围的块内依赖相关，优于朴素并行解码的完整块内依赖代价。

Abstract: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) accelerate generation by unmasking multiple tokens in parallel, but sampling these tokens independently ignores their correlations and biases the output. Anari et al. (2026) corrected this bias with rejection sampling, decomposing the log acceptance probability into a sum of token-level terms, but the evaluation requires one score query per unmasked token. We propose the Single-Increment Rejection Sampler (SIRS), which provides an estimate of the log acceptance probability from a single randomly sampled increment at the cost of one query. SIRS then converts a Poisson number of clipped estimates into accept/reject decisions through a Bernoulli factory adapted from Chen et al. (2026). Since each query returns the conditionals of all remaining tokens in the block, we further Rao-Blackwellize each increment by averaging over these tokens at no extra cost, thereby reducing clipping. We show that the KL-divergence between the data distribution and the SIRS output is bounded by a clipping term plus the model's training error. With exact scores, parallel decoding pays the full within-block dependence, whereas SIRS pays only the part beyond the clipping range.

</details>


### [428] [Explore Once, Evaluate Many: Multiple Policy Evaluation for Stochastic Linear Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22252)
*Spyros Dragazis,Yilei Chen,Aldo Pacchiano*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PRISMA算法，在随机上下文线性bandit中同时评估K个目标策略，以O~((L²S²+β²)(1∨ρ*)/ε²·logK)的样本量达到ε精度，无需特征二阶矩下界且与空间基数无关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有策略评估方法多为单策略设计，面向多策略同时评估时样本效率低；且常见保证依赖特征二阶矩的数值下界或上下文/动作空间基数，限制了适用性。作者希望以共享采样设计与共享估计器实现K个策略的高效联合评估。

Method: PRISMA由三部分组成：(1) 无奖励规划（reward-free planning），在与奖励无关的访问下构造共享的规划上下文；(2) 正则化采样设计，学习一个对所有目标策略通用的采样分布，其难度由实例相关量ρ*≤d刻画；(3) 单一岭回归估计器在全部K个目标策略间共享。另采用自适应倍增过程，在未知ρ*时选择正则化尺度。策略查询成本单独核算，每个共享规划上下文需K次查询。

Result: 在概率至少1−δ下，以ε精度估计每个目标策略值，所需上下文抽取与奖励观测数为O~((L²S²+β²)(1∨ρ*)/ε²·logK)，隐藏因子为K、d、1/δ的对数项；其中L、S、β分别约束特征范数、奖励参数范数与噪声。保证不要求二阶矩特征值有数值下界，也不显式依赖上下文与动作空间基数。

Conclusion: 通过奖励无关规划+正则化共享采样+单一共享岭回归估计器，可实现多目标策略的样本高效同时评估，复杂度仅对K呈对数依赖，且对问题实例的刻画更细（ρ*），适用性更强。

Abstract: We study how to evaluate $K$ target policies simultaneously in stochastic contextual bandits with linear reward structure. Given a known $d$-dimensional feature map and reward-free access to policy queries, we propose PRISMA (Policy evaluation through Regularized Information Sharing and Mixture Allocation), an algorithm that estimates every target policy's value to accuracy $\varepsilon$ with probability at least $1-δ$. The algorithm uses $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\!\left( \frac{(L^2S^2+β^2)(1\veeρ^\star)}{\varepsilon^2} \cdot \log(K) \right)$ context draws and reward observations, where $ρ^\star\le d$ is an instance-dependent measure of the difficulty of designing a shared sampling distribution. Here, $L$, $S$, and $β$ bound the feature norm, reward parameter norm, and reward noise, respectively, and the suppressed factors are logarithmic in $K$, $d$, and $1/δ$. Our method combines reward-free planning, a regularized sampling design, and a single ridge regression estimator shared across all target policies. An adaptive doubling procedure selects the regularization scale without knowledge of $ρ^\star$. The guarantees require no numerical lower bound on second-moment eigenvalues and have no explicit dependence on the cardinalities of the context and action spaces. Policy-query costs are accounted for separately, with $K$ queries per shared planning context.

</details>


### [429] [BitSparse: Compact Activation Storage for ReLU Feed-Forward Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22256)
*Max Zhu,Bohang Sun,Pietro Lio,Jialin Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BitSparse 是一种 GPU 驻留的无损压缩格式，用于稀疏激活缓存，通过融合到 autograd 函数的 Triton 内核完成压缩与精确重建，在 Modded-NanoGPT 与 Nemotron-H 上分别降低每 token 显存 31% 和 30%，开销不超过 1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 训练显存瓶颈：激活检查点靠重计算省显存，有损压缩会改变存储的激活值。而稀疏 ReLU/ReLU² 激活的回归提供了新机会——对激活缓存本身做无损压缩。

Method: 提出 BitSparse：面向稀疏激活的 GPU 驻留无损压缩格式；压缩与重建由自定义 Triton 内核实现并融合进 autograd 函数，在前向时压缩缓存、反向时精确还原；支持 BF16 与 FP8；可选符号位打包进一步提升压缩率至接近理论上限。另设计预分配缓冲区系统，避免变长张量分配时的主机同步。

Result: 分析了压缩比并与理论最优值对比；Modded-NanoGPT 和 Nemotron-H 上每 token 显存分别下降 31% 与 30%，在实际序列长度下额外开销不超过 1%。

Conclusion: 稀疏激活缓存的无损压缩是降低训练显存的第三条可行路径，BitSparse 在几乎零开销下显著节省显存，并配以预分配缓冲机制消除主机同步。

Abstract: Reducing memory use in large language model (LLM) training is an ongoing challenge. Activation checkpointing saves memory by recomputation, while lossy compression changes the stored activations. The reemergence of sparse $\relu$ and $\relu^2$ activations creates a third opportunity: losslessly compressing the activation cache itself. We present BitSparse, a GPU-resident lossless compression format for sparse activations. Compression and reconstruction run in custom Triton kernels fused into an autograd function, shrinking the activation cache while recovering it exactly for the backward pass. Bfloat16 (BF16) and FP8 activations are supported. Optional sign-bit packing further increases compression up to close to the theoretical limit. We analyze its compression ratio and compare it to the theoretical optimum. BitSparse lowers per-token VRAM by 31\% and 30\% Modded-NanoGPT and Nemotron-H respectively, with overheads of no more than 1\% at practical sequence lengths. Additionally, a new preallocated buffer system avoids host synchronization during training when variable size tensors are allocated.

</details>


### [430] [Topology-Inspired Fine-Tuning for Wind-Field Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22262)
*Arjun Dadhwal,Brian Summa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出科学超分辨率模型的逐点重建损失与拓扑结构评价之间存在张力，提出用可微的拓扑启发辅助损失（梯度幅值+固定持久点对监督）微调预训练CNN，在PD与MT距离上同时且一致地改善风场超分结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学超分通常以逐点重建损失优化，但科学解释往往依赖极值、连通区域和多尺度标量结构；实验显示逐点指标与不同拓扑距离（bottleneck PD、W2 PD、merge-tree）对CNN与GAN的偏好相互矛盾，甚至同一拓扑描述子上的不同距离也奖励不同性质，因此需要明确这一张力并设计能兼顾结构保真的训练目标。

Method: 以预训练CNN与GAN风场超分模型为对象，用逐点指标、bottleneck PD距离、merge-tree距离以及order-2 Wasserstein PD距离做对比刻画；随后对预训练CNN施加可微的拓扑启发辅助损失：标量风速、梯度幅值、软高速水平集、局部极大值，以及借助Topology ToolKit离线定位的真值持久对端点上的固定对监督。共研究16种微调配置，每种均与仅使用原重建损失的匹配标准微调对照，在固定168场基准上评估（拓扑在每场固定的160×160子区域上计算），最终目标融合梯度监督与固定对监督两种信号。

Result: 在标量场损失中，梯度监督带来最大的PD改善但不改善平均MT距离；固定对监督在PD与MT上给出最大且最一致的联合改善。最终组合目标相对预训练CNN将平均bottleneck、W2,∞、W2,2距离分别降低31%、25%、27%（相对对照降低32–35%，而对照本身使三者全部变差），在168场中的150场上三者同时下降，并提升1.30 dB PSNR（约为标准微调增益的一半）；平均MT距离亦有改善，但仅在其中91场上体现。

Conclusion: 逐点重建指标与拓扑描述子（乃至同一描述子的不同距离）评价的性质并不一致，标准微调甚至会损害拓扑保真；将梯度监督与真值持久对监督相结合，可在几乎不牺牲重建质量的前提下显著且一致地提升持久图距离，并部分改善merge-tree距离。PD与MT仅在91/150场上共同改善，说明二者捕获互补的标量结构，科学超分评估应同时报告多类拓扑指标。

Abstract: Scientific super-resolution (SR) models are typically optimized with pointwise reconstruction losses, yet scientific interpretation often hinges on extrema, connected regions, and multiscale scalar structure. We characterize this tension with pretrained CNN and GAN wind-field SR models. Pointwise metrics, bottleneck persistence-diagram (PD) distance, and merge-tree (MT) distance favor the CNN, whereas order-2 Wasserstein PD distances favor the sharper GAN, so even different distances on the same topological descriptor reward different properties. Motivated by this disagreement, we fine-tune the pretrained CNN with differentiable topology-inspired auxiliary losses on scalar speed, gradient magnitude, soft high-speed level sets, and local maxima, and with fixed-pair supervision, which constrains predicted values and persistence at ground-truth persistence-pair endpoints located offline with the Topology ToolKit. A loss study of 16 fine-tuning configurations, each compared with a matched standard fine-tuning control that uses only the original reconstruction loss, on a fixed 168-field benchmark (with topology evaluated on a fixed 160 by 160 subregion of each field), shows that, among the scalar-field losses, gradient supervision provides the strongest PD improvement but does not improve mean MT distance, whereas fixed-pair supervision gives the largest and most consistent joint improvement in PD and MT distances. The final objective combines these two signals. Relative to the pretrained CNN, it lowers mean bottleneck, $W_{2,\infty}$, and $W_{2,2}$ distances by 31%, 25%, and 27% (and by 32-35% relative to the control, which on its own worsens all three), lowers all three on 150 of 168 fields, and gains 1.30 dB PSNR, about half the gain of standard fine-tuning. Mean MT distance also improves, but on only 91 of those 150 fields, indicating that PD and MT capture complementary structure.

</details>


### [431] [Baselines and Score Centering in Policy Gradient Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22263)
*Shuo Han,Ziqing Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文从协方差视角重新审视正则化重要性采样下的策略梯度估计，指出奖励常数漂移不变性由奖励与重要性加权得分的协方差恢复，并厘清组均值基线与得分中心化在序列级/词元级重要性采样中的不同作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型后训练中强化学习常为离策略（训练-推理不匹配、异步训练策略陈旧），实践中重要性比率被截断、掩码或裁剪正则化，导致重要性加权策略梯度对奖励的常数平移不再不变，需要寻找恢复该不变性的正确估计量。

Method: 以奖励与重要性加权得分之间的协方差作为估计目标；分别在序列级与词元级重要性采样下推导该协方差视角，并据此分析组均值基线与得分中心化两种中心化操作（样本均值 vs 总体均值）所对应的不同无偏协方差估计量及其方差。

Result: 协方差视角揭示了组均值基线与得分中心化的作用与差异：二者均为协方差估计中的中心化，但减去的是样本均值与总体均值，因而给出方差不同的无偏估计量；是否应同时使用取决于重要性采样的层级——序列级下使用组均值基线后得分中心化无额外收益，词元级下在比率被正则化时仅用组均值基线而不做得分中心化一般会引入偏差。

Conclusion: 正则化重要性采样下应以协方差作为策略梯度的估计目标以恢复奖励平移不变性；基线使用需与重要性采样层级匹配，避免不必要的中心化或引入偏差。该文为技术性注记，给出理论分析而非实验结论。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a widely used approach to post-training large language models. In a typical implementation, learning is off-policy: The policy generating the responses differs from the policy being trained because of training-inference mismatch or policy staleness in asynchronous training. This discrepancy is commonly addressed by importance sampling, whose ratio is usually regularized in practice through truncation, masking, or clipping. Under regularized importance sampling, the importance-weighted policy gradient is no longer invariant to constant shifts in the reward. This invariance is recovered by using the covariance between the reward and the importance-weighted score as the estimand, which coincides with the policy gradient when the ratio is not regularized. This note develops this covariance perspective for both sequence-level and token-level importance sampling. The covariance perspective reveals the roles of the group-mean baseline and score centering in policy gradient estimation. Both perform centering in covariance estimation, but they differ in the mean being subtracted: The group-mean baseline uses a sample mean, whereas score centering uses a population mean. The two lead to distinct unbiased covariance estimators with different variances. Whether both forms of centering should be used simultaneously depends on whether importance sampling is applied at the sequence level or at the token level. With sequence-level importance sampling, score centering adds no benefit once the group-mean baseline is used; with token-level importance sampling, using the group-mean baseline without score centering generally introduces bias when the importance ratio is regularized.

</details>


### [432] [Librarian Agents: Training LLMs to Curate Long-Context Workspaces that Anticipate Future Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22273)
*Anikait Singh,Teresa Zhang,Yoonho Lee,Roshen Sanjay Nair,Aviral Kumar,Chelsea Finn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Librarian Agents 框架，用强化学习训练建造者智能体，在推理前主动把原始文档重组为可复用的分层文件系统工作区，从而提升长文档与跨文档推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 在长文档上下文中推理仍困难。标准检索是"反应式"的，在推理时才按需检索，对复杂跨文档推理形成瓶颈；预计算结构（如知识图谱）依赖刚性启发式规则而效果有限。作者观察到现代智能体框架中的一种不对称性：智能体能导航已有文件系统解决即时任务，却很少被训练去构建可供未来复用的工作区。因此希望让智能体具备"前瞻性定向整理"能力。

Method: 将工作区构建形式化为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），由 builder agent 把原始文档转化为由合成文件与引用链接构成的分层文件系统，形成面向下游回答智能体的定制工作区；通过强化学习优化 builder 策略，直接以下游回答准确率作为奖励信号。

Result: 在 BrowseComp-Plus 上比最强检索与预计算基线高 33 个百分点；前期构建成本可在重复查询间摊销；在 BRIGHT 上对未见领域零样本泛化，平均准确率提升 31 个百分点。

Conclusion: 将"推理前的主动语料整理"作为可学习能力，通过 RL 端到端对齐下游任务，是一种优于反应式检索与启发式预计算的长文档推理范式，且具备成本摊销与跨域泛化优势。

Abstract: Reasoning over long document contexts remains a challenge for large language models (LLMs). Standard retrieval methods are inherently reactive, bottlenecking agents with complex, cross-document reasoning at inference time, while precomputed structures like knowledge graphs often fall short because they rely on rigid heuristics. Instead, can we allow agents to perform anticipatory directed curation: learning to proactively reorganize unstructured corpora prior to inference to efficiently serve diverse future queries. We build on a key asymmetry in modern agentic harnesses (e.g., Claude Code): while LLM agents are adept at navigating existing filesystems to solve an immediate task, they are rarely trained to construct reusable workspaces for future use. To instantiate this capability, we introduce Librarian Agents, a framework in which a builder agent transforms raw documents into a hierarchical filesystem of synthetic files and reference links, which forms a workspace tailored for a downstream answering agent. We formulate workspace construction as a Markov decision process and optimize the builder policy via reinforcement learning to directly maximize downstream answering accuracy. Empirically, Librarian Agents outperforms the strongest retrieval and precomputation baselines by 33 percentage points on BrowseComp-Plus, amortizes upfront construction costs across repeated queries, and generalizes zero-shot to unseen domains on BRIGHT with a 31-point average accuracy improvement.

</details>


### [433] [Learning Rational Strategies for Temporal Objectives in Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22287)
*Omar Adalat,Edwin Hamel-De le Court,Francesco Belardinelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究未知动态随机多智能体系统的理性综合，将各智能体的PLTL_f时序目标转化为奖励自动机，在MARL框架下学习均衡解并给出收敛与置信保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体随机系统中，各智能体拥有独立的概率时序目标，且系统动态未知；需要同时保证目标满足与策略剖面的稳定性（如Nash均衡、子博弈完美均衡），而现有方法通常假定已知模型或仅考虑单一目标。

Method: 以PLTL_f刻画每个智能体的概率时序目标，用满足概率导出收益；将各智能体目标自动编译为奖励自动机，在无模型MARL环境中采用表格型Nash-Q学习求解理性综合问题（寻找满足指定智能体概率时序约束且构成所选解概念下稳定解的策略剖面）；给出条件收敛保证，用有限样本同时置信界验证满足性，并通过近似最佳响应检查评估策略稳定性。

Result: 提供表格型Nash-Q学习的条件收敛性保证，能够以有限样本同时置信界认证目标满足，并以近似最佳响应检验策略稳定性；在8个一般和并发随机博弈上进行实证验证。

Conclusion: 所提方法可在未知动态的随机多智能体环境中，以无模型方式实现概率时序目标的理性综合，兼顾目标满足与策略稳定性，并具备理论保证与实验支持。

Abstract: We study rational synthesis for stochastic multi-agent systems with unknown dynamics, where each agent is equipped with its own probabilistic temporal objective specified using Probabilistic Linear Temporal Logic on Finite Traces ($\mathsf{PLTL}_f}$). We impose solution concepts (e.g., Nash equilibrium, subgame-perfect equilibrium) as constraints on the joint strategy profile, using payoffs derived from each agent's probability of satisfying its temporal objective. In particular, we formulate per-agent rational synthesis as finding a strategy profile -- if one exists -- such that (i) the designated agent's probabilistic temporal constraint is satisfied, and (ii) the profile represents a stable solution under a chosen solution concept. We give conditional convergence guarantees for tabular Nash-Q learning, certify satisfaction with simultaneous finite-sample confidence bounds, and assess strategic stability with approximate best-response checking. Our approach operates in a stochastic \emph{Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning} (MARL) environment, where model-free learning algorithms attempt to attain extremal satisfaction probabilities for temporal objectives automatically compiled into reward automata. Our approach is empirically validated using 8 general-sum concurrent stochastic games.

</details>


### [434] [CAT-alyzing Honesty: Continuous Adversarial Training for Transferable LLM Honesty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22292)
*Yuan-Chen Chang,Niklas Herbster,Gauthier Gidel,Tommaso Tosato*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 CATCH（Continuous Adversarial Training for Consistent Honesty），借鉴"鲁棒拒答有害查询"的对抗训练思路，让模型在训练中靠近诚实回答、远离不诚实回答并保持能力，用仅数百条自报告场景数据即可获得可泛化、可迁移的诚实行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 应用于对诚实性要求高的场景，但即便经过对齐训练，仍会出现与知识矛盾或缺乏上下文支撑的不诚实输出，需一种稳健且不损害通用能力的诚实性训练方法。

Method: 连续对抗训练：对每条样本同时构造诚实回答（吸引）与不诚实回答（排斥）目标，并将源自自报告（self-reporting）场景的数百条目标用于训练；引入一种新颖的效用数据（utility data）选择以保护通用能力。在 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 与 Qwen3-3.6-27B 两种架构上评测，并在 MASK、Among Us 多智能体博弈、AuditBench 等不同基准上检验泛化与迁移。

Result: 仅用数百条自报告场景目标训练，即学到可稳健泛化并跨基准迁移的诚实行为：在 MASK 上持续降低压力下的不诚实；在 Among Us 中提升"坦白"率；在 AuditBench 中提升模型隐藏行为的发现率。CATCH 优于 prompting 与监督微调，与 SOTA 诚实性激活引导（activation steering）持平，但因新颖的效用数据选择在保持效用上超过激活引导。

Conclusion: 对抗式"趋近诚实、远离不诚实"的训练范式能以极低数据成本获得一致且可迁移的诚实性，并可在不牺牲通用效用的情况下优于提示与 SFT、在效用上优于诚实性激活引导。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming prevalent in scenarios where honesty is critical. However, despite alignment training, these models still exhibit dishonest behaviour, such as outputting claims that contradict some knowledge or are not supported by what is accessible in context. We introduce Continuous Adversarial Training for Consistent Honesty (CATCH), inspired by a method originally developed to robustly refuse harmful queries. CATCH trains the model towards an honest answer and away from a dishonest one while maintaining the model's capabilities. We evaluate two architectures (Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and Qwen3-3.6-27B). We show that trained with only hundreds of targets built from self-reporting scenarios, CATCH learns an honest behaviour that robustly generalizes and transfers across distinct benchmarks. It consistently reduces dishonesty under pressure on MASK, increases confessions in the multi-agent game of Among Us, and improves the discovery rates of the model's hidden behaviours in AuditBench. We show that CATCH outperforms prompting and supervised fine-tuning in improving honesty, and it is on par with state-of-the-art honesty activation steering. However, CATCH surpasses honesty steering in maintaining utility, thanks to a novel choice of utility data.

</details>


### [435] [Towards Continual Learning: Mitigating Forgetting With Subspace Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22293)
*Arnav Chavan,Kusha Sareen,Rishabh Tiwari,Abhranil Chandra,Johan Obando-Ceron,Kurt Keutzer,Scott Niekum,Inderjit S Dhillon,Devvrit Khatri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出子空间微调（SST），将每步权重更新限制在权重矩阵的底部奇异子空间，从而在保持目标任务性能的同时大幅缓解灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM经微调获取新技能时会破坏已有能力（灾难性遗忘）。已有工作表明遗忘与微调更新权重的幅度及方向有关：on-policy方法（RL、on-policy蒸馏）避免更新权重矩阵的主奇异方向因而遗忘更少，而SFT将更新集中沿主方向，易发生灾难性遗忘。作者希望显式消除主方向上的更新。

Method: 提出Subspace Tuning（SST）：将每个权重更新约束在底部奇异子空间，消除沿主奇异方向的变化。SST与优化器无关，可与SFT、自蒸馏等微调配方组合；其核心机制包括紧致子空间保护、稠密梯度估计与简单的刷新机制，使其学习能力强于既有正交微调方法；最多可保护99%的权重子空间。

Result: 保护高达99%的权重子空间时，记忆保持显著提升且目标任务性能依然强劲；该效果随模型与数据规模增大而增强，在large-model情形下几乎消除遗忘；SST使模型更接近基座分布，KL漂移比基线配方低2–4倍。

Conclusion: SST推进了学习—遗忘的帕累托前沿，可作为预训练语言模型微调的实用默认方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) acquire new skills through fine-tuning, but it can destroy capabilities they already have: catastrophic forgetting remains a central obstacle to continual learning in LLMs. Recent works connect forgetting to how far, and along which directions, fine-tuning moves the weights. On-policy methods such as reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation avoid updating the principal singular directions of weight matrices and thus forget less. In contrast, SFT concentrates updates along these directions and is susceptible to catastrophic forgetting. In this work, we introduce Subspace Tuning (SST), which restricts each weight update to the bottom singular subspace, eliminating changes along the principal directions. SST is optimizer-agnostic and composes well with fine-tuning recipes including SFT and self-distillation. SST combines tight subspace protection, dense gradient estimation, and a simple refresh mechanism, enabling stronger learning than prior orthogonal fine-tuning methods. With these mechanisms, protecting as much as 99\% of the weight subspace substantially improves retention while preserving strong target-task performance. This behavior strengthens with model and data size and nearly eliminates forgetting in the large-model regime. SST also keeps the model close to its base distribution, inducing $2$--$4\times$ less KL drift than the baseline recipes. Overall, SST advances the learning--forgetting Pareto frontier, making it a practical default for fine-tuning pre-trained language models.

</details>


### [436] [Learning to Steer LLM Agents and Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22316)
*Leyang Shen,Yaxin Gong,Yang Zhang,Chenxiao Fan,Jiakai Wang,Dong Wang,Yang Liu,Fuli Feng,Chun Kai Ling,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"steering agent"（监督智能体），在LLM智能体与多智能体系统执行过程中实时监控，当出现"目标漂移"时及时干预使其回归正轨。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的智能体与多智能体系统在长程工具调用与协作中容易随执行推进偏离总体目标（目标漂移），浪费执行资源并导致不良结果，需要一种在线监督机制。

Method: steering agent观测执行上下文，通过"低成本快速路径"决定何时干预、通过"高成本慢速路径"决定如何干预；为获得漂移评估与有效干预能力，将两条路径联合训练，采用强化学习，结合成对排序目标与GRPO（分组相对策略优化）。

Result: 在信息检索类搜索任务上，steering agent对单智能体与多智能体系统均提供有效监督，提升性能与效率；所学监督能力可泛化到域外任务、迁移到未见执行者，并支持无需重训练的可控干预频率。

Conclusion: 在线监督式steering agent是缓解目标漂移、提升长程工具使用与多智能体协作可靠性与效率的有效方案，且具备良好的泛化性与可迁移性。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents and multi-agent systems increasingly tackle complex tasks through long-horizon tool use and inter-agent collaboration. However, these systems are prone to deviating from the overall goal as execution unfolds, which wastes execution resources and leads to undesired outcomes, a failure termed goal drift. In this work, we propose a steering agent that supervises execution on the fly and steers the system back on track when drift occurs. The steering agent observes the execution context, deciding when to intervene with a low-cost fast path and how to intervene with a high-cost slow path. To unlock its steering intelligence, the ability to assess goal drift and generate effective interventions, we jointly train the two paths with reinforcement learning, combining a pairwise ranking objective with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). Experiments on information-seeking search tasks show that the steering agent provides effective supervision for both single-agent and multi-agent systems, improving their performance and efficiency. The learned steering intelligence generalizes to out-of-domain tasks, transfers to unseen executors, and supports controllable intervention frequency without retraining.

</details>


### [437] [Twice Upon a Time: Complementary Representations for Time-Series Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22327)
*Hedi Zisling,Liran Nochumsohn,Ilan Naiman,Mihir Parmar,Omri Azencot*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"互补表征"设计原则：将折线图（保留绝对测量与坐标框架）与归一化延迟嵌入（消除幅度缩放与偏移、凸显时序结构）作为两个视觉视图，经专门视觉编码器与多层次特征融合注入共享语言模型，在TSRBench等基准上显著优于单视图与专用TSLM基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时序语言模型（TSLM）通常只暴露单一表征，等于对所有下游任务强加固定的归纳偏置。核心问题在于：时序表征应保留何种信息、应消除何种变化，尚未被系统探讨。

Method: 以互补表征为原则构建双视图模型：视图一为折线图，保留绝对测量值与观测坐标框架；视图二为归一化延迟嵌入，对正幅度缩放与偏移保持不变并显式暴露时序结构。两个专用视觉编码器通过视觉token与多层次特征融合接入同一语言模型；基座为Qwen3-VL-8B。并通过评估期干预与单视图消融验证两视图的不变性差异及互补性。

Result: 评估期干预证实两视图具有不同的不变性剖面；单视图消融显示组合在超越基础感知的预测与推理任务上增益最大。TSRBench总体准确率由仅折线图的44.5%提升至53.2%，显著超过最强专用TSLM基线的36.7%；TSExam达89.9%，多变量ChatTS对齐数值准确率86.8%。

Conclusion: 互补表征是通用TSLM的有效设计原则：模型既能利用时序结构，又不牺牲对原始测量框架的访问能力。

Abstract: Time Series Language Models (TSLMs) enable language-based understanding and reasoning over temporal data, yet a fundamental question remains: what information should their time-series representations preserve, and what variation should they factor out? Existing TSLMs typically expose the language model to a single representation, imposing a fixed inductive bias across downstream tasks. We instead introduce complementary representations as a design principle for time-series reasoning. Our model combines two visual views: line plots preserve absolute measurements and the observed coordinate frame, while normalized delay embeddings factor out positive amplitude rescaling and offsets while exposing temporal structure. Dedicated visual encoders integrate both views into a shared language model through visual tokens and multi-level feature fusion. Evaluation-time interventions verify that the two views exhibit distinct invariance profiles, while single-view ablations show that their combination is particularly beneficial beyond basic perception, with the large gains in prediction and reasoning. Built on Qwen3-VL-8B, our dual-view model improves overall TSRBench accuracy from 44.5% with line plots alone to 53.2%, substantially exceeding the strongest evaluated dedicated TSLM baseline at 36.7%. It further achieves 89.9% accuracy on TSExam and 86.8% numerical accuracy on multivariate ChatTS alignment. Together, these results demonstrate that complementary representations provide an effective design principle for general-purpose TSLMs, enabling models to exploit temporal structure without sacrificing access to the original measurement frame.

</details>


### [438] [Robust Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Treatment Regimes under Model and Measurement Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22336)
*Chengze Xie,Xuan Wang,Ying Ding,Hairong Wang,Yan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出鲁棒强化学习框架，将患者建模为隐上下文，通过鲁棒上下文MDP统一处理跨患者泛化与生物标志物误差、疾病动态漂移下的可靠性，并在转移性前列腺癌自适应治疗中验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自适应治疗方法难以在患者间泛化，且在测量的生物标志物存在误差或疾病动态发生漂移时可靠性不足，需要一种能同时兼顾泛化性与鲁棒性的策略学习方法。

Method: 将患者视为隐上下文（hidden context），把泛化与鲁棒性问题统一建模为鲁棒上下文马尔可夫决策过程（robust contextual MDP），并据此开发鲁棒强化学习框架；在经临床数据校准的转移性前列腺癌自适应治疗模拟器上进行实验。

Result: 学到的策略可泛化且鲁棒，显著优于现有自适应治疗方法；在生物标志物准确且疾病按预期演化时，鲁棒性几乎不带来性能损失；在多种场景下所得策略对现有方法形成帕累托支配。

Conclusion: 鲁棒强化学习有望成为学习可靠自适应治疗策略的规范化方法论。

Abstract: We develop a robust reinforcement learning (RL) framework for learning adaptive treatment policies that generalize across patients and remain reliable under errors in the measured biomarker and shifts in the disease dynamics. By modeling the patient as a hidden context, we address generalization and robustness in a unified manner through robust contextual Markov decision processes. Applying our framework to adaptive therapy for metastatic prostate cancer in a simulator calibrated to clinical data, we obtain generalizable and robust policies that substantially outperform the existing adaptive therapy method. In particular, we attain robustness with almost no loss of performance when the biomarker is accurate and the disease evolves as anticipated, and find that the resulting policy Pareto-dominates the existing method across a diverse array of scenarios. Our findings suggest that robust RL holds great promise as a principled methodology for learning reliable adaptive treatment policies.

</details>


### [439] [Lean Graph Search for Formal Theorem Proving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22339)
*Yihan Xu,Jia-Chen Gu,Junyi Zhang,Di Wu,Haikang Deng,Po-Nien Kung,Kai-Wei Chang,Amit Sahai,Wei Wang,Nanyun Peng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LeanGraphSearch：基于Mathlib前向依赖图的多跳检索方法，通过图排序传播相关性并重排候选，在检索与端到端定理证明上均优于LeanSearch v2。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有lemma检索系统主要将库声明与目标定理或其证明中间步骤做语义匹配，对声明间多跳依赖利用不足；而这些依赖可揭示与目标词面不相似、但在相关问题证明中反复出现的支撑引理。

Method: 针对Lean 4构建依赖图：将每个声明链接到其依赖的前提（Mathlib前向依赖）；用图排序算法将相关性从语义匹配到的声明传播至其依赖节点；再用原始查询对扩展后的候选集重排序。

Result: 在MathlibQR上recall较最强基线LeanSearch v2最高提升12%；在MathlibMPR上完整标注证明路径覆盖率提升，最多多覆盖3.7%的组。集成到由Lean反馈引导的迭代证明循环后，在三个定理证明基准上，{8,16,32}轮反思时pass rate较原始prover最高提升40%，较LeanSearch v2最高提升10%，准确率-成本效率更优。

Conclusion: 依赖图搜索对定理证明具有实际价值，检索增益可转化为端到端证明性能提升，值得进一步研究结构感知的证明发现检索。

Abstract: Retrieving relevant lemmas is crucial for formal theorem proving, enabling provers to build machine-checkable proofs from established mathematical results. Recent retrieval systems match library declarations to a target theorem or its intermediate proof steps, but make limited use of multi-hop dependencies among declarations. These dependencies can reveal supporting lemmas that are not necessarily lexically similar to the target theorem but recur in proofs of related problems. To this end, we propose LeanGraphSearch, a graph-based retrieval method for Lean 4 that constructs a graph from Mathlib's forward dependencies and traverses it to uncover supporting lemmas through multi-hop dependency chains. Specifically, LeanGraphSearch links each declaration to the premises it depends on, uses a graph-based ranking algorithm to propagate relevance from semantically matched declarations to their dependencies, and reranks the expanded candidates against the original query. Across two mathematical retrieval benchmarks, LeanGraphSearch improves recall by up to 12% over the strongest baseline, LeanSearch v2, on MathlibQR and increases coverage of complete annotated proof routes on MathlibMPR, covering up to 3.7% of extra groups. More importantly, we evaluate whether these retrieval gains translate into improved end-to-end theorem proving by integrating LeanGraphSearch into an iterative proving loop guided by Lean feedback. Across three theorem proving benchmarks, LeanGraphSearch improves pass rate at {8, 16, 32} reflection turns by as much as 40% compared to vanilla prover and at most 10% compared to LeanSearch v2, showing higher accuracy-cost efficiency. These findings highlight the value of dependency graph search for theorem proving and motivate further research on structure-aware search for proof discovery.

</details>


### [440] [Rethinking Routing Exploration in Modern Mixture-of-Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22353)
*Bingcong Li,Hao Ma,Michael Muehlebach,Niao He,Yi Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文识别出MoE中细粒度专家分割与共享专家之间的"探索困境"，提出MirrorMoE通过对非必要专家进行token自适应抑制来缩小探索空间，从而调和该矛盾，并在不同规模模型上一致提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代MoE架构常同时采用细粒度专家分割与共享专家两种设计：前者通过固定激活率下更多专家组合提升表达能力，后者引入对所有token都激活的专家。但二者存在冲突——共享专家降低token表示的变异性，削弱路由的探索性；而细粒度分割因路由空间组合式扩大，反而更需要探索。结果是细粒度分割带来的额外表达能力在实践中难以充分实现。

Method: 提出MirrorMoE，通过token自适应的方式抑制不必要的专家，从而收缩探索空间，以调和上述探索困境。

Result: MirrorMoE在不同模型规模下均取得了一致的性能提升。

Conclusion: 共享专家与细粒度专家分割之间存在探索困境，需通过缩小探索空间（token自适应专家抑制）来平衡，MirrorMoE是有效解决方案。

Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models have become an important approach for scaling model parameters. Modern MoE architectures increasingly combine two design choices: fine-grained expert segmentation and shared experts. The former increases expressiveness by enabling more expert combinations at a fixed activation ratio, and the latter introduces experts that are active for every token. We identify an exploration dilemma between these designs: shared experts can make routing less exploratory by reducing the variability of token representations. This conflicts with the greater need for exploration induced by fine-grained expert segmentation due to the combinatorially enlarged routing space. Consequently, the additional expressiveness offered by fine-grained segmentation may not be fully realized in practice. MirrorMoE is proposed to reconcile this exploration dilemma by shrinking the exploration space through token-adaptive suppression of unnecessary experts. MirrorMoE consistently improves performance across model scales.

</details>


### [441] [PathFM: Fast Generative Forecasting of Multivariate Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22358)
*Jiachen Yao,Xiyuan Zhang,Annan Yu,Boran Han,Abdul Fatir Ansari,Shuai Zhang,Michael Bohlke-Schneider,Bernie Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出轨迹式（路径）预测模型 PathFM，用 flow matching 直接生成完整未来路径以刻画联合依赖结构，并通过蒸馏与共享历史注意力缓存实现高效采样，同时给出 fps-bench 路径评测基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主流时间序列基础模型多预测边际分位数，未指定未来轨迹的依赖结构；而累计需求、峰值负荷、事件发生时间等轨迹相关量依赖联合分布，点预测与边际分数无法反映这一点。

Method: 1) 基于 flow matching 生成整条未来路径，从而建模轨迹级联合分布；2) 将模型蒸馏为 1–2 步采样器，并在多次抽样间共享历史注意力缓存，使一条序列生成多条路径的耗时约等于分位数模型一次查询；3) 蒸馏后的采样器使直接优化校准损失（calibration loss）变得可行；4) 构建 fps-bench，在 fev-bench 任务上增加 energy score、variogram score 及下游指标。

Result: 在 fev-bench 与 TIME 上边际精度具竞争力；在 fps-bench 上聚合路径分数优于所有评估的外部基线；在混沌系统实验中，flow 模型能保持长期变异性，而强基线快速塌缩。

Conclusion: PathFM 使生成式时间序列预测兼具竞争力与实用性，可支撑多样化的下游应用，并指出路径级评测（fps-bench）是边际指标的必要补充。

Abstract: Time series foundation models are becoming increasingly popular for general-purpose forecasting. However, most leading models predict marginal quantiles, leaving the dependence structure of future trajectories unspecified. This distinction matters for trajectory-dependent quantities such as cumulative demand, peak load, and event timing, yet point and marginal scores do not reveal it. To model this dependence, we introduce PathFM, a trajectory-based forecasting model that uses flow matching to generate complete future paths. We further distill the model to one or two steps and share history attention cache across draws. Together, these enable PathFM to generate multiple paths for a single series in roughly the time needed for one query to a quantile model. The distilled sampler also makes it practical to optimize a calibration loss directly. PathFM achieves competitive marginal accuracy on the established forecasting benchmarks fev-bench and TIME. To complement these evaluations, we introduce Forecast Path Score Bench (fps-bench), which augments fev-bench tasks with energy and variogram scores and downstream metrics. PathFM achieves a higher aggregate path score on fps-bench than all evaluated external baselines. Experiments on chaotic systems further show that our flow model sustains long-run variability, while strong baselines rapidly collapse. PathFM makes generative time series forecasting both competitive and practical, enabling diverse downstream applications.

</details>


<div id='physics.optics'></div>

# physics.optics [[Back]](#toc)

### [442] [Megabar Shocks on a Benchtop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20749)
*Yun Kai,Min Kim,Senpeng Lin,Zhen Sang,Jacob Gordon,Steven E. Kooi,Alexei Maznev,Thomas Pezeril,Cyril Williams,Tom Lockard,Damian Swift,Keith A. Nelson*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文提出一种仅用数十毫焦（mJ）激光脉冲能量，在台式装置上通过多环、多延时激光环叠加激发会聚冲击波，实现兆巴（100 GPa）量级压力的方法，实测冲击压缩效率达23 GPa/mJ。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究极端条件下材料行为需要兆巴（100 GPa）级压力，但传统手段通常依赖千焦（kJ）级大型激光装置，成本高、门槛高。作者希望探索能否以极低激光能量在小型台式系统上达到同等压力水平。

Method: 核心方法为采用多个不同直径的激光环并结合时间延迟，叠加激发会聚冲击波。利用高速成像与条纹相机（streak camera）测量冲击波轨迹，再通过流体动力学代码（hydrocode）模拟推断压力、温度与密度，从而评估冲击压缩效率。

Result: 在仅数毫焦至数十毫焦的激光脉冲能量下实现了兆巴级压力；经流体动力学模拟校核，冲击压缩效率达到23 GPa/mJ；通过高速成像与条纹相机获得冲击轨迹并反演热力学状态。

Conclusion: 该工作证明台式低能量激光即可实现兆巴级冲击压缩，且效率高、可扩展；若进一步放大，有望在台式装置上开展高能量密度物理实验。

Abstract: Techniques to generate megabar (100 GPa) pressure are critical for the study of materials under extreme conditions. However, kJ-class lasers are typically needed to generate such extreme pressures. Here, we present a method to reach megabar pressure on a benchtop using only tens of mJ a few millijoules of laser pulse energy. The core of our method is the utilization of multiple laser rings of different diameters and time delays to additively excite a focusing shock wave. Using high-speed imaging and a streak camera, we measured the shock trajectory and inferred pressure, temperature and density using hydrocode simulation. Our shock compression efficiency, informed by hydrocode, has achieved 23 GPa/mJ. If scaled up, our method may enable high-energy-density experiments on a benchtop.

</details>


### [443] [Localized high-Q resonances enable electrically defined beam steering in lithium niobate metasurfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21027)
*Jiyong Shim,Sahil Dagli,Hamish Carr Delgado,Remi Dado,Chih-Yi Chen,Feng Pan,Isabella He,Sajjad Abdollahramezani,Mark L. Brongersma,Jennifer A. Dionne*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该工作将铌酸锂的Pockels效应与高Q(Q>1700)硅导模共振纳米天线结合，实现1 μm间距、单元独立电光调控的超表面，通过偏置图案而非几何结构实现可重构光束偏转。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LiDAR与光通信需要高速、可重构、独立控制光学相位的光束偏转器件；传统超表面几何固定，偏转角度不可重构，且小间距下单元间耦合限制性能。

Method: 构建铌酸锂+高Q硅导模共振纳米天线复合超表面；利用局域共振实现1 μm pitch的单元独立电光调制；改变偏置图案设定偏转角度；采用模式重叠分析评估单元间耦合对可用Q的限制。

Result: 相同阵列可分别偏转至53.5°和32.4°，角度由偏置图案决定；测得0阶调制深度18.0%，偏转级仅占入射功率0.09%，探测调制带宽940 MHz。

Conclusion: 偏置可重构的电光超表面可行；模式重叠分析给出单元耦合限制Q的设计规则，为紧凑高速光束偏转器件提供设计准则。

Abstract: High-speed beam steering for LiDAR and optical communication requires independent, reconfigurable control of optical phase. We demonstrate a metasurface combining lithium niobate's Pockels effect with high-Q (Q > 1700) silicon guided-mode resonance nanoantennas whose localized resonances allow individual electro-optic control at a 1 $μ$m pitch. Identical arrays steer light to 53.5$^\circ$ or 32.4$^\circ$, with the angle set by the bias pattern rather than antenna geometry. We measure 18.0% 0th-order modulation depth, 0.09% of incident power in the steered order, and a 940 MHz detected modulation bandwidth. Mode-overlap analysis shows how inter-element coupling limits usable Q, providing design rules for compact, high-speed beam steering.

</details>


### [444] [Monte Carlo Framework for Physics-Based Design and Optimization of X-Ray Compressive Ghost Imaging Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21334)
*R. H. Shukrun,A. Ben-Yehuda,Y. Korotinsky,Y. Klein,O. Sefi,Y. Fried,L. Epstein,S. Shwartz*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出基于FLUKA的蒙特卡洛框架，模拟X射线鬼成像中光子输运与二值掩模产生的桶信号，并将物理标度分析（光子数、管负载、吸收剂量）与重建质量/收敛分析耦合，用于在设计阶段判断系统受限因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: X射线鬼成像相较光学实现受多种能量相关光子—物质相互作用（光电吸收、康普顿散射、荧光）支配，其相对贡献取决于源谱、样品几何与成分及探测器配置，缺乏测量前的定量设计工具。

Method: 构建FLUKA蒙特卡洛框架，模拟光子输运并由二值照明图案预测桶信号；将模拟桶信号经物理标度分析换算为光子数、管负载与吸收剂量，并与鬼成像重建分析（图像质量与收敛性）耦合。以厘米尺度铁质样品为例，在单一透射探测器与三个离轴散射探测器、多种源谱条件下评估重建。

Result: 结果表明源谱特性与探测器几何显著影响重建质量与辐射剂量；框架可在测量前判定系统是受源输出、掩模调制还是重建算法限制，并给出定量设计准则。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了面向具体应用的X射线鬼成像系统预测性设计框架，可为未来系统设计提供定量指导。

Abstract: X-ray ghost imaging has emerged as a promising computational imaging modality capable of forming images from spatially integrated measurements. Unlike optical implementations, image formation is governed by multiple energy-dependent photon-matter interactions: photoelectric absorption, Compton scattering, and fluorescence. The relative contributions of these interactions depend on the source spectrum, sample geometry and composition, and detector configuration. We present a FLUKA-based Monte Carlo framework that models photon transport and predicts bucket signals generated by binary illumination patterns. The framework couples a physical scaling analysis, which converts the simulated bucket signals into photon numbers, tube loading and absorbed dose, with a ghost imaging reconstruction analysis of image quality and convergence. Our framework helps assess whether a given configuration is limited by the source output, the mask modulation or the reconstruction before any measurement is made. We evaluate the reconstruction for a centimeter-scale imaging system for an iron crown using one transmission detector and three off-axis scattering detectors over a range of source spectra. The results reveal how source characteristics and detector geometry influence reconstruction quality and radiation dose, providing quantitative guidelines for future X-ray ghost imaging system design. More broadly, this work establishes a predictive design framework for application-specific X-ray ghost imaging systems.

</details>


### [445] [Nonreciprocal Control of Spatiotemporal Floquet Dynamics in Levitated Optomechanical Arrays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21399)
*Guangyu Zhang,Qihao Guo,Zhang-qi Yin*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 在非互易参数驱动光悬浮粒子环中，空间相位可在保持集体时间锁定的同时被控制：非互易性使有限波矢模极化并驱动从"钉扎态"到"持续定向空间相位漂移"的转变，漂移速度编码于谱分支劈裂。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 周期驱动光子与光力系统是研究集体Floquet动力学的平台，但时间锁定与有限-q图样连续旋转之间的关系尚不清楚。

Method: 构建参数驱动光悬浮粒子的非互易环形阵列；分析反向传播有限波矢模的极化与耦合不对称性，通过两条主导谱支的劈裂测量归一化空间相位漂移速度，并考察少粒子极限。

Result: 钉扎区呈现实验室系周期二时间晶体响应；旋转区形成时间锁定但空间相位持续漂移的时空有序态。漂移速度由谱支劈裂独立编码，方向随耦合不对称性反转；该对应关系在少粒子环中依然成立。

Conclusion: 非互易性为驱动光悬浮光力系统中空间相位漂移与时间同步的独立调控提供了途径。

Abstract: Periodically driven photonic and optomechanical systems provide a versatile setting for realizing collective Floquet dynamics, yet the relation between temporal locking and continuous rotation of the finite-$q$ pattern remains poorly understood. We show that a nonreciprocal ring of parametrically driven optically levitated particles allows the spatial phase to be controlled while collective temporal locking is preserved. Nonreciprocity polarizes the counterpropagating finite-wave-vector modes and drives a transition from the pinned state to persistent directional spatial-phase drift. The normalized spatial-phase drift velocity is independently encoded in the splitting of the two dominant spectral branches, and its direction reverses with the coupling asymmetry. The pinned regime exhibits a laboratory frame period-two time-crystalline response, whereas the rotating regime forms a distinct temporally locked spatiotemporally ordered state. The same correspondence between spatial-phase drift and spectral splitting persists down to few-particle rings, indicating that the effect does not require a large array. These results establish nonreciprocity as a route to independently control spatial-phase drift and temporal synchronization in driven levitated optomechanical systems.

</details>


### [446] [Machine Learning Surrogate Model for Accelerating InGaAs/GaAs Quantum Well Laser Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21430)
*Paul Verrinder,Jack Markham*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 基于MLP神经网络的代理模型，以InGaAs量子阱激光器的外延层参数为输入，预测6项激光性能指标，R²>0.91，速度提升约10⁶倍，用于百万级设计空间搜索最优外延结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 完整器件仿真（Harold）计算代价高昂，难以支撑大规模外延层设计空间的遍历优化，需要快速、准确的代理模型。

Method: 构建MLP代理模型，训练数据为4999组外延层参数设计经Harold仿真得到的6项性能指标；采用Swish激活函数替代ReLU，并引入由基础输入派生的工程化特征；随后在100万组设计空间中搜索最小化阈值电流与内损耗的结构。

Result: 留出测试集上6项指标R²均>0.91；相比完整仿真加速约10⁶倍，百万设计评估耗时由231天降至约2分钟；Swish+派生特征使平均R²由0.88升至0.94，平均绝对百分比误差由1.78±0.08%降至1.17±0.09%（无额外训练数据）。

Conclusion: MLP代理模型可在保持高预测精度的同时实现数量级加速，配合激活函数选择与特征工程可显著提升性能，适用于激光器外延层参数的快速逆向设计与大规模优化。

Abstract: A machine-learning surrogate model based on a multi-layer perceptron neural network is used to predict six laser performance metrics for an indium gallium arsenide quantum well laser given epitaxial layer parameters as inputs. The surrogate model was trained on simulation data from a set of 4999 designs which were generated by varying epitaxial layer parameters and simulating each design with Harold to extract performance metrics. The model predicts all 6 chosen metrics with a coefficient of determination, $R^2$, greater than 0.91 on a held-out test set and demonstrates a $\sim 10^6 \times$ speed up compared to full device simulations. The model is used to search across 1 million potential epitaxial designs in the parameter space and find designs that minimize threshold current and internal loss. Using the surrogate, rather than full device simulation, reduces computation time for a million designs from 231 days to $\sim$2 minutes on a standard laptop. It is also demonstrated that use of the Swish activation function, rather than ReLU, together with engineered input features - i.e. derived quantities calculated from the base model inputs - raise the mean $R^2$ from 0.88 to 0.94 without additional training data, and reduce the mean absolute percentage error from $1.78 \pm 0.08 \%$ to $1.17 \pm 0.09 \%$.

</details>


### [447] [Thermal Confinement in Plasmonic Nanoparticles under Generalised Pulsed Illumination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21698)
*Javier González-Colsa,Dolores Ortiz,José María Saiz,Alfredo Franco,Francisco González,Fernando Bresme,Pablo Albella*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该工作建立了球形等离激元纳米颗粒热约束的数值模型，结合广义光热加热与瞬态热方程有限差分解并计入有限界面热导，提出由温度时间包络定义的热约束半径，证明脉冲宽度是可调的热约束控制参数，且界面热导在超短脉冲下可致约束半径偏差达20%、瞬态热构造偏差超60%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 热约束决定光热应用中热量影响的空间范围，是光热应用的关键参数，但缺乏在从超短脉冲到连续波全激发条件下定量刻画纳米尺度热局域、并显式考虑界面热导的方法。

Method: 构建数值处理：将广义光学加热模型与瞬态热方程的有限差分解相结合，显式引入有限界面热导边界条件；针对球形等离激元纳米颗粒，在脉冲至连续波激发条件下计算温度场；由周围介质中的温度时间包络定义热约束半径，以表征热量空间分布。

Result: 脉冲宽度可作为高效、可调的热约束控制参数；有限界面热导可使空间约束半径偏差达约20%，在超短激发下瞬态热构造偏差超过60%；将代表性靶向配体的特征尺寸与热约束长度尺度比较，表明可精确调节脉冲宽度以控制靶向加热。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了预测纳米尺度热局域的统一框架，为高精度热等离激元应用的理性设计奠定基础。

Abstract: Thermal confinement is a key parameter in photothermal applications, as it determines the spatial extent of the region affected by the generated heat. In this work, we develop a numerical treatment to quantify thermal confinement in spherical plasmonic nanoparticles under excitation conditions ranging from ultrashort pulses to the continuous-wave regime. The model combines generalized optical heating with a finite-difference solution of the transient heat equation and explicitly accounts for finite interfacial thermal conductance. To characterize the spatial distribution of heat, we introduce a thermal confinement radius defined from the temporal temperature envelope in the surrounding medium. We demonstrate that pulse duration acts as a highly effective, tuneable parameter to govern thermal confinement. Notably, we quantitatively show that finite interfacial thermal conductance can induce deviations of up to 20% in the spatial confinement radius and over 60% in the transient thermal construct under ultrashort excitation. By comparing the characteristic dimensions of representative targeting ligands with the resulting thermal-confinement length scales, we show how pulse duration can be precisely tailored to control target heating. These results provide a unified framework for predicting nanoscale heat localization paving the way for the rational design of high precision thermoplasmonic applications.

</details>


### [448] [Watt-level single-cavity dual-comb laser at 2.1 $μ$m wavelength](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21766)
*Mykyta Redkin,Yicheng Wang,Marcel van Delden,Robin Löscher,Oliver Nagy,Sergei Tomilov,Clara J. Saraceno*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 报道了一台直接发射于2.1 μm、瓦级功率的单腔双光梳激光器，基于Ho:CaAlGdO4晶体软光阑Kerr透镜锁模，并对其频率稳定性、相位噪声、RIN及光谱分辨率进行了表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2 μm大气传输窗口的紧凑超快光频梳在直接光谱与非线性变频中有重要应用，但该波段双光梳系统稀缺，现有方案多依赖非线性转换，系统复杂、转换效率低、平均与峰值功率均偏低。

Method: 采用单腔软光阑Kerr透镜锁模（KLM）结构，增益介质为宽带掺Ho的CaAlGdO4（CALGO）晶体，实现直接2.1 μm双光梳输出；并对自由运转双光梳的频率稳定性、相位噪声与相对强度噪声（RIN）进行详细表征，通过Fabry-Pérot标准具引入的频谱调制评估可达光谱分辨率。

Result: 总输出功率超过2 W（每梳1 W），脉宽sub-100 fs（带宽50 nm），重复频率96.5 MHz，对应单梳脉冲能量10 nJ、峰值功率100 kW。

Conclusion: 该单腔振荡器兼具紧凑性、高效率与被动互相干性，同时具备2.1 μm瓦级平均功率，适用于大气传输窗口的环境传感，也可作为向中红外与太赫兹波段非线性变频的驱动源。

Abstract: Compact ultrafast laser combs around the 2 $μ$m atmospheric transmission window are of growing interest for direct spectroscopy and as drivers for nonlinear conversion to otherwise hard-to-reach spectral regions. Dual-comb systems in this region remain very scarce: existing implementations rely mostly on nonlinear conversion, resulting in complex systems with poor conversion efficiency and overall low average and peak power. In this paper, we report on a watt-level dual-comb laser directly emitting at 2.1 $μ$m. The system is based on a single-cavity, soft-aperture Kerr-lens mode-locked (KLM) laser using a broadband holmium (Ho)-doped CaAlGdO$_4$ (CALGO) gain crystal. The laser delivers a total output power exceeding 2 W (1 W per comb) with a sub-100-fs pulse duration (50 nm bandwidth) at a repetition rate of 96.5 MHz, corresponding to a pulse energy of 10 nJ and a peak power of 100 kW per comb. To assess the source's potential for future spectroscopic applications, we characterize the free-running dual comb in detail for frequency stability, phase noise, and relative intensity noise (RIN), and benchmark the achievable spectral resolution by measuring spectral modulations imposed by Fabry-Pérot etalons. Our system combines the compactness, high efficiency, and passive mutual coherence of a single-cavity oscillator with watt-level average power at 2.1 $μ$m, making it a promising source for environmental sensing in the atmospheric transmission window, or as a driver for nonlinear frequency conversion, for example, to the MIR and THz regions.

</details>


### [449] [Ablation-Driven Selective Laser Direct Mass Transfer for Micro-LEDs with High Speed, Enhanced Gap Tolerance, and High Precision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21839)
*Yuxuan Cao,Yulong Wang,Jürgen Brugger,Zhen Zhang*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文提出离焦直接激光烧蚀转移（D-DLAT）方法，以聚酰亚胺为动态释放层，通过烧蚀冲击主动推进微LED芯片，实现高精度、高选择性、高速规模化转移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: micro-LED是下一代显示的关键，但供体到接收基板的大规模转移是制造瓶颈；现有LIFT方法存在通量低、选择性有限、反应时间长的问题，且多数间接激光转移依赖芯片被动下落。

Method: 采用离焦直接激光烧蚀转移（D-DLAT），以聚酰亚胺作为动态释放层，直接烧蚀释放层产生烧蚀冲击，主动将小尺寸芯片推向接收基板；并优化烧蚀轮廓与扫描路径。

Result: 成功转移600 μm至35 μm的micro-LED，最小放置误差低于1 μm，临界转移间隙达50 μm；实现完全选择性，支持复杂图案化转移与阵列重排（repitching）。

Conclusion: D-DLAT克服现有转移技术的基本限制，适用于micro-LED显示的可扩展高良率制造，并为微光电器件的高速操控与异质集成、微组装及柔性电子提供新范式。

Abstract: Micro light-emitting diodes (micro-LEDs) offer superior performance for next-generation displays, yet their scalable manufacturing is severely bottlenecked by the mass transfer process from donor to receiver substrates. The existing laser-induced forward transfer (LIFT) methods are restricted by low throughput, limited selectivity, and long reaction times. In this study, we introduce a novel defocused direct laser ablation transfer (D-DLAT) method utilizing polyimide as a dynamic release layer. Whereas most indirect laser transfer methods trigger chip release followed by passive descent toward the receiver, D-DLAT directly ablates the release layer to actively propel the small-sized chips towards the receiver via ablation shock. By optimizing the ablation profiles and scanning paths, this method achieves high-speed transfer with significantly enhanced precision and robustness. We demonstrate the successful transfer of micro-LEDs ranging from 600 $\unicode{x03BC}$m down to 35 $\unicode{x03BC}$m in size, with a minimum reported placement error of less than 1 $\unicode{x03BC}$m, and a critical transfer gap of up to 50 $\unicode{x03BC}$m. Furthermore, the D-DLAT approach enables full selectivity, facilitating complex patterned transfers and array repitching operations that are essential for full-color display integration. Our findings indicate that D-DLAT effectively overcomes the fundamental limitations of current transfer technologies, demonstrating substantial potential for the scalable and high-yield manufacturing of advanced micro-LED displays. Ultimately, D-DLAT establishes a robust paradigm for the high-speed manipulation and heterogeneous integration of micro-optoelectronic devices, extending its profound implications beyond displays to the broader landscape of advanced micro-assembly and flexible electronics.

</details>


### [450] [Optical Coherent Combining in Multi-Aperture Free-Space Receivers through Atmospheric Turbulence via Optically Computed Alignment Gradients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21876)
*Chen Cheng,Tong Luo,Siyu Gong,Qun Zhang,Linsheng Fan,Qi Wu,Yanfu Yang,Jiayin Xue*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出一种光学域多孔径相干合并方案：对齐信息由光干涉本身产生，经平衡探测差分光电流直接读出相位与偏振的上升方向，无需信道估计、无需扰动、无逐支路数字处理；各级对共用参考（合并场自身的无源抽头）对齐，无需独立激光或锁频。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多孔径接收的价值在于将空间分集转化为相干合并增益，但前提是各支路场复本在求和前的相对相位与偏振已对齐。星地下行链路中大气扰动幅度、相位与偏振，使对齐必须跟踪时变信道而非固定偏置，传统方案（信道估计、逐支路数字处理、独立本振/锁频、多路复用）代价高。

Method: 以光学干涉形成使合成输出功率最大的上升方向，并由平衡探测的差分光电流直接读出；所有支路相对于合并场自身无源抽头这一共享参考对齐；单平均窗口内并行获得全部支路更新方向，无需频率/码/时间复用；数据侧仅需一个双偏振相干接收机（与孔径数无关）；读出仅用3 dB定向耦合器、静态移相器、法拉第旋转器和平衡光电二极管，无需90°光混频器、混频器或偏振分集混合器；相位与偏振环路为固定增益、无除法，各支路仅含一个相位调制器与一个偏振控制器，无幅度执行器。

Result: 给出了闭式合并增益与损耗预算，并明确表述了方案的假设与局限；实验验证尚待开展。

Conclusion: 该方案将信道对齐从"计算问题"转化为"光域物理过程"，在硬件复杂度与可扩展性上具优势（读出器件基础化、执行器最小化、接收机数不随孔径增加），但性能仍有待实验证实。

Abstract: Multi-aperture reception converts spatial diversity into a coherent-combining gain, but only if the relative phase and polarization of the collected field replicas are aligned before they are summed. In a satellite-to-ground downlink the atmosphere perturbs amplitude, phase and polarization, so the alignment must track a fluctuating channel rather than a fixed offset. This paper proposes a new optical-domain combining scheme in which the alignment information is computed by light itself: the ascent directions that maximize the combined output power are formed by optical interference and read out directly as differential photocurrents of balanced detection, so no estimate of the channel, no deliberate perturbation, and no per-branch digital processing is needed to obtain them. Every branch is aligned against one shared reference - a passive tap of the combined field itself - so no independent laser or optical frequency lock is required, and the update directions of all branches are available simultaneously in a single averaging window without frequency, code, or time multiplexing. The data path needs a single dual-polarization coherent receiver regardless of the aperture count, and the readout is built from elementary parts only - a 3 dB directional coupler, static phase shifters, a Faraday rotator, and balanced photodiodes - so no 90-degree optical hybrid, mixer, or polarization-diverse hybrid is required. The phase and polarization loops are fixed-gain and division-free, and each branch carries one phase modulator and one polarization controller with no amplitude actuator. A closed-form combining-gain and loss budget is derived, the assumptions and limitations of the scheme are stated explicitly, and experimental validation remains open.

</details>


### [451] [Frequency comb stability, bistability, and self-starting in normal dispersion microresonators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22164)
*Logan Courtright,Alexey Sukhinin,Pradyoth Shandilya,Tanvir Mahmood,James P. Cahill,Curtis R. Menyuk*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了正常色散微谐振腔中光子晶体结构诱导模式分裂时"platicon"（暗孤子）的线性稳定性，绘制了泵浦失谐-泵浦功率参数空间中的稳定区，发现高功率下的"手指"双稳区，并确定platicon可自启动的参数窗口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反常色散微腔频梳依赖亮孤子，而正常色散微腔通过制备模式耦合（模式分裂）也能产生频梳，其载体为暗孤子/platicon；但platicon在失谐-功率参数空间中的稳定性边界、双稳行为及自启动条件尚不清晰，需要系统刻画。

Method: 以光子晶体谐振腔（周期调制波导宽度、几何诱导模式耦合）为对象，在泵浦失谐与泵浦功率构成的参数空间中，变化模式分裂强度与腔色散，对platicon做线性稳定性分析；并将稳定区与连续波调制不稳定区求交以判定自启动条件，辅以数值仿真验证。

Result: 发现platicon存在宽广的稳定区域；在高功率处出现"手指"状结构，其边界处发生陡峭转变，内部platicon解呈双稳；稳定区与CW调制不稳定区存在交叠，在该交叠区内platicon可自启动，仿真显示其能稳定自启动。

Conclusion: 模式分裂强度与色散共同决定platicon的稳定性版图；高功率手指区的双稳与边界突变是重要特征；稳定区∩调制不稳定区给出了platicon自启动的可靠参数判据，为正常色散微腔频梳的实验设计提供指导。

Abstract: Recent work has demonstrated that it is possible to generate frequency combs in normal dispersion microresonators by taking advantage of fabricated mode coupling that induces a mode split. In particular, photonic crystal resonators periodically modulate the microresonator's width, which geometrically creates mode coupling. In contrast to frequency combs generated by microresonators in the anomalous dispersion regime, which are typically generated using bright solitons, the frequency combs generated by normal dispersion regime microresonators are dark pulses that are commonly referred to as dark solitons or platicons. In this work, we examine the linear stability of platicons in the pump-detuning and pump-power parameter space as the mode split strength and cavity dispersion is varied. Our work reveals a broad region of stability for platicons. Our work also reveals the existence of fingers at high power at whose boundaries a sharp transition occurs and inside of which platicon solutions are bistable. Finally, we investigate the overlap of the region where platicons are stable with the region where continuous waves are modulationally unstable, and it is possible for a platicon to self-start. Simulations show that platicons consistently self-start inside this region.

</details>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [452] [The World Won't Wait: Evaluating and Teaching Agents Under a Live Clock](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20665)
*Ningxin Pan,Hanyu Li,Yeqing Shen,Ning Ding,Yehui Tang,Wentao Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 RealtimeBench 基准来评估在游戏持续运行（推理不暂停）条件下的 LLM 智能体实时表现，并提出双时间尺度离线递归自我改进方法 TORSI，使快速学生模型在无教师调用的情况下提升实时任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体虽能完成复杂交互任务，但推理与工具调用耗时较长；在持续变化的环境中，原本正确的动作可能因延迟而失效。现有评估多假设环境可暂停，无法反映实时性约束下的能力退化，且"更强但更慢"的模型未必占优。

Method: 1) 构建 RealtimeBench：含 6 类游戏、180 个任务，在推理期间游戏继续运行，并采用配对评估比较暂停/不暂停两种设置。2) 提出 TORSI（Two-Timescale Offline Recursive Self-Improvement）：慢速教师在两次尝试之间离线分析失败案例并在暂停环境中验证修正，进而撰写可复用的指令给学生模型；学生在实际游玩中不调用教师，仅通过验证分数决定是否采纳更新，形成双时间尺度的"审慎—学习—行动"分工。

Result: 配对评估显示 GPT-6.1-sol 在暂停设置下优于更快的 Jev，但在持续运行设置下反被 Jev 超越。TORSI 两轮迭代将 Jev 的平均测试分数从 13.51 提升到 24.19（0–100 进度尺度），6 类游戏全部提升；所得指令在无需调参的情况下也提升了另外三个模型的平均分数。

Conclusion: 结果指向"实时智能"：通过在不同时间尺度上组织审慎推理、离线学习与快速行动，可让强 LLM 智能体在持续变化的世界中保持有效性；同时表明实时性应作为独立评估维度，且慢教师的离线经验可低成本迁移到快速学生。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can solve complex interactive tasks, yet reasoning and tool calls take time. In continuously changing environments, an otherwise correct action may arrive too late. We introduce RealtimeBench, with 180 tasks across six game types, to evaluate agents while games continue running during inference. Paired evaluations show that GPT-6.1-sol outperforms the faster Jev when games are paused, but falls behind when they keep running. We propose Two-Timescale Offline Recursive Self-Improvement (TORSI): a slow teacher studies failures and tests corrections in paused games between attempts, then writes reusable instructions for a fast student. The student acts without teacher calls during gameplay, and validation scores determine which updates are adopted. Two rounds raise Jev's average test score from 13.51 to 24.19 on a 0--100 progress scale, improving all six game types. The instructions also improve average scores for three other models without retuning. These findings point toward real-time intelligence: enabling powerful LLM agents to remain effective in a continuously changing world by organizing deliberation, learning, and action across timescales.

</details>


### [453] [Evaluating Model Capabilities After Benchmark Saturation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20667)
*Morio Hamada,Jehyeok Yeon,Matteo Migliarini,Justin Olive,Magda Dubois*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究基准饱和后，模型解题完整文本记录（transcripts）是否仍携带能力信息。作者用历史基准回测模拟饱和，比较成对评判、单文本绝对打分、确定性特征或嵌入预测等协议；发现饱和 transcripts 仍蕴含超越准确率的能力信号，成对评判最优，预测误差较仅用饱和分数基线降低5.3倍，但跨分布偏移时泛化不稳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 能力快速提升导致基准饱和：多模型接近满分后基准失去区分度，难以支撑安全论证与前沿政策。然而基准条目产出的信息远多于分数本身——包含模型完整解题过程，作者因此探究能否利用这些 transcripts 在分数饱和后继续评估能力。

Method: 采用回顾性模拟借助历史基准与模型发布构造饱和场景；检验仅访问饱和基准中正确解答 transcripts 的协议能否预测在未饱和留出条目上的能力。评估三类代表性信息抽取方法：成对评判（pairwise judging）、单文本绝对打分、以及基于确定性文本特征或嵌入的预测；并分析信息在 transcripts 各段落与通道（如推理、工具调用）中的分布及跨分布偏移的泛化性。

Result: 饱和 transcripts 保留超出基准准确率的能力信息。所评估协议中成对评判表现最佳，相较仅用饱和基准分数的基线将预测误差降低5.3倍。能力相关信息分布于 transcripts 多个段落，但集中于推理与工具调用等特定信息通道。协议预测力并非总能跨分布偏移泛化，例如会低估2025年初首批推理模型的能力。

Conclusion: 饱和基准的任务 transcripts 中仍存在预测能力的信号，但要将现有基准的寿命延长，需要设计能稳健提取这些信号的方法。

Abstract: Rapid advances in AI capabilities are causing benchmarks to saturate. Once several models approach perfect scores, a benchmark loses its power to differentiate between them, and with it its utility for informing AI safety cases and frontier policies.
