The teacher then regenerates only these spans from the student's own prefix, and the student is trained on the regenerated segments. LoCD thereby concentrates learning on the most informative states while keeping exposure bias low. Extensive experiments across math reasoning, code generation, and agent tasks demonstrate that LoCD consistently outperforms strong baselines and achieves more stable training with smaller and sparser parameter updates.

</details>


### [522] [Incentivizing Tool-Use Reinforcement Learning for Post-Arrival Emergency Care Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21449)
*Pengfei Hu,Chenwei Wu,Qiao Jin,Jun Deng,Zhiyong Lu,Liyue Shen,Yue Ning*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出TIR-EC框架：将EHR特征组作为工具供LLM调用，用GBDT教师模型提供工具选择与分级风险奖励做强化学习，并通过"逆向课程"把临床技能蒸馏进模型权重，使4B模型在三个临床预测任务上取得最高macro F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在EHR预测任务上普遍不如树模型等传统ML方法；作者通过受控分析将差距归因于两点：(1) LLM不会筛选有信息量的特征；(2) 即使给定正确特征，也错误判断数值对风险的隐含含义。

Method: TIR-EC：把EHR特征组封装为LLM可调用的工具；以梯度提升树（GBDT）作为教师，提供"有信息量的工具参考集"和分级风险目标作为强化学习奖励；同时用逆向课程学习——在RL过程中逐步从prompt中移除任务特定临床技能，使其蒸馏进模型权重。

Result: 在三个临床预测任务上，4B的TIR-EC agent在所有对比模型中macro F1最高，优于传统ML基线，并与规模大得多的前沿LLM相当；进一步分析显示其以更少的工具调用选中更有用证据，且更有效地融合多项测量。

Conclusion: 通过工具集成强化学习+树教师奖励+技能逆向课程蒸馏，可弥合LLM与树模型在EHR预测上的差距，小模型亦能达到最优性能。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can reason over both structured measurements and free-text records, which makes them attractive for emergency department (ED) prediction. However, most existing LLMs still fall short of conventional ML methods like trees on EHR-based prediction tasks. Our controlled analysis traces this gap to two weaknesses: LLMs do not select informative features, and they misjudge what numerical values imply for risk even when given the right features. We propose TIR-EC, a tool-integrated reinforcement learning framework that addresses both. TIR-EC exposes EHR feature groups as tools the LLM can call. It trains the LLM with rewards from a gradient-boosted tree teacher, which provides a reference set of informative tools and a graded risk target. TIR-EC also distills task-specific clinical skills into the model weights through a reverse curriculum that gradually removes the skills from the prompt during RL process. Evaluation on three clinical prediction tasks shows that our 4B agent achieves the highest macro F1 of all compared models, outperforms conventional ML baselines, and is competitive with much larger frontier LLMs. Further analysis shows that TIR-EC selects more useful evidence with fewer tool calls and combines measurements more effectively.

</details>


### [523] [Ontology Refinement with Embeddings and LLMs: A Case Study on CASTON](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21466)
*Hui Yang,Ziyu Li,Xuan Liu,Anders Jarfors,He Tan,Jiaoyan Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CASTON本体精化工作流：微调的本体嵌入模型筛选少量候选公理及替换候选，再由LLM给出修复建议；小规模专家评测中默认配置的6个高置信度替换全被两位专家接受。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本体（如生物医学、医疗领域）用于表示复杂知识，但无论人工还是自动构建的类层次都可能含微妙的包含（subsumption）错误，需精细精化；现有方法在可靠性与可扩展性上仍有不足。

Method: 以铸造领域本体CASTON为对象，设计轻量且可扩展的精化工作流：先由微调的本体嵌入模型（OnT，CASTON微调）提取有限数量的待精化候选公理及可能替换候选，再交由LLM（如Qwen3-8B）生成修复建议；代码开源。

Result: 小规模专家评测显示，采用CASTON微调的OnT嵌入模型与Qwen3-8B的默认配置能产生可靠的高置信度修复：全部6个高置信度替换均被两位领域专家接受。

Conclusion: 嵌入模型候选筛选+LLM修复建议的组合可在可控人工审核成本下实现可靠的类层次精化，为领域本体质量保障提供可扩展的轻量方案。

Abstract: Ontologies are widely used to represent and organize complex knowledge in domains such as biomedicine and healthcare. However, constructing reliable ontologies remains challenging, as class hierarchies, whether manually or automatically constructed, may contain subtle subsumption errors that require careful refinement. We study this problem in CASTON, a casting-domain ontology, and present a lightweight but scalable refinement workflow that combines a fine-tuned ontology embedding model with Large Language Models (LLMs). The embedding model is used to extract a limited number of candidate axioms for refinement together with possible replacement candidates, and an LLM then returns repair suggestions. In a small expert evaluation, the default configuration using a CASTON-fine-tuned OnT embedding model and Qwen3-8B produced reliable high-confidence repairs: all six high-confidence replacements were accepted by both domain experts. The implementation is available at https://github.com/HuiYang1997/OntRefine.

</details>


### [524] [Tool-Augmented Large Language Models for Reliable Medical Calculation from Patient Notes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21477)
*Yang Zhong,Ling Luo,Xuanlyu Zhu,Yanhua Wang,Yuanyuan Sun,Jian Wang,Hongfei Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出工具增强的LLM框架，将医疗计算器的规则检索、可执行工具合成与受约束变量抽取分离，在MedCalc-Bench上达到86.73%最终答案准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接用LLM从自由文本病历中执行医学计算器不可靠：规则回忆、参数抽取、算术推理与格式化纠缠在单次生成步骤中，易产生算术幻觉。

Method: 框架三部分：检索并结构化计算器规格说明；据此生成可复用的可执行工具；用受约束抽取器将每份病历映射为计算器所需输入，再由工具执行确定性计算，从而将临床语言理解与规则执行、算术解耦。

Result: 在MedCalc-Bench上最终答案准确率86.73%，分别超过单次提示基线和仅监督微调基线24.0与17.27个百分点。消融与错误分析表明增益主要来自规则接地的工具合成与模式约束抽取，剩余失败集中于临床语义抽取及基准特有的输出契约。

Conclusion: 将计算器逻辑落地为可执行工具可缓解算术幻觉，提升临床输出计算可靠性；瓶颈已从算术转向语义抽取与输出规范。

Abstract: Medical calculators translate raw patient observations into clinically actionable values and scores. However, applying these calculators directly to free-form patient notes requires precise variable extraction combined with the exact execution of complex formulas, scoring rules, and output conventions. Relying solely on direct large language model (LLM) prompting is unreliable in this context, as rule recall, parameter extraction, arithmetic reasoning, and formatting become entangled within a single generative step. To address these limitations, we propose a tool-augmented LLM framework for reliable medical calculation from patient notes. The framework retrieves and structures calculator specifications, generates reusable executable tools, and uses a constrained extractor to map each patient note to calculator-ready inputs. The tools then perform deterministic calculation, separating clinical language understanding from rule execution and arithmetic. Evaluated on the MedCalc-Bench dataset, our method achieves 86.73% final-answer accuracy, outperforming the one-shot prompting and supervised fine tuning-only baselines by 24.0 and 17.27 percentage points. Ablation and error analyses show that these performance gains are primarily driven by rule-grounded tool synthesis and schema-constrained extraction, whereas remaining failures are concentrated in clinical-semantic extraction and benchmark-specific output contracts. By grounding calculator logic in executable tools, the proposed approach alleviates arithmetic hallucinations and improves the computational reliability of the final clinical outputs.

</details>


### [525] [AI-Driven Disaster Response and Displacement Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21482)
*Noora Al-Emadi,Muhammad Imran,Yin Yang,Ingmar Weber,Fabjan Lashi,Gaia Rigodanza,Ivana Hajzmanova,Ferda Ofli*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该摘要综述AI在人道主义任务中的广泛应用，包括气候预测、能源优化、贫困预测、灾害响应与冲突监测等。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阐明AI具备可扩展、数据驱动的潜力，能够应对全球紧迫挑战，从而引出对该领域系统梳理的必要性。

Method: 以综述/举例方式，列举AI在各人道主义场景中的具体技术路径：AI气象模型、机器学习结合卫星影像与社会经济数据、损害与需求评估及流离失所追踪。

Result: AI在天气预报精度与速度、可再生能源控制与设计、森林砍伐监测、贫困预测、灾害与冲突监测等方面均展现出应用效果与创新方案。

Conclusion: AI已成为人道主义领域重要的赋能工具，但摘要未给出量化结论，仍需进一步讨论其局限、伦理与落地条件。

Abstract: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) has demonstrated its potential across a wide range of humanitarian tasks, offering scalable and data-driven solutions to some of the world's most pressing challenges. For instance, in addressing climate change, AI-powered models are being used for faster and more accurate global weather forecasting, control and design of renewable energy, and monitoring deforestation. Machine learning algorithms analyze satellite imagery and socioeconomic data to predict poverty and promote sustainable development. AI has also transformed disaster response and conflict monitoring, providing innovative solutions for assessing damage and urgent needs and tracking displacement.

</details>


### [526] [FlashAttention with Statistics: Low-Overhead Attention Features for Compact Hallucination Detectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21483)
*Andrei Volodichev,Maksim Savichev,Nikita Sviridov,Artem Yuliy,Dmitry Simakov,Alexey Zaytsev*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出无需物化注意力矩阵的注意力统计量计算方法（FlashAttention累积、稀疏查表、二次分块遍历），在极低开销下实现基于冻结代理模型注意力特征的支持性检测，4B代理在多数基准上优于9个零样本LLM评判器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM常生成上下文不支持的回答，需检测"上下文不忠实"输出；现有个体检测器依赖代理模型注意力权重的统计量，但标准流程物化注意力矩阵使内存随序列长度二次增长，代价过高。

Method: 设计三种免物化的注意力统计量计算路径：①在FlashAttention前向过程中累加；②前向之后稀疏查表；③对得分进行第二次分块遍历；据此将统计量分为近零开销与较高开销两类。并在冻结的Qwen3代理（0.6B–8B）上训练探针分类器，结合注意力特征进行检测。

Result: H100上，5个已发表检测器的统计量在2K token时仅增加Qwen3-8B前向16%延迟，35K时降至1.4%，每响应token存储22.5KiB；三个基准上，4B代理在两个基准的F1上超过9个零样本4-9B LLM评判器中最强者，代理匹配或超过至多7B的专用grounding checker；探针优于提示同一模型作评判器；12个基准-代理对中有一半加入注意力特征显著提升F1，且从无显著下降。

Conclusion: 注意力统计量可在不物化注意力矩阵的前提下近乎免费计算，使基于冻结代理模型探针的检测既高效又强于零样本LLM评判与专用检查器，注意力特征提供稳定增益。

Abstract: Large language models can produce fluent answers that the supplied context does not support. A compact frozen proxy model can detect such answers by reading the context and another model's response, even from a proprietary generator. Attention-based detectors use summary statistics of the proxy's attention weights, but standard pipelines materialize the attention matrix, whose memory grows quadratically with sequence length. We compute these statistics without materializing attention, by accumulation in the FlashAttention pass, sparse lookups after it, or a second tiled pass over the scores, and classify them by this path into nearly free and costlier ones. On an H100, the statistics of five published detectors add 16% to the latency of a Qwen3-8B forward at 2K tokens, falling to 1.4% at 35K, and store 22.5 KiB per response token. On three benchmarks, probes trained on frozen Qwen3 proxies of 0.6B to 8B parameters prove strong detectors: a 4B proxy outperforms the strongest of nine zero-shot 4-9B LLM judges in F1 on two of the three, the proxies match or outperform specialized grounding checkers of up to 7B parameters, probing each proxy beats prompting it as a judge, and adding attention features significantly improves F1 in half of the 12 benchmark-proxy pairs, never significantly lowering it.

</details>


### [527] [MetaExp: Learning to Self-Improve through Experience via Verifiable Cross-Task Environment Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21492)
*Renhao Li,Xinjie Shen,Yang Su,Jianhong Tu,Derek F. Wong,Dayiheng Liu,Min Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MetaExp 通过可控跨任务结构的可验证任务族训练模型，使"经验学习"本身成为可迁移的模型能力；在参数冻结的下游进化中，SpreadsheetBench +8.5、APEX-Agents 峰值 +2.3、AutomationBench +14.8。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型智能体可累积交互反馈，但难以可靠地把反馈转化为可复用经验。现有方法要么优化外部经验脚手架，要么在特定任务分布上训练与经验相关的行为，因而无法回答"经验学习本身能否成为可迁移的模型能力"。训练这种能力需要超越孤立任务的监督信号——孤立任务主要支撑回合内解题，而非揭示跨回合仍然有用的知识。

Method: 提出 MetaExp 可扩展框架，借助受控跨任务结构的可验证任务族进行训练：每个任务族保留一个可复用因子、变化任务特定实现，从而支持迁移而非直接复用解法。设两种互补设计：Shared-Tool 族固定黑盒工具以诱导操作性经验；Shared-Workflow 族在变化实现中保留潜在流程以诱导程序性经验。在两种设计下扩展环境，采集并过滤序列交互轨迹，用来自 1,000 个任务族的 4,956 条轨迹微调 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B。

Result: 下游进化时冻结参数，MetaExp 在 SpreadsheetBench 提升 +8.5 点，APEX-Agents 峰值 +2.3，AutomationBench 提升 +14.8；且在排除相关领域的训练设置下增益依然保持。

Conclusion: 经验学习可作为一种可迁移能力，支撑模型部署后持续的非参数式改进。

Abstract: Language-model agents can accumulate interaction feedback, but reliably turning that feedback into reusable experience remains challenging. Existing methods either optimize external experience scaffolds or train experience-related behavior on specific task distributions, leaving open whether experience learning itself can become a transferable model capability. Training such a capability calls for supervision beyond isolated tasks, which mainly support in-episode problem solving rather than revealing what knowledge remains useful across episodes. In this work, we introduce MetaExp, a scalable framework that trains this capability through verifiable task families with controlled cross-task structure. Each family preserves a reusable factor while varying task-specific realizations, enabling transfer without direct solution reuse. We propose two complementary designs: Shared-Tool families keep black-box tools fixed across tasks to elicit operational experience, while Shared-Workflow families preserve latent procedures across changing realizations to elicit procedural experience. We scale environments under both designs, collect and filter sequential interaction trajectories, and fine-tune Qwen3.5-122B-A10B on 4,956 trajectories from 1,000 task families. With parameters frozen during downstream evolution, MetaExp improves by +8.5 points on SpreadsheetBench, peaks at +2.3 on APEX-Agents, and improves by +14.8 on AutomationBench. The gains persist under domain-excluded training, supporting experience learning as a transferable capability for continued non-parametric improvement after deployment.

</details>


### [528] [ISW-Agent: Integrating LLM-Driven Dialogue with n8n Workflow for Internal Solitary Wave Remote Sensing Image Processing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21502)
*Hao Zhang,Hengrui Liu,Lina Sun,Junmin Meng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出 ISW-Agent，将大语言模型解析与 n8n 工作流及独立科学模型耦合，实现从自然语言指令到内孤立波（ISW）波锋预测的可追溯遥感处理链。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内孤立波遥感分析需要在影像获取、检测、条纹提取与传播预测等多环节间传递任务参数与空间信息，环节割裂、缺乏统一的自然语言驱动与校验机制。

Method: 以结构化任务约束、地理空间坐标转换和阶段化输出校验为纽带，将 LLM 语义解析、n8n 工作流编排与独立科学模型集成；每个后端测试 120 条中文指令，并用 Sentinel-1 场景与 3408 次故障注入实验评估。

Result: GPT-5.6 Sol 与 DeepSeek 均达 94.2% 严格任务匹配率，意图与执行决策全部与参考一致；50 个计时场景中 39 个完成检测—提取—预测，中位周转 48.04 s，11 个因空提取而终止；故障注入中重试恢复 234 次瞬态故障、输出校验拒绝 234 个结构缺陷，另有 61 个溯源或完整性错误。

Conclusion: ISW-Agent 可将自然语言请求连接至可追溯的空间处理链，实现多模型协同的内孤立波分析；但仍需补充内容一致性校验以覆盖溯源与完整性错误。

Abstract: Internal solitary wave (ISW) remote sensing requires task parameters and spatial information to be transferred across image acquisition, detection, stripe extraction, and propagation prediction. Here, we present ISW-Agent, which integrates large language model (LLM) interpretation with n8n workflows and independent scientific models through structured task constraints, geospatial transformations, and stage-specific output validation. In tests of 120 Chinese instructions per backend, GPT-5.6 Sol and DeepSeek both achieved a strict task-match rate of 94.2%, with all intents and execution decisions matching the reference. Sentinel-1 cases demonstrated continuous processing from dialogue requests to wavefront prediction for the specified scene. Of 50 timed scenes, 39 completed detection, extraction, and prediction with a median turnaround time of 48.04 s; 11 stopped after empty extraction. Across 3,408 controlled fault-injection runs, retries recovered 234 transient-failure conditions and output validation rejected 234 structural defects, while 61 provenance or completeness errors indicated the need for content-consistency checks. Overall, ISW-Agent thus connects natural-language requests to traceable spatial processing chains for multimodel ISW analysis.

</details>


### [529] [Decomposing Brain-LLM Alignment with Interpretable Semantic Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21508)
*Camila Kolling,Mariya Toneva*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 利用可解释语义表征SCRIBE分解LLaMA2-7B与大脑对齐中的语义信息，发现共享方差占主导，具体性语义属性与共享方差相关更强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM能预测自然语言理解时的神经响应，但其脑对齐背后的语言信息难以解释，需用可解释语义表征来拆解这种对齐的构成。

Method: 以SCRIBE（涵盖65个神经认知基础的语义属性的可解释情境语义表征）为透镜，在7名被试听叙事故事（Moth Radio Hour）的自然fMRI数据上，对LLaMA2-7B与SCRIBE做方差分解，区分共享与各自独有的脑预测方差；再分析语义属性具体性（concreteness）与两类方差的关系，并进行属性消融实验。

Result: 共享方差在全脑及语言相关区域均占主导，但两种表征仍保留显著独有贡献；具体性属性相比抽象属性在全脑及多数区域与LLaMA2-7B共享方差更大，而抽象属性未表现出更大的SCRIBE独有方差；属性消融显示语义贡献跨多个维度累积影响共享与SCRIBE独有方差。

Conclusion: 在该数据集上，LLaMA2-7B的脑—模型对齐有相当部分可归因于可解释的语义信息，同时LLaMA2-7B表征之外还存在互补的、具有脑预测力的语义信息。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) predict neural responses during naturalistic language comprehension, but the linguistic information underlying this brain alignment remains difficult to interpret. We use SCRIBE, an interpretable contextual semantic representation spanning 65 neurocognitively grounded semantic properties, as a lens for decomposing the brain alignment of one LLM, LLaMA2-7B. Using variance partitioning between LLaMA2-7B and SCRIBE on naturalistic fMRI data from seven participants listening to narrative stories (Moth Radio Hour), we separate brain-predictive variance shared between the two representations from variance unique to each. We find that shared variance is the dominant component across the whole brain and language-related regions, while both representations also retain significant unique contributions. We then examine whether the concreteness of individual semantic properties relates to shared and SCRIBE-unique brain-predictive variance. Concrete properties show greater shared variance with LLaMA2-7B than abstract properties across the whole brain and most examined regions, whereas abstract properties do not show greater SCRIBE-unique variance. Finally, property ablations reveal that semantic contributions extend across multiple dimensions, with cumulative effects on both shared and SCRIBE-unique variance. Together, these results show that, for LLaMA2-7B on this dataset, a substantial portion of brain-LLM alignment is associated with interpretable semantic information, while revealing complementary brain-predictive semantic information beyond the LLaMA2-7B representation.

</details>


### [530] [QREF: Improving DeepSearch Agents by Aligning Search with Reasoning via Query Refinement and Evidence Filtering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21512)
*Yujia Chen,Yuhui Wang,Junzhe Wang,Shihan Dou,Di Liang,Yujiong Shen,Yuhao Zhou,Zhiheng Xi,Ming Zhang,Senjie Jin,Jiayi Chen,Dingwei Zhu,Yajie Yang,Yuan Hua,Chenyao Lu,Tao Gui,Qi Zhang,Xuanjing Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出即插即用的QREF模块（查询精炼器+证据过滤器），通过SFT+RL优化，在不改架构、不重训推理策略的前提下提升DeepSearch智能体的检索质量与性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DeepSearch智能体在迭代检索与推理中存在查询意图错位、约束不足或冗余的问题，导致证据覆盖差、检索噪声不断累积，限制了整体表现。

Method: QREF包含两个组件：查询精炼器按当前推理意图重写搜索查询，并保证同一检索批次内查询的互补覆盖；证据过滤器保留与当前批次及推理目标均相关的证据。查询精炼器先经有监督微调初始化，再基于与真实网页搜索环境的交互用强化学习优化，以减少无效查询。

Result: 在四个挑战性基准上平均相对Pass@1提升33.55%（WebSailor）与11.04%（TongyiDeepResearch）；相比无QREF的原始骨干，RL训练的精炼器使缺乏判别性检索锚点的查询批次比例下降95%；相比仅SFT的精炼器，其基于过滤的无效查询比例也更低。

Conclusion: 通过外挂式查询重写与证据过滤即可显著改善DeepSearch的检索有效性与最终性能，且RL训练在降低无效查询方面优于纯SFT，具备良好的通用性与即插即用性。

Abstract: DeepSearch agents achieve strong performance on complex information-seeking tasks through iterative search and reasoning. However, they often issue intent-misaligned, under-constrained, or redundant search queries, resulting in poor evidence coverage and accumulating retrieval noise. To mitigate these limitations, we propose QREF, a plug-and-play Query Refiner and Evidence Filter. Specifically, the Query Refiner rewrites search queries according to the current reasoning intent while ensuring complementary coverage across each search batch. The Evidence Filter retains evidence relevant to both the current search batch and the reasoning objective, reducing distracting retrieval results. We initialize the Query Refiner with supervised fine-tuning and optimize it through reinforcement learning based on interactions with a real-world web search environment, reducing ineffective queries. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our approach improves the performance of DeepSearch agents across four challenging benchmarks, achieving average relative Pass@1 improvements of 33.55% on WebSailor and 11.04% on TongyiDeepResearch without modifying architectures or retraining their reasoning policies. Compared with the original DeepSearch backbone without QREF, the RL-trained refiner reduces the fraction of query batches that lack discriminative retrieval anchors by 95%. Compared with the SFT-trained refiner, it also lowers the filter-based ineffective query ratio.

</details>


### [531] [SCRIBE: Scalable Contextual Representations of Interpretable Brain-Grounded Semantics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21518)
*Camila Kolling,Omer Moussa,Emin Çelik,Mariya Toneva*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SCRIBE框架，用开源大模型集成构建可解释的词级情境化语义表征，行为实验达到人类噪声上限75-81%，并能显著更好预测语言选择性脑区的神经反应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实语言中的语义依赖情境而变化，而现有语义表征难以在自然场景下刻画这种情境依赖性，阻碍了对大脑如何建构语言意义的研究。

Method: 构建以神经科学为依据的语义空间SCRIBE，集成多个开源大语言模型，为任意文本生成可解释的词级语义特征表征；开展921人行为实验考察语义特征判断的情境变化，并用自然故事聆听时的脑活动数据做预测与方差分解分析（对照非情境化表征与句法特征）。

Result: 人类语义特征判断随情境系统性变化，SCRIBE能捕捉这些变化，达到估计人类噪声上限的75-81%；SCRIBE可预测语言选择性脑区的神经反应，显著优于非情境化语义表征；方差分解显示其解释的脑预测信息超出句法特征，具有独特贡献。

Conclusion: SCRIBE为在脑中研究自然语言语义提供了可扩展、可解释的基础框架。

Abstract: Understanding how the human brain constructs meaning from real-world language remains a fundamental challenge, as semantics depend on context that varies in natural settings. To enable the study of real-world linguistic meaning in the brain, we introduce SCRIBE, a framework grounded in a neuroscience-informed semantic space that leverages an ensemble of open-source large language models to generate interpretable, word-level semantic representations of arbitrary text. In a behavioral study with 921 participants, we show that human semantic feature judgments vary systematically with context, and that SCRIBE captures these shifts, reaching 75-81% of the estimated human noise ceiling. Using brain activity recorded while participants listen to naturalistic stories, we further demonstrate that SCRIBE predicts neural responses in language-selective brain regions, significantly outperforming non-contextual semantic representations. Variance partitioning reveals that SCRIBE explains unique brain-predictive information beyond syntactic features, suggesting that its representations capture aspects of linguistic meaning not accounted for by the measured syntactic features. Together, these findings establish SCRIBE as a scalable and interpretable foundation for studying natural language semantics in the brain.

</details>


### [532] [CriticaLLM: Using LLMs as Autonomous Game Master for Tabletop Role-Playing Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21525)
*Gaëtan Berlaimont,Justin Vanwichelen,Benoît Ronval,Hélène Verhaeghe*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CriticaLLM框架，一个可全自动运行完整桌面角色扮演游戏（TTRPG）的AI游戏主持人，涵盖故事生成、探索与战斗管理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM已具备处理长文本、遵循指令和生成创意的能力，可用于游戏与TTRPG场景；但TTRPG包含造故事、守规则、允许玩家自由行动等复杂要素，需明确LLM应具备的关键能力并构建可行的自动化系统。

Method: 首先归纳LLM在TTRPG语境下应表现出的关键组件；据此设计CriticaLLM框架，实现从生成多样化情节到管理探索阶段与战斗阶段的全流程自动化GM；随后邀请真实TTRPG玩家进行评估，并在四个不同规模LLM上考察生成情节与反派角色的多样性。

Result: 通过真实玩家评测以及对四种规模LLM生成剧情与反派多样性的分析，框架能够端到端运行完整TTRPG游戏，整体表现被视为有前景的方案。

Conclusion: CriticaLLM是将LLM用于全自动TTRPG主持的可行且有前景的方向，为后续在规则遵循、玩家自由度与叙事多样性方面的改进奠定基础。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown impressive capabilities across many tasks, including processing large amounts of text, following instructions, and generating ideas. This allows the use of such models in various contexts, including games and Tabletop Role-Playing Games (TTRPGs), such as Dungeons & Dragons. However, these games include many complex components, from crafting interesting stories to adhering to rules, while allowing some freedom in players' actions. In this work, we first highlight key components that LLMs should exhibit in the context of TTRPGs. Then, we introduce our framework, CriticaLLM, a fully automated Game Master that can run entire TTRPG games, from creating diverse and interesting stories to managing exploration and combat phases. We evaluate our framework with actual TTRPG players and examine the diversity of generated plots and antagonists across four LLMs of varying sizes. Overall, our framework appears to be a promising option for running entire TTRPG games.

</details>


### [533] [Functional Subnetwork Localization for Efficient Continual Learning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21537)
*Shuoran Jiang,Wentao Zhu,Yang Xiang,Dongfeng Li,Yunan Zhang,Mengchen Zhao,Yuhui Guo,Kai Chen,Youcheng Pan,Xiangping Wu,Qingcai Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CiMEO框架，通过定位LLM中互不重叠的功能子网络并按其路由训练样本，将参数与优化器状态更新限制在局部区域，在140万条序列指令上兼顾习得新技能与缓解灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物智能依靠局部可塑性在保留旧技能的同时持续适应新信息，而LLM的持续学习仍易发生灾难性遗忘。作者希望找到LLM内部功能专一的子网络，以实现定向、资源高效的适配。

Method: 先用梯度归因画像（gradient-attribution profiling）定位与认知相关的功能子网络，发现其相互重叠度极低；据此提出CiMEO：将每个训练样本路由到对应功能子网络，仅在被选中的区域更新参数与优化器状态，从而降低更新冲突与显存开销。

Result: 在覆盖编程、考试型任务与数学推理的五个生成式基准上，经140万条序列指令的持续训练，CiMEO取得对比方法中最高的平均性能，并有效缓解灾难性遗忘；子空间重叠度与主角度分析表明局部更新有助于保持预训练表征。

Conclusion: 功能子网络定位是一种实现高效、稳定LLM持续学习的实用途径，为资源受限下的顺序多任务学习提供了可操作方案。

Abstract: Biological intelligence continually adapts to new information while retaining prior skills through localized plasticity. In contrast, continual learning in large language models (LLMs) remains vulnerable to catastrophic forgetting. A promising direction is to identify functionally specialized subnetworks within LLMs that enable targeted and resource-efficient adaptation. Using gradient-attribution profiling, we localize cognition-associated functional subnetworks exhibiting extremely low mutual overlap. Building on this finding, we propose Function-isolated Memory-Efficient Optimization (CiMEO), a continual learning framework that routes each training example to its corresponding functional subnetwork, restricting parameter updates and optimizer states to selected regions. Across 1.4 million sequential instructions, CiMEO achieves the highest average performance among the compared methods on five generative benchmarks spanning programming, examination-style tasks, and mathematical reasoning, while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Subspace-overlap and principal-angle analyses further indicate that localized updates help preserve pre-trained representations, highlighting functional subnetwork localization as a practical approach to efficient and stable continual learning in LLMs.

</details>


### [534] [Agent Status Protocol (ASP): A Lightweight Specification for State Reporting in Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21538)
*Diego Gosmar,Deborah A. Dahl,Emmett Coin,Csaba Bolyós,Andreas Zettl*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ASP 0.1 是一个轻量协议提案：异构 AI 智能体通过 HTTP POST 推送 JSON 事件上报运行状态，服务端经 SSE 向观察者推送聚合状态，并通过心跳缺失、进度停滞检测及来自监督者/护栏/操作员/同伴的外部观测来弥补自报不可信的问题；状态沿生命周期、健康、任务、发言权、治理五个正交维度建模，复用 A2A、OFP 与 OpenTelemetry GenAI 语义约定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构 AI 智能体缺乏统一的运行状态上报与观测机制；且已崩溃、挂起或被攻陷的智能体无法可信地自报故障，单纯依赖自报不足以支撑可靠监控。

Method: 协议设计：智能体以 HTTP POST 推送小型 JSON 事件；服务端以 SSE 向观察者推送聚合状态。服务端通过心跳超时推断存活性，并可识别"存活但无进展"的智能体；同时接受来自监督者、护栏、操作员与同伴的外部观测，区分优先级覆盖与并列展示两种语义。状态沿生命周期、健康、任务、发言权、治理五个独立维度建模，任务状态复用 A2A、发言权状态复用 OFP、属性约定复用 OpenTelemetry GenAI 语义约定。

Result: 提出 ASP 0.1 协议规范草案，支持智能体同时处于多维组合状态（如在线、降级、执行任务且等待发言权），并给出与既有词汇表互操作的复用方案。文中未报告实现或评测结果。

Conclusion: ASP 0.1 为提案性工作草案而非已批准标准，旨在开启社区讨论；作者邀请评论、替代方案与独立实现。

Abstract: The Agent Status Protocol (ASP) defines a lightweight way for heterogeneous AI agents to report their operational state to a status server, and for observers such as dashboards to receive that state as soon as it changes. Agents push small JSON events over HTTP POST; the server exposes the aggregated state to observers over Server-Sent Events (SSE). Because an agent that has crashed, hung or been compromised cannot be trusted to report its own failure, ASP does not rely on self-reports alone: the server infers liveness from missed heartbeats, can detect agents that are alive but no longer making progress, and accepts observations from supervisors, guardrails, operators and peers, some of which take precedence over what the agent says about itself while others are shown alongside it. ASP models state along independent dimensions (lifecycle, health, task, floor, governance), so that an agent can be, for example, online, degraded, working on a task and waiting for the floor at the same time. It reuses existing vocabularies: task states from the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, floor states from the Open Floor Protocol (OFP), and attribute conventions from the OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions. This paper presents version 0.1 of ASP as a proposal, not as an approved standard. It is a working draft intended to open a discussion, and the authors invite comments, alternative proposals and independent implementations from the community.

</details>


### [535] [Reinforcement Learning-driven Diffusion Models: Language, Vision, and Beyond](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21539)
*Zhiyuan Ma,Jiabao Wei,Tianyu Wang,Hanqing Wang,Jiadong Pan,Haowen Xu,Liangliang Zhao,Ruixun Liu,Yuhan Wang,Yuwei Zhang,Liang Feng,Junhao Xiao,Kaiyan Zhang,Xuekai Zhu,Daizong Liu,Biqing Qi,Yihao Liu,Ganqu Cui,Ning Ding,Linfeng Zhang,Jianjun Li,Kun He,Xiang Bai,Bowen Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是首篇针对RL驱动扩散模型的综述，提出技术全景图，并通过实验分析RL重塑扩散过程的方式及三大瓶颈，给出未来路线图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统扩散模型在复杂推理、生成路径自主探索及复杂人类对齐目标上存在局限，受LLM中RLHF成功启发，RL作为后训练机制被引入扩散模型，但缺乏系统性梳理。

Method: 综述性研究：提出覆盖语言、多模态、机器人、科学模型的技术全景图，聚焦扩散轨迹优化与奖励工程；在多个任务专属基准上系统评测代表性方法。

Result: 直观展示不同RL后训练策略的优势，并揭示三大瓶颈：奖励设计脆弱性、高维生成空间中的探索-利用权衡、稀疏奖励下的训练不稳定性。

Conclusion: 提供RL与扩散模型融合的原则性路线图，展望鲁棒、可解释的RL-扩散系统方向，并建立公开仓库持续追踪进展。

Abstract: Diffusion models (DMs) have steadily demonstrated outstanding performance in high-fidelity, controllable generation across diverse scenarios, following the "pretraining-finetuning" paradigm established in LLMs. Despite these advances, conventional DMs still face critical limitations in sophisticated reasoning, autonomous exploration of generation pathways, and adaptability to complex, human-aligned objectives. Inspired by RLHF's success in LLMs, RL has recently emerged as a pivotal post-training mechanism to iteratively refine DMs through reward-driven trajectory optimization. This paper presents the first comprehensive review of RL-driven DMs and an empirical analysis of how RL reshapes the diffusion process towards experience-centric, goal-directed generation. We propose a novel technical panorama elucidating RL's multifaceted roles in diffusion-based language, multimodal, robotic, and scientific models, with a granular focus on diffusion trajectory optimization and reward engineering. Through extensive experiments on multiple task-specific benchmarks, we systematically evaluate representative methods to intuitively highlight the advantages of different RL post-training strategies. Furthermore, we reveal and dissect three crucial bottlenecks that currently hinder the real-world deployment of RL-driven DMs: reward design fragility, exploration-exploitation trade-off in high-dimensional generation spaces, and training instability under sparse rewards. Based on these perspectives, we provide a principled roadmap for the integration of RL into DMs and outline promising future research directions for robust, interpretable RL-diffusion systems. We also construct a public repository to continuously track the latest developments in this rapidly evolving field: https://github.com/MAIR-Lab-HUST/Awesome-RL-for-Diffusion-Models.

</details>


### [536] [ClaimScope: Label-Blind Witness Verification for Mathematical Claim Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21581)
*Mushir Akhtar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 ClaimScope，一个含72个任务的数学智能体审计基准（verdict/scope/counterexample/repair），把"判定结论"与"可执行证据"分开评估。在 Qwen3-8B 上比较直接生成与四种同草稿的两遍条件：见证检查器反馈带来 23/39 有效反例、25/72 安全完成（无检查器通用反馈为 15/39、20/72），严格完成仍为 17/72，判定准确率 47/72→46/72；增益主要来自见证结构修正而非推理能力提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数学智能体多以答案准确率或证明接受度评估，无法区分"结论判定"与"可执行证据/见证"两类能力，也难判断反馈增益究竟来自推理改进还是输出结构修复。作者因此需要一个能审计所提结论（判定、适用范围、反例、修复）的基准与匹配对照实验。

Method: 构建 ClaimScope 基准：72 个任务，覆盖优化器状态搬运、有限视界仿射递推、精确 2×2 线性代数，每个任务要求给出 verdict、scope、counterexample 与 repair。评估 Qwen3-8B：直接生成，加四种同草稿（same draft）的两遍条件，对照"见证检查器反馈"与"无检查器通用反馈"。见证检查器只评估模型自身提交的状态，不参考标准判定、不提供替代见证；被验证的反驳可确立命题为假，拒绝理由可提示结构性修正。另做仅 schema 的事后修正，不再调用模型。

Result: 在无效命题上，检查器反馈获得 23/39 被接受反例，通用反馈 15/39；安全完成 25/72 对 20/72。严格完成仍为 17/72；判定准确率由 47/72 变为 46/72。按命题聚类的安全完成差异为 .094，bootstrap 95% 区间 [.000, .198]。七个任务级增益均随视界/输入长度诊断出现。仅 schema 的事后修正即可在不额外调用模型的情况下达到同样 25 个安全任务。

Conclusion: 结果把命题分类与可执行证据区分开来，并将观察到的增益定位于见证结构修正，而非更广泛的推理能力提升；同时提示部分"反馈增益"可由输出模式约束复现，评估应显式报告严格完成与见证层面指标。

Abstract: Mathematical agents are commonly evaluated by answer accuracy or proof acceptance. We introduce ClaimScope, a 72-task benchmark for auditing proposed claims through a verdict, scope, counterexample, and repair. Tasks cover optimizer-state transport, finite-horizon affine recurrences, and exact $2\times2$ linear algebra. We evaluate Qwen3-8B with direct generation and four matched two-pass conditions, each starting from the same draft. A witness checker evaluates only the model's submitted state, without consulting reference verdicts or supplying a replacement witness. Its feedback still conveys information about validity: a verified refutation establishes that the claim is false, and rejection reasons can suggest structural fixes. In this evaluation, verifier feedback yields $23/39$ accepted counterexamples on invalid claims and $25/72$ safe completions, compared with $15/39$ and $20/72$ for checker-free generic feedback. Strict completion remains $17/72$; verdict accuracy changes from $47/72$ to $46/72$. The claim-grouped safe-completion difference is $.094$, with a bootstrap 95\% interval of $[.000,.198]$. All seven task-level gains follow horizon/input-length diagnostics. A post-hoc schema-only correction of the direct outputs reaches the same 25 safe tasks without another model call. These results separate claim classification from executable evidence, while locating the observed gains in witness-structure correction rather than demonstrating broader reasoning improvement.

</details>


### [537] [LOADBench: A Large Open Analog Dataset and Benchmark for Machine Learning in IC Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21591)
*M. Leibl,F. Azevedo,S. Uhlich,A. Bonetti,A. Venkitaraman,C. Hsieh,P. Pham,L. Servadei,H. Graeb,R. Martins*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一个面向模拟IC设计的开源大规模数据集（100+ 运放拓扑，SkyWater130 PDK，含标注、约束、Nsgpice测试台与NSGA-II多目标尺寸优化结果，每拓扑约10^3个Pareto最优与10^6个中间尺寸-性能对），并基于此定义六个标准化基准任务，实现可复现、可横向比较的评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习用于模拟IC设计受限于开放的标准化数据匮乏：不同论文多基于定制、常封闭的数据集与临时性指标，方法间比较不可靠。

Method: 构建开源数据集：>100个运放拓扑（1/2/3级），SkyWater130 PDK；每拓扑附带结构与功能标注、拓扑相关的尺寸约束（对称性与尺寸规则）、Ngspice测试台，以及NSGA-II多目标尺寸优化运行结果（每拓扑约10^3个Pareto最优解与10^6个中间尺寸-性能对）；在此基础上定义六个基准任务及精确协议：逆向尺寸、拓扑选择、子电路分类、结构电路生成、Pareto归属预测、多目标优化；并开源真值标注与指标例程参考实现。

Result: 数据集覆盖100+拓扑并附带完整标注、约束与仿真验证环境；六个基准任务具备明确评估协议；被称为四十余年模拟IC设计自动化中最全面的ML开发数据集，支持异构方法间的可复现、直接可比评估。

Conclusion: 通过开源数据与标准化基准同时弥补数据缺失与评估不统一两大缺口，为模拟IC设计的机器学习研究提供统一评测基础。

Abstract: Machine learning (ML) for analog IC design is constrained by limited open data and the absence of standardized evaluation: results reported in different papers are typically obtained on bespoke, often closed, datasets and with ad-hoc metrics, leaving comparisons across methods unreliable. We address both gaps with a large opensource dataset and a suite of standardized benchmarks. The dataset contains more than 100 operational amplifier (opamp) topologies (1-, 2-, and 3-stage) in the SkyWater130 PDK, each shipped with structural and functional annotations, topology-specific sizing constraints (symmetry and sizing rules), an Ngspice testbench, and a multi-objective NSGA-II sizing run producing around 103 Pareto-optimal and 106 intermediate sizing-performance pairs per topology. On top of this data we define six benchmark tasks with precise protocols: inverse sizing, topology selection, sub-circuit classification, structural circuit generation, Pareto-membership prediction, and multi-objective optimization. Thus, the data presented here constitutes the most comprehensive dataset for ML development in over four decades of analog IC design automation. The dataset, ground-truth annotations, and reference implementations of the metric-defining routines are released under an open license, enabling reproducible and directly comparable evaluation across heterogeneous analog design automation methods.

</details>


### [538] [LoopAhead: Speculating Ahead for Faster Decoding in Looped Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21594)
*Zixuan Liu,Nan Xue,Rui Bao,Yuhang Xu,Xiaofeng Cao,Jiangchao Yao,Zhiyong Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LoopAhead 为循环 Transformer 提出投机解码框架，利用早期循环状态预生成多个未来 token，并由深层循环反馈决定草稿分支的继续或暂停，全深度模型做最终决策，实现最高 7.82 倍解码加速且保持目标分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环 Transformer 虽提升参数效率，但逐 token 生成仍需顺序计算并反复访问权重，解码延迟高；现有流水线自投机解码仅从早期循环预测草稿并异步推进不同循环深度的 token，未充分利用早期循环特征做更长前瞻，且仍浪费算力验证错误的投机分支。

Method: 提出 LoopAhead 框架：设置轻量级前瞻草稿器（LAD），基于早期循环状态一次性预测多个未来 token；利用深层循环反馈判断哪些草稿分支继续、哪些暂停；由全深度模型进行最终 token 决策，并按不同循环深度分配互补角色。

Result: 相比自回归解码最高取得 7.82 倍解码加速，同时保持目标模型的输出分布不变。

Conclusion: LoopAhead 通过早期草稿、深层反馈筛选与全深度决策的协同，提升了循环 Transformer 的投机解码效率与前瞻长度，在分布无损前提下显著降低解码延迟。

Abstract: Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying the same Transformer layers. However, generating each token still involves sequential computation and repeated access to model weights, leading to high decoding latency. Recent pipelined self-speculative decoding methods reduce this delay by drafting tokens from early-loop predictions and asynchronously advancing tokens at different recurrent depths in the same batch, but they do not fully exploit early-loop features for longer lookahead and still spend computation verifying incorrect speculative branches. We introduce \method, a speculative decoding framework for looped transformers that enables earlier drafting of future tokens and assigns complementary roles to different recurrent depths. A lightweight lookahead drafter (LAD) predicts multiple future tokens with early-loop states, and deeper-loop feedback helps decide which draft branches to continue and which to pause, while the full-depth model makes the final token decisions. LoopAhead achieves up to 7.82x decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding while preserving the target model's output distribution.

</details>


### [539] [Evaluating Inquiry Learning in LLM-Based Agents: Hypothesizing, Reasoning, and Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21604)
*Marta Knežević,Seyed Parsa Neshaei,Jibril Frej,Vinitra Swamy,Tanja Käser*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出统一交互式框架评估LLM完整探究能力：将Countdown任务扩展为可主动操纵变量、收集观测并推断关系的数学环境，发现7个LLM内在探究能力有限、表达式还原成功率低，但教育支架式结构化引导可显著提升表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往工作将LLM的归纳推理、假设生成、数据分析等能力孤立评估，未考察其在完整探究循环（探索—假设生成—观测推理—假设精化）中的整合表现，缺乏统一、可交互的评估设定。

Method: 构建统一交互式探究评估框架：将Countdown任务扩展为数学环境，智能体通过操纵变量主动探测系统、收集观测并推断变量间关系，从而分析探索策略、因果发现与假设精化；在7个LLM及多种提示策略下进行实验，并引入受人类探究学习启发的教育支架式结构化引导。

Result: 各模型固有的探究能力有限，发现底层表达式的成功率低；结构化引导（教育支架）可显著提升性能；分析揭示了模型在策略性探索与迭代假设精化方面的不足。

Conclusion: LLM当前在策略性探索与迭代假设精化上仍存在明显局限；为人类学习者设计的简单引导策略可迁移至LLM，促进更有效的探究行为，表明统一交互式评估对刻画完整科学探究能力具有价值。

Abstract: Scientific inquiry involves iterative cycles of exploration, hypothesis generation, and reasoning over observations to uncover relationships in complex systems. Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in several components of this process, including inductive reasoning, hypothesis generation, and data analysis. However, prior work typically evaluates these abilities in isolation, leaving open how models integrate them across a full inquiry cycle. In this work, we introduce a framework for evaluating LLMs' inquiry capabilities in a unified, interactive setting. We extend the Countdown task to a mathematical environment where an agent probes the system by manipulating variables, collecting observations, and inferring relationships between them. This setup enables analysis of exploration strategies, causal discovery, and hypothesis refinement during inquiry. Across seven LLMs and multiple prompting strategies, our experiments reveal limited inherent inquiry capabilities and low success rates in discovering the underlying expressions. However, structured guidance inspired by educational scaffolding significantly improves performance. Our findings highlight current limitations of LLMs in strategic exploration and iterative hypothesis refinement, and show how simple guidance strategies developed for human learners in inquiry learning can support more effective inquiry behavior.

</details>


### [540] [Learning Intrinsic Dynamics in Latent World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21612)
*Jiamin Shi,Yuanhong Zhang,Zhiyang Liu,Jiawei Sun,Jingwen Fu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文探究"动作可预测性"与潜表征中内在动力学（动作—后果关系）保持之间的联系，并提出 Concat IDM（从拼接潜状态预测动作），在 Push-T 24 种外观下将规划成功率从 9.1% 提升到 77.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型需要学习内在动力学，即动作与其后果的关系；但与控制过程无关的视觉变化会干扰所学表征，使这一关系被掩盖，因此需要一种引导表征保留控制相关信息的归纳偏置。

Method: 理论层面：证明当编码器把同一状态、同一外观下不同动作的可区分结果合并时，平方逆预测误差存在正下界，而前向预测在这些转移上仍可精确。实证层面：通过控制外观多样性对比、监督干预与潜变量探针验证动作预测的作用。方法实例化为 Concat IDM——用拼接的连续潜状态预测动作，借助离线轨迹中已有的动作标签更新共享编码器，且不改变测试时规划器。

Result: Push-T（24 种外观）三次独立训练中，Concat IDM 将规划成功率从 9.1% 提升至 77.2%；其配对提升比单一外观情形高出 52.9 个百分点。

Conclusion: 动作可预测性可作为一种指向内在动力学的归纳偏置，Concat IDM 在视觉多样性下的潜空间规划中具有实际收益。

Abstract: Learning intrinsic dynamics---the relationship between actions and their consequences---is essential for world models. However, visual variations unrelated to the underlying control process can obscure this relationship in learned representations. We investigate the connection between action predictability, defined as the ability to reconstruct an action from consecutive latent states, and the preservation of intrinsic dynamics. Our central hypothesis is that encouraging action predictability discourages representations from discarding the distinctions between different actions and their consequences. We provide two complementary forms of evidence for this connection. Theoretically, we derive a positive lower bound on squared inverse prediction error when the encoder merges distinguishable outcomes of different actions from the same state and appearance, and show that forward prediction can still be exact on those transitions. Empirically, controlled appearance-diversity comparisons, supervision interventions, and latent probes support the role of action prediction in preserving control-relevant transition information. We instantiate action predictability with Concat IDM, which predicts actions from concatenated latent states and updates the shared encoder using action labels already available in offline trajectories, without changing the test-time planner. Across three independent training runs on Push-T with 24 appearances, Concat IDM increases planning success from 9.1% to 77.2%; its paired improvement is 52.9 percentage points larger than that observed with a single appearance. Together, these findings support action predictability as an inductive bias toward intrinsic dynamics and demonstrate the practical benefits of Concat IDM for latent planning under visual diversity.

</details>


### [541] [AgentPerturb: Evaluating LLM Agent Robustness under Controlled Interaction Perturbations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21624)
*Yuanjian Xu,Jinyi Han,Jianing Hao,Yuxuan Sun,Fanyang Lu,Richeng Xuan,Guang Zhang,Zhichao Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出一个二维框架（扰动目标×扰动类型），在APEX-Agents与Toolathlon上系统评估前沿LLM智能体的鲁棒性，揭示故障机制并给出面向鲁棒性的训练建议与基准构建流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实任务复杂且含噪，对LLM智能体构成重大挑战，但现有评测缺乏同时刻画“潜在扰动目标”与“扰动类型”的系统性框架，难以统一量化鲁棒性。

Method: 采用二维视角（扰动目标与扰动类型）开展统一研究；在APEX-Agents与Toolathlon上进行受控评测，结合轨迹级分析与成本分析，追踪扰动引发失败的机制，并提出严谨的基准构建流水线。

Result: 扰动持续导致性能下降，且主要脆弱性随任务环境而异；轨迹分析显示智能体极少识别被篡改的输入，常在未验证情况下传播错误信息；成功完成扰动轨迹往往需要显著更多计算。

Conclusion: 建议训练目标覆盖多样噪声形式，并奖励验证行为、不确定性意识与恢复能力；代码与数据将在AgentPerturb仓库发布。

Abstract: Real-world tasks are often complex and noisy, posing substantial challenges for LLM agents. Yet existing evaluations lack a systematic framework for jointly characterizing potential perturbation targets and types. We use this two-dimensional view to conduct a unified study that quantifies the robustness of current frontier models, traces the mechanisms behind perturbation-induced failures, and draws implications for robustness-oriented training. Through controlled evaluations on APEX-Agents and Toolathlon, we find that perturbations consistently degrade performance, while the dominant vulnerabilities vary across task environments. Trajectory-level analysis reveals that agents rarely recognize altered inputs and often propagate corrupted information without verification. A focused cost analysis further shows that successful perturbed trajectories can require substantially more computation. These findings motivate training objectives that cover diverse forms of noise and reward verification, uncertainty awareness, and recovery. We provide a rigorous benchmark-construction pipeline. Code and data will be released at https://github.com/xuyj233/AgentPerturb.

</details>


### [542] [The Self-Improvement Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21646)
*Brian B. Moser,Stanislav Frolov,Tobias C. Nauen,Federico Raue,Andreas Dengel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文将智能体建模为程序，用可能不可计算语义分数刻画"改进"，证明一般情形下不存在同时保证可靠性与非保守性的可终止门控/搜索过程；但在有界评测与有限提案预算的可判定体制下，穷举模拟可实现两者，且接受链仍可能在有界分数上升时使真实分数下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM驱动的智能体日益自主（写代码、调工具、改提示、修改自身组件），催生"安全自我改进"问题：奖励模型或自动审稿人等自动化门控能否可靠判定某次更新是否应被接受。核心困难是结构性的——门控必须是可终止的计算过程，而真正关心的"语义改进"依赖可能无界的程序行为，二者存在本质错配。

Method: 将智能体形式化为程序，以非必然可计算的语义分数定义"改进"。研究两类评测抽象：(1) 认证器（批准/拒绝更新）；(2) 搜索过程（给定提案生成器，若存在改进候选则输出之）。通过自指构造与随机化（有界错误）分析刻画不可能性；随后引入实践中常用的可判定体制——有界评测与有限提案预算——分析穷举模拟的可终止性与保证；最后构造反例分析该恢复方案的极限。

Result: 完全一般情形下，不存在可终止过程能同时保证可靠性（绝不接受非改进）与非保守性（绝不遗漏可用改进）；自指构造可迫使任何此类门控或搜索器失败，有界错误的随机化门控同样受此限制。在有界评测+有限提案预算下，穷举模拟给出具上述保证的可终止搜索过程；但存在接受更新链，使每轮有界分数上升而真实分数下降。

Conclusion: 论文划出一条边界：无界、通用的设定中正确性保证会崩塌；有界设定中保证可通过设计恢复，但恢复并不完备——有界代理指标可被系统性"刷分"。因此安全自我改进的门控设计须显式对待评测语义与有界性假设。

Abstract: With the rise of large language models, agentic systems are becoming increasingly autonomous, as they write code, call tools, revise prompts, and propose modifications to their own components. This autonomy raises a fundamental question for safe self-improvement: can an automated gate like a reward model or an automated reviewer reliably decide whether a proposed update should be accepted? The difficulty is structural. The gate must be a terminating, computable procedure, while the property we ultimately care about, namely whether an update is a genuine semantic improvement, depends on potentially unbounded program behavior. We formalize this mismatch by modeling agents as programs and defining improvement in terms of a semantic score that need not be computable. We study two evaluation abstractions. The first is a certifier that approves or rejects an update. The second is a search procedure that, given access to a proposal generator, attempts to output some improving candidate if one exists. We show that, in the fully general setting, no terminating procedure can simultaneously guarantee reliability (never accepting a non-improvement) and non-conservatism (never missing an available improvement): self-referential constructions can force any such gate or searcher to fail. Randomized gates with bounded error face the same limit. We then identify a standard decidable regime used in practice (bounded evaluation and a finite proposal budget) under which exhaustive simulation yields a terminating search procedure with the desired guarantees. We also show the limit of this recovery: a chain of accepted updates can raise the bounded score in every round while the true score falls. Our results draw a boundary between unbounded, universal settings where correctness guarantees collapse and bounded settings where they can be recovered by design.

</details>


### [543] [Data World: Scaling Data Environments from Scratch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21656)
*Zhanli Li,Zeyuan Xu,Chaoxu Pang,Zeyuan Liu,Anyang Ji,Te Sun,Kongcheng Zhang,Wenbo Xu,Xubin Yue,Shipeng Luo,Junjie Zhao,Yingfan Hua,Jingqing Ruan,Zhongda Su,Feng Hong,Zhizhao Zeng,Ke Zeng,Xunliang Cai,Hanjia Ye*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 Data World：先显式定义文件背后的"世界机制"，再据此合成环境、任务与评分标准，构建可审计的数据代理训练/评测体系（DataWorld-Bench 与 2,135 条训练任务），并用无轨迹蒸馏的 RL-zero 训练得到 DataWorld-35B-A3B，在多个基准上显著超过基座。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据代理用代码处理异构文件并产出分析洞察，但扩展其训练面临三大障碍：环境构建成本高；隐私与知识产权限制；开放式结论缺乏已知生成真值、难以验证。因此需要一个可控、可验证、可规模化生成的环境来源。

Method: 核心思路是在生成文件之前先形式化指定"文件背后的世界"（显式机制）。实现为多智能体引擎 Data World，从显式机制合成环境、任务和评分细则（rubrics）；独立审计检查目标能否从观测文件中恢复；rubrics 同时用于评测与 RL 奖励。通过人类偏好筛选问题真实性，从 50 个留出世界、16 个领域选出 100 个任务构成 DataWorld-Bench；另从 1,037 个不相交世界生成 2,135 条训练任务。训练侧采用 RL-zero（无可验证轨迹蒸馏）在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上训练。

Result: 对十个前沿模型的评测显示基准仍具挑战性，洞察发现尤为困难，并存在稳定的"计算—洞察"差距（computation-insight gap）。RL-zero 训练得到的 DataWorld-35B-A3B 在同口径评测下较基座提升：DataWorld-Bench +7.06、DAComp +14.28、DABstep-Hard +20.90、JobBench（更广泛职业基准）+12.13 分。

Conclusion: "先生成世界机制、再生成数据"的范式为数据代理提供了可审计、可验证、可扩展的合成环境与奖励信号，且仅靠 RL-zero 即可获得跨基准的泛化提升，表明该环境合成方式具备良好的迁移价值。

Abstract: Data agents use code to process heterogeneous files and derive analytical insights. Scaling their training faces costly environment curation, privacy and intellectual-property restrictions, and difficulty verifying open-ended findings without known generative truth. Our core insight is to specify the world behind the files before generating the files themselves. We introduce Data World, a multi-agent engine that synthesizes environments, tasks, and rubrics from explicit mechanisms. Independent audits check target recoverability from observed files; rubrics support evaluation and RL rewards. Human preference-based curation for question realism selects 100 tasks across 50 held-out worlds and 16 domains for DataWorld-Bench. The engine also yields 2,135 training tasks from 1,037 disjoint worlds. Evaluation of ten frontier models shows that the benchmark remains challenging, particularly for insight discovery, with a consistent computation-insight gap. RL-zero training on the synthesized tasks produces DataWorld-35B-A3B from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B without trajectory distillation. Under matched evaluation, it improves over its base by 7.06 points on DataWorld-Bench, 14.28 on DAComp, 20.90 on DABstep-Hard, and 12.13 on JobBench, a broader occupational benchmark.

</details>


### [544] [In-Context Preference-Conditioned Pareto Set Learning from Limited Offline Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21736)
*Yiming Yao,Liang Zhao,Qingfu Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ICPSL框架：在大规模合成先验数据上预训练基础式超网络，给定离线观测即可单次前向生成问题特定的偏好条件Pareto解模型，免去逐偏好搜索与逐问题训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实场景中多目标优化常需离线进行、无法再评估目标函数，仅有稀疏覆盖决策与目标空间的静态数据集。现有方法要么对每个偏好单独优化，要么为每个问题训练专用Pareto解模型，导致跨偏好重复搜索与跨问题重复训练，效率低下。

Method: ICPSL通过在大规模多样化合成先验数据上预训练超网络（foundation-style hypernetwork），实现偏好维度与问题维度的双重摊销：输入未见问题的离线观测，超网络在一次前向传播中输出问题特定、以偏好为条件的Pareto解模型；该模型可复用于任意偏好下的解的预测，无需问题特定训练或偏好级搜索。

Result: 在合成与真实问题上，ICPSL生成的Pareto解质量高，并在问题特定解模型构建上取得显著加速。

Conclusion: ICPSL将Pareto集学习转化为上下文内（in-context）超网络生成问题，同时摊销偏好搜索与模型构建成本，为离线多目标优化提供高效、可复用的偏好条件Pareto解建模范式。

Abstract: Multi-objective optimization involves diverse preferences over conflicting objectives. Rather than returning a finite set of trade-off solutions, preference-conditioned Pareto set learning seeks to map a specified preference directly to a corresponding Pareto optimal solution. Yet in many real-world scenarios, optimization must proceed offline without further objective evaluations, leaving only a limited static dataset that sparsely covers the decision and objective spaces. Existing methods either optimize separately for each preference or train a problem-specific Pareto solution model, requiring repeated search across preferences or repeated training across problems. We introduce in-context preference-conditioned Pareto set learning (ICPSL), a framework that amortizes both preference-wise solution search and problem-specific model construction. ICPSL pretrains a foundation-style hypernetwork on a large and diverse set of synthetic prior data. Given the offline observations of an unseen problem, the pretrained hypernetwork learns to generate a problem-specific, preference-conditioned Pareto solution model in a single forward pass. The generated model can then be reused to predict solutions for arbitrary preferences without problem-specific training or preference-wise search. Experiments on synthetic and real-world problems show that ICPSL produces high-quality Pareto solutions while providing substantial speedups in problem-specific solution-model construction.

</details>


### [545] [DeciCAD: Harness-Grounded Learning of Action Policies for CAD Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21755)
*Yufeng Peng,Yixin Zhang,Ziyi Liu,Zhikun Xu,Jiarong Yang,Sijie Wang,Wenjie Feng,Qiyu Kang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出DeciCAD——面向CAD的领域原生agent harness，研究harness所定义的动作决策空间如何塑造LLM agent的行为与策略学习，并通过SFT与几何接地的在线强化学习（RL）训练策略，在多个CAD基准上取得更优F1与IoU，同时显著减少输出token。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent通过闭环动作策略运作，而决策空间由agent harness定义。CAD属于具有持久状态、几何约束和长程流程的专业领域，harness所诱导的决策空间如何影响agent执行与策略学习尚缺乏系统研究。

Method: 构建领域原生harness DeciCAD，提供语义CAD动作、面向决策的观测、环境反馈与持久状态转移；在此基础上设计学习流水线，从交互轨迹中提取因果决策监督，先做监督微调（SFT），再进行几何接地的在线强化学习。

Result: 在四个CAD基准上取得最佳F1与IoU，相较通用编码harness减少45%–88%的模型输出token；同等监督下SFT将F1从0.6883提升至0.7437并优于编码策略，后续在线RL将几何可用性从66.5%提升至73.5%、F1提升至0.7880。

Conclusion: harness所诱导的决策空间会实质性影响CAD中agent的执行表现与策略学习效果，领域原生harness设计与配套学习流水线是提升专业领域agent性能的有效路径。

Abstract: Large Language Model agents operate through closed-loop action policies whose decision space is defined by an agent harness. We investigate how this operating space shapes agent behavior and policy learning in computer-aided design (CAD), a professional domain characterized by persistent state, geometric constraints, and long-horizon procedures. We instantiate this perspective in DeciCAD, a domain-native harness that exposes semantic CAD actions, decision-oriented observations, environment feedback, and persistent state transitions. Building on this harness, we develop a learning pipeline that extracts causal decision supervision from interaction trajectories and improves the policy through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and geometry-grounded online reinforcement learning (RL). Across four CAD benchmarks, DeciCAD achieves the best F1 and intersection over union (IoU) while reducing model-output tokens by 45--88% relative to a general-purpose coding harness. Under matched supervision, its SFT policy improves F1 from 0.6883 to 0.7437 and outperforms the coding policy; subsequent online RL further raises geometry availability from 66.5% to 73.5% and F1 to 0.7880. These results demonstrate that the decision space induced by a harness materially affects both agent execution and policy learning in CAD.

</details>


### [546] [From Research Goals to Scientific Closure: Evaluating Agents Through Evidence-Supported Physics Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21767)
*Yijia Mao,Song Dai,Tao Chen,Xiangyu Lu,Linqian Zeng,Chenxi Hu,Sitong Zhou,Dongyang He,Xiaodan Mao,Linxuan Zhang,Tong Zhu,Yafu Li,Fangchen Yu,Peng Ye,Feng He,Yu Cheng,Yun Luo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PhysClosureBench基准（50个专家验证的强场/阿秒物理目标任务），以20项Atomic Score衡量局部科研完成度、以Research Closure（RC0–RC4）衡量研究闭合度；七个前沿LLM中Claude-Opus-5平均原子分最高（6.29/10）但仅32.7%达到RC4，揭示局部成果与完整研究闭合之间的持续鸿沟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评测多关注智能体的局部任务正确性或单一答案质量，缺乏对"能否自主组织完整科学探究并得到有充分证据支撑的结论"这一能力的度量，尤其在需要证据链与适用条件约束的物理研究场景中缺乏目标指定式（goal-specified）基准。

Method: 构建PhysClosureBench：50个经专家验证、目标指定的研究任务，覆盖强场物理、阿秒物理及邻近领域；每个任务只给出研究目标与关键科学约束，由智能体自行组织探究、生成并验证证据。评价采用双层体系：20项判据的Atomic Score度量局部科学成果；Research Closure（RC0–RC4）依据必要证据要求与适用范围条件是否满足，评估对研究问题的闭合程度。对七个前沿LLM进行多次运行与案例级分析。

Result: Claude-Opus-5取得最高平均Atomic Score（6.29/10），但仅在32.7%的尝试中达到RC4；全基准中36.2%的尝试虽原子分≥8/10仍未达RC4；七个模型在三次运行均达RC4的任务数显著少于"至少一次运行达RC4"的任务数，显示结果不稳定性。案例级分析表明，对生成结果的误读与未解决的物理适用性边界是导致闭合不完整的主要来源。

Conclusion: 当前AI智能体擅长局部科学步骤，却难以实现完整的研究闭合；局部成果分数高估了其端到端科研自主性，需在评测与系统设计中显式建模证据充分性、适用条件与跨次稳定性。

Abstract: Can AI agents organize scientific investigations that lead to well-supported conclusions? To evaluate this capability, we introduce PhysClosureBench, a benchmark of 50 expert-verified, goal-specified research tasks spanning strong-field, attosecond, and neighboring physics areas. Each task specifies the research objective and essential scientific constraints, while leaving the agent to organize the investigation and determine how to generate and validate the evidence needed to answer the question. A 20-criterion Atomic Score measures local scientific accomplishment, while Research Closure (RC0--RC4) assesses how fully the investigation resolves the specified research question based on whether its indispensable evidence requirements and applicable scope conditions are satisfied. We evaluate seven frontier LLMs, where Claude-Opus-5 achieves the highest mean Atomic Score (6.29/10) but reaches RC4 in only 32.7% of attempts. Across the benchmark, 36.2% of attempts scoring at least 8/10 still fall short of RC4, while all seven models reach RC4 on substantially fewer tasks in all three runs than in at least one. Case-level analysis further illustrates how misinterpretation of generated results and unresolved physical applicability limits can lead to incomplete closure. Together, these results reveal a persistent gap between AI agents' local scientific accomplishments and their ability to achieve complete research closure.

</details>


### [547] [RSIFlow: Adaptive Self-Improvement Workflows with an Evolving Meta-Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21791)
*Huan Zhang,Mingju Chen,Dongxu Zhou,Can Lv,Sen Cui,Faguo Wu,Shiji Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出RSIFlow，一个将自适应工作流编排与元智能体能力演化相结合的递归自我改进框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体自我改进方法（模型优化、harness演化、可执行产物精炼）及递归自我改进虽已扩展到改进机制本身，但仍难以根据不断变化的性能瓶颈自适应调整改进工作流，也缺乏利用执行反馈优化工作流编排的能力。

Method: RSIFlow从任务-智能体轨迹与环境反馈中诊断性能瓶颈，动态选择组件特定的改进工作流；随后由元智能体将工作流结果蒸馏为组件特定技能与跨组件原则，并演化自身harness以改进后续工作流编排。

Result: 在六个基准与两个主干模型上的实验中，RSIFlow在所有基准上取得SOTA平均性能；消融实验验证了自适应工作流编排与元harness演化的贡献。

Conclusion: 诊断驱动的自适应工作流编排与元harness自我演化相结合，可有效提升LLM智能体的递归自我改进效果，代码已开源。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in complex tasks, including code generation, tool use, and multi-hop question answering. Existing self-improvement methods enhance agent performance through model optimization, harness evolution, and executable artifact refinement, while recursive self-improvement (RSI) further extends optimization to the improvement mechanisms themselves. However, adapting self-improvement workflows to evolving performance bottlenecks while improving workflow orchestration through execution feedback remains a key challenge. We propose \textbf{RSIFlow}, a \textbf{R}ecursive \textbf{S}elf-\textbf{I}mprovement framework that integrates adaptive work\textbf{flow} orchestration with meta-agent capability evolution. RSIFlow diagnoses performance bottlenecks from task-agent trajectories and environmental feedback to dynamically select component-specific improvement workflows. The meta-agent then distills workflow outcomes into component-specific skills and cross-component principles, evolving its own harness to improve subsequent workflow orchestration. Experiments across six benchmarks and two backbone models show that RSIFlow achieves the SOTA average performance on all benchmarks. Ablation studies further demonstrate the contributions of adaptive workflow orchestration and meta-harness evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/1HUAN1/RSI-Flow.

</details>


### [548] [Co2In: a Bi-level Memory Incremental Learning Framework with Knowledge Encoding, Consolidation, and Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21804)
*Wenju Sun,Qingyong Li,Boyang Li,Wen Wang,Siyu Zhang,Yi Wei,Yangliao Geng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Co2In：受人类记忆机制启发的双层记忆增量学习框架，通过工作记忆编码新知识、整合到长期记忆，实现无样本类增量/任务增量学习的高可塑性与稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 增量学习需同时具备可塑性（获取新知识）与稳定性（保留旧知识），但二者平衡仍是智能系统的重大挑战；人脑依靠多种记忆单元协同编码与存储信息而实现优异平衡，论文由此获得启发。

Method: 提出Co2In框架，采用双层记忆架构：工作记忆负责自适应知识获取，长期记忆负责信息的持久保留。流程分三步：工作记忆先从新数据中学习，将知识编码进参数；随后执行巩固过程（consolidation），在已学参数中识别潜在模式并重表示为紧凑的知识表征；最后将知识表征与识别出的模式转化为独立网络层并整合进长期记忆。

Result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Tiny-ImageNet上，于无样本（exemplar-free）Class-IL与Task-IL设置下评估，Co2In取得最先进性能，且内存消耗高效。

Conclusion: Co2In通过工作记忆与长期记忆的协同（编码—巩固—整合）设计，使模型能够以高可塑性和高稳定性累积知识，在高效内存条件下优于现有方法。

Abstract: Incremental learning (IL) aims to continually acquire new knowledge (plasticity) while retaining previously learned information (stability). However, striking a balance between plasticity and stability remains a significant challenge for intelligent systems. The human brain achieves exceptional balance, owing to various memory units that collaboratively encode and store information. Inspired by human memory mechanisms, this paper introduces an IL framework with knowledge enCoding, Consolidation, and Integration (Co2In). Co2In is designed as a bi-level memory architecture: a working memory for adaptive knowledge acquisition and a long-term memory dedicated to the persistent retention of information. The two memory modules work cooperatively during IL. The working memory first learns from new data to encode knowledge into parameters. Subsequently, Co2In performs a consolidation process to identify underlying patterns in the learned parameters and re-express them into a compact knowledge representation. Next, the knowledge representation and the identified patterns are transformed into separate network layers and integrated into the long-term memory. These designs empower Co2In to accumulate knowledge with high plasticity and stability. We evaluate Co2In on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny-ImageNet under exemplar-free Class-IL and Task-IL settings. Experimental results show that Co2In achieves state-of-the-art performance with efficient memory consumption.

</details>


### [549] [CIM-Embed: Learning Instruction-Conditioned Multimodal Embeddings for Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21805)
*Yinghua Xu,Pengyang Xie,Yanxiang Zhou,Chuanzhi Tong,Xiao Xiao,Chaoqun Feng,Xiaoqing Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CIM-Embed 通过指令条件化的多模态嵌入与监督对比学习，直接生成可聚类表示，在自建 ProductMIC 基准上以 HDBSCAN 取得 95.01 的平均 V-measure，远超最强通用嵌入基线 WeMM 9B 的 53.06。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态对象在不同指令下需要不同划分（如电商商品按颜色、材质或两者分组），检索导向嵌入难以还原这些划分，生成式聚类又依赖中间描述或迭代决策，缺乏直接、无需已知簇数的条件化聚类表示。

Method: 提出 CIM-Embed 框架：采用监督对比学习（同组为正样本、异组为负样本，可跨任务纳入），配合异构结构化批处理以适配不同组数的任务；推理时将图像、文本与指令直接映射为嵌入，再用 HDBSCAN 在未知簇数下形成划分；并基于 Amazon Reviews 2023 元数据构建 ProductMIC 训练集与评测基准（5,373 商品、449 个单属性与组合分组任务、50 个训练未见的叶类目）。

Result: 全维嵌入加 HDBSCAN 时，任务内直接 SupCon 训练平均每任务 V-measure 达 95.01，而最强通用嵌入基线 WeMM 9B 仅 53.06；在 ProductMIC 上冻结训练所得编码器亦可提升域外条件分组表现，受控迁移实验可区分划分迁移与指令响应。

Conclusion: 指令条件化嵌入可直接作为聚类表示，无需中间描述或指定簇数即可还原多种划分；训练所得编码器具备一定域外迁移能力。代码与数据集将于录用后发布。

Abstract: Multimodal objects can require different partitions under different instructions, as when products in an e-commerce catalog are grouped by color, material, or both. Retrieval-oriented embeddings may not recover these partitions, while generative clustering often relies on intermediate descriptions or iterative decisions. This paper presents CIM-Embed, a framework for learning instruction-conditioned multimodal embeddings for clustering. Supervised contrastive learning uses same-group positives and negatives from other groups, optionally including other tasks; heterogeneous structured batches accommodate tasks with different group counts. At inference, the model maps each object's image, text, and instruction directly to an embedding; HDBSCAN then forms a partition without the ground-truth cluster count. We construct ProductMIC from product metadata in Amazon Reviews 2023, comprising training data and an evaluation benchmark for instruction-conditioned clustering. The benchmark contains 5,373 products and 449 single-attribute and compositional grouping tasks spanning 50 leaf categories excluded from our training. With full-dimensional embeddings and HDBSCAN, direct within-task SupCon training achieves a mean per-task V-measure of 95.01, compared with 53.06 for WeMM 9B, the strongest general-purpose embedding baseline evaluated. Frozen product-trained encoders also improve out-of-domain conditional grouping, while controlled transfer experiments distinguish partition transfer from instruction response. We will release the code and dataset upon acceptance.

</details>


### [550] [RoleQ: Role-Aligned Scales for Converting Language Models to Ternary](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21808)
*Johannes Knittel,Alec Helbling,Hanspeter Pfister*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 RoleQ 量化框架，按 Transformer 单元的功能角色（读/写残差流）而非权重矩阵布局来放置量化尺度，无需搜索或校准，在 0.6B–14B 模型上把三值量化的困惑度降低最多一半，几 GPU 小时即可将现有检查点转为 1.59 bit/权重。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低于 4 bit 的权重量化虽能压缩显存与带宽且困惑度尚可，但常损失事实知识与任务准确率；三值权重以往主要依赖从头训练或长时间微调，成本高。常规量化格式按权重矩阵布局放置尺度，与 Transformer 的功能结构不匹配。

Method: RoleQ 依据单元功能角色分配尺度：从残差流读取的向量（如输出投影）每个输出单元一个尺度，写入残差流的向量每个输入单元一个尺度。该规则为结构化规则，无需搜索、校准或额外存储状态，适用于整数与三值网格。另在第二三值平面上按 per-unit Fisher 显著性做稀疏放置，保持矩阵乘无乘法运算。

Result: 在旋转基下，该方法以一半求解开销达到逐层轴搜索的效果；三值下相较布局式放置困惑度最多减半，覆盖两个模型族、0.6B 至 14B 全尺寸，而行级尺度会使 MMLU 跌至随机水平。轻量后训练流程数 GPU 小时即可把现有检查点转为 1.59 bit/权重，在困惑度、零样本准确率与 MMLU 上领先所有同等或更低驻留比特的后训练三值方法，知识类任务优势最广。8B 模型上，不到 1 bit 的额外预算可挽回约一半因转换损失的 MMLU，优于等比特下的随机或 Hessian 放置。

Conclusion: 基于功能角色的尺度放置是高效、无搜索的量化原则，配合稀疏第二三值平面可显著缓解三值量化的知识损失，为低成本后训练三值化提供实用方案。

Abstract: Weight quantization below four bits shrinks memory and bandwidth at a perplexity that looks acceptable, but often at the cost of factual knowledge and task accuracy. Ternary weights have mostly been obtained by training from scratch or long fine-tuning. We introduce RoleQ, a quantization framework that places scales by the functional roles of Transformer units rather than by the layout of the weight matrix, as conventional formats do. Vectors that read from the residual stream take one scale per output unit; those that write to it, one per input unit. The rule is structural, needs no search, calibration or stored state, and holds on integer and ternary grids. In a rotated basis it matches a per-layer axis search at half the solver work, and at ternary it cuts perplexity by up to half against layout-based placement in two families at every size from 0.6B to 14B, where per-row scales leave MMLU at chance. Our lightweight post-training pipeline converts an existing checkpoint to 1.59 bits per weight in a few GPU-hours, a fraction of the cost of learned ternarization, and leads every post-training ternary method at matched or lower memory-resident bits on perplexity, zero-shot accuracy and MMLU, most widely on knowledge. A sparse second ternary plane placed by a per-unit Fisher saliency keeps the matmul multiplication-free and recovers what ternary loses first: at 8B, a fraction of a bit returns about half the MMLU that conversion costs, well ahead of random or Hessian-based placement at equal bits.

</details>


### [551] [CoWorld Reasoner: Agentic Multimodal Reasoning with the Evolving Video World Model-Driven Harness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21910)
*Dongjie Cheng,Ruifeng Yuan,Ran Wei,Ning Song,Yongqi Li,Wenjie Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CoWorld Reasoner智能体框架，将视频世界模型作为统一视觉推理引擎，通过工具与技能灵活调度多种视觉想象操作，并以VLM-VWM协同演化迭代工具与技能，在七个时空与感知推理基准上超越直接推理的同一VLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM需具备超出输入图像的运动、动作与视角变化的时空推理能力；视频世界模型（VWM）可生成任务相关的视觉证据，但现有方法以固定流程调用VWM（如仅做新视角合成），难以适配多样推理任务的灵活视觉想象需求。

Method: 智能体框架CoWorld Reasoner：以VWM为统一视觉推理引擎，其Video World Model-Driven Harness通过工具暴露多种视觉操作，并用技能引导VLM判断是否需要进行想象、选择操作、构造生成请求并解释生成出的视觉证据；进一步提出VLM-VWM Harness Co-Evolution，在模型权重固定的前提下，依据执行反馈联合修订工具、技能与执行代码。

Result: 在涵盖空间智能、时序与因果推理、感知推理的七个基准上，CoWorld Reasoner均优于同一VLM的直接推理；最强变体在全部七个基准上均有提升，MMSI相对准确率提升11.8%、ERQA提升13.0%，并在五个基准上优于使用相同骨干的五个演化基线。

Conclusion: 将VWM作为可按需调度多种想象操作的统一推理引擎，并结合无需更新权重的工具—技能—代码协同演化，可有效增强VLM的时空与感知推理性能，优于固定流程式视觉想象与现有演化基线。

Abstract: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) advance, they are increasingly expected to perform spatiotemporal reasoning over motion, actions, and view changes beyond what the input images show. Video World Models (VWMs) provide a natural unified engine for visual imagination by generating task-relevant visual content as additional evidence. However, existing approaches typically invoke a VWM through fixed pipelines centered on a predefined form of visual imagination, such as novel-view synthesis. To support flexible visual imagination for diverse reasoning tasks, we introduce CoWorld Reasoner, an agentic framework that uses a VWM as a unified visual reasoning engine. Its Video World Model-Driven Harness exposes multiple visual operations through tools and uses skills to guide the VLM in deciding whether to imagine, selecting an operation, constructing a generation request, and interpreting the resulting visual evidence. We further introduce VLM-VWM Harness Co-Evolution, which jointly revises tools, skills, and execution code based on execution feedback while keeping both model weights fixed. Across seven benchmarks spanning spatial intelligence, temporal and causal reasoning, and perceptual reasoning, CoWorld Reasoner outperforms direct reasoning with the same VLM. The strongest variant improves on all seven benchmarks, including relative accuracy gains of 11.8% on MMSI and 13.0% on ERQA, and outperforms all five evolving baselines using the same backbone across five benchmarks.

</details>


### [552] [OntoAct: Hypothesis-Based Neuro-Symbolic Agents through Ontological Abstraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21983)
*Donghyeok Lee,Bong Gyun Kang,Junyong Ahn,Sungroh Yoon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 OntoAct，一个基于本体抽象的假设驱动神经符号框架，将经验转化为关于实体类型、关系和条件的公理以实现知识复用，并用 LLM 提出假设、符号验证器检验支撑条件；同时构建 Tacit-FLE 基准，用于诊断与修复工厂隐藏故障。在 Tacit-FLE、Mars、ALFWorld 上取得领先性能且交互与推理高效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从经验中学习需要恢复可复用知识并判断其在新情境下的适用性。现有方法难以将个体经验抽象为可跨情境迁移的知识，也缺乏对假设适用条件是否被当前观测支撑的检验机制，尤其在证据分散、需通过交互反复修正诊断的复杂任务（如工厂隐藏故障维护）中表现不足。

Method: OntoAct：以本体抽象为核心，将单个经验转化为关于实体类型、关系与条件的公理，使底层模式可跨情境复用；LLM 利用该世界知识提出假设与动作，符号验证器结合当前观测评估假设的支撑条件；验证过程识别缺失证据，新观测与干预结果用于更新假设评估并指导后续动作。另构建 Tacit-FLE 基准（基于 Factorio Learning Environment），含合成分散证据的维护语料库，且修复执行后故障可能仍未被解决，迫使智能体通过交互重新评估诊断。

Result: 在 Tacit-FLE、Mars 与 ALFWorld 三个环境中，OntoAct 均取得领先的任务表现，同时保持较高的交互效率与推理效率。

Conclusion: 基于本体抽象与假设-验证闭环的神经符号框架能有效实现经验知识的抽象复用与条件化适用判断，并通过交互反馈迭代修正假设，在诊断修复类与具身交互类任务中优于对比方法。

Abstract: Learning from experience requires recovering reusable knowledge and determining when it applies to a new situation. We introduce OntoAct, a hypothesis-based neuro-symbolic framework built on ontological abstraction. OntoAct turns individual experiences into axioms over entity types, relations, and conditions, making their underlying patterns reusable across situations. A large language model (LLM) uses this world knowledge to propose hypotheses and actions, while a symbolic verifier assesses their supporting conditions against current observations. Verification identifies missing evidence, and new observations and intervention outcomes update hypothesis assessments and guide subsequent actions. We also introduce Tacit-FLE, a benchmark built on the Factorio Learning Environment (FLE) for diagnosing and repairing hidden faults in existing factories using inherited operational records. Its synthetic maintenance corpus distributes evidence across records, and an executed repair may leave the fault unresolved, requiring agents to reassess their diagnoses through interaction. Across Tacit-FLE, Mars, and ALFWorld, OntoAct achieves leading task performance with efficient interaction and inference.

</details>


### [553] [CARA: Causally Guided Retrieval Agent for Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22017)
*Weicheng Liu,Xiangcheng Wu,Depeng Xu,Haopeng Zhang,Xi Niu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CARA：一种免训练、因果引导的检索智能体，通过"结果性"与"必要性"两个因果相关性准则评估证据，结合路径一致性与倒数排名融合，在三个STaRK数据集上检索与下游问答均优于现有方法，且探索节点更少、检索操作更少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本丰富知识图上的RAG需要识别真正有助于回答问题的证据，而非仅匹配文本内容。现有智能体检索器虽能自适应平衡全局搜索与多跳探索，但主要依赖文本相似度引导检索，容易偏离因果相关证据。

Method: 提出CARA（免训练的因果引导检索智能体），显式评估检索证据的因果相关性：(1) 结果性（consequentiality）——加入证据是否提升可回答性；(2) 必要性（essentiality）——移除证据是否削弱可回答性。将两项评估与路径一致性结合以引导图探索，并用倒数排名融合（RRF）聚合多智能体的证据。在三个STaRK数据集上评测，并为STaRK补充真值答案以支持下游问答评估。

Result: CARA在三个STaRK数据集上持续优于现有检索器；同时提升答案质量与忠实度，且检查的图节点更少、所需检索操作更少。

Conclusion: 因果相关性评估使智能体图检索更聚焦、更有效，同时提升检索性能与下游问答表现。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation over text-rich knowledge graphs requires identifying evidence that contributes to answering a question, rather than merely matching its textual content. Existing agentic retrievers adaptively balance global search and multi-hop exploration but primarily rely on textual similarity to guide retrieval. We propose CARA, a training-free, CAusally guided Retrieval Agent that explicitly evaluates the causal relevance of retrieved evidence through two complementary criteria: consequentiality, measuring whether adding evidence improves answerability, and essentiality, assessing whether removing evidence weakens answerability. CARA integrates these assessments with path consistency to guide graph exploration and employs reciprocal rank fusion to aggregate evidence from multiple agents. We evaluate CARA on three STaRK datasets and augment STaRK with ground-truth answers to enable downstream question answering evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that CARA consistently outperforms existing retrievers. CARA also improves answer quality and faithfulness while examining fewer graph nodes and requiring fewer retrieval operations. These findings demonstrate that causal relevance assessment enables more focused and effective agentic graph retrieval, improving both retrieval performance and downstream question answering.

</details>


### [554] [GraphACM: Graph-based Action Consistency Measurement for Uncertainty Quantification in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22031)
*Yaxin Ma,Wenbo Zhang,Satya Krishna Pothapragada,Alina Zare*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基于图的框架，对同一任务多次执行的行为一致性进行细粒度度量与不确定性量化，并据此预测任务成败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法只用单一任务级分数概括一致性，既不能定位行为差异发生的位置，也未保证比较是在等价决策情境下进行。

Method: 对同一任务的多条 rollout，将等价状态合并为带动作标签的有向图，从而在共享决策状态上比较动作；提出节点级与全局级动作一致性度量，并以全局一致性分数作为不确定性的代理指标来预测任务成功或失败。

Result: 在 ALFWorld、AppWorld、WebShop 三个环境、三个 LLM 上的实验表明，该度量与任务成功正相关，任务成功预测平均 AUROC 达 0.811，优于最强行为一致性基线（0.729）与言语化置信度（0.769）。

Conclusion: 状态条件化的行为一致性度量有效，可定位智能体动作一致的决策位置，并作为不确定性信号可靠预测任务成败。

Abstract: Behavioral consistency across repeated executions provides an informative signal for assessing the reliability of large language model (LLM) agents. However, existing approaches typically summarize consistency with a single task-level score, without identifying where behavioral differences occur or whether actions are compared under equivalent decision contexts. We propose a graph-based framework for fine-grained behavioral consistency measurement and uncertainty quantification. Given multiple rollouts of the same task, we merge equivalent states into a directed, action-labeled graph, enabling action comparisons at shared decision states. We introduce node-level and global measures of action consistency, using the global consistency score as a proxy for uncertainty to predict task success or failure. Experiments across three LLMs on ALFWorld, AppWorld, and WebShop demonstrate that our measure is positively associated with task success and achieves an average AUROC of 0.811 for task-success prediction, outperforming the strongest behavioral-consistency baseline (0.729) and verbalized confidence (0.769). These results highlight the effectiveness of state-conditioned behavioral consistency and pinpoint where agent actions agree.

</details>


### [555] [Progress Reward Model for Reinforcement Learning via Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22056)
*Xiuhui Zhang,Ning Gao,Xingyu Jiang,Yihui Chen,Yuheng Pan,Mohan Zhang,Yue Deng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PRM4RL框架，将LLM任务规划与基于势函数的稠密进度奖励结合，用于稀疏奖励长时序强化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统RL在稀疏奖励长时序任务上表现受限；现有LLM增强RL方法中，规划类方法依赖预定义技能库且不优化底层策略，奖励类方法需大量人工反馈或穷举搜索。

Method: 高层规划：将复杂任务分解为可管理的子任务序列，设计面向子任务的细粒度进度函数监测执行进度；底层奖励：受potential-based reward shaping启发，用进度函数构造Progress Reward Model（PRM）生成稠密奖励，并提供最优性与收敛性理论保证。

Result: 在机器人控制任务上优于基于LLM的规划方法与奖励方法，达到SOTA性能。

Conclusion: 将分层任务规划与理论可保证的稠密进度奖励相融合，可有效提升稀疏奖励长时序任务的策略优化效果。

Abstract: Traditional reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms face significant limitations in handling long-term tasks with sparse rewards. Recent advancements have leveraged large language models (LLMs) to enhance RL by utilizing their world knowledge for task planning and reward generation. However, planning-based approaches often depend on pre-defined skill libraries and fail to optimize low-level control policies, while reward-based methods require extensive human feedback or exhaustive searching due to the complexity of tasks. In this paper, we propose the Progress Reward Model for RL (PRM4RL), a novel framework that integrates task planning and dense reward to enhance RL. For high-level planning, a complex task is decomposed into a series of simple manageable subtasks, with a subtask-oriented, fine-grained progress function designed to monitor task execution progress. For low-level reward generation, inspired by potential-based reward shaping, we use the progress function to construct a Progress Reward Model (PRM), providing theoretically grounded optimality and convergence guarantees, thereby enabling effective policy optimization. Experimental results on robotics control tasks demonstrate that our approach outperforms both LLM-based planning and reward methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance. Code is available at https://github.com/deng-ai-lab/PRM4RL.

</details>


### [556] [FAOPs: Normal Forms and an Algebra for AI Agent Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22061)
*Ali Mohammadi Shanghooshabad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出FAOP形式化理论，将AI智能体工作流重构为类型化函数并施加四级渐进范式（分解、类型化、因子化、作用域化），配合可靠的代数重写规则与终止/优化/成本扩展，并在SkillBase系统中实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受监管行业要求AOP可追溯、可审计、可复现、受访问控制且时间成本有界，但AOP通常以粗粒度文件形式存储：步骤捆绑动作、复制产生的流程漂移、任一步骤可访问任意工具、重构缺乏校验，导致完整性与隔离性只能寄希望于运行时。

Method: FAOP将工作流抽象为作用于作用域状态的类型化函数，对库整体施加四级范式：FNF-1分解为原子步骤；FNF-2显式化并类型检查数据流；FNF-3为共享流程提供单一规范定义以消除漂移；FNF-4将每步限制于最小权限工具。规范化后每步成为具备声明式契约的独立实体。构建可证明可靠的等式代数使重构与并行化成为编译期重写；正交扩展+V（终止性验证）、+O（优化）、+B（时间与成本上界）；另设架构级分类器（0–3）判断工作流是否需要AI。

Result: 在SkillBase（AOP管理系统中类比PostgreSQL之于数据）中实现该理论，并配以独立执行器在运行时强制上述保证；以端到端金融工作流示例演示方法有效性。

Conclusion: FAOP使完整性、隔离、类型、终止、成本与优化成为整个库范围内的编译期关注点，而非运行时期望，为受监管场景下的智能体工作流治理提供数据库级纪律。

Abstract: Organizations increasingly encode operational procedures as multi-step agent skills, here called Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs), that must be traceable, auditable, reproducible, access-controlled, and bounded in time and cost, requirements that regulated sectors make mandatory. Yet AOPs are typically kept as coarse-grained files, in which steps bundle actions, copied procedures drift apart, any step may reach any tool, and refactoring goes unchecked. We present Functional Agent Operating Procedures (FAOP), a formal theory that brings database-grade discipline to AI agent workflows. FAOP recasts each workflow as a typed function over scoped state and subjects an entire library to four progressive normal forms: Decomposed (FNF-1) splits a workflow into atomic steps, Typed (FNF-2) makes its data flow explicit and type-checked, Factored (FNF-3) gives each shared procedure a single canonical definition so a change propagates instead of drifting, and Scoped (FNF-4) confines every step to least-privilege tool access. Once normalized, every atomic step is a separate entity with a declared contract and can be type-checked, scope-confined, bounded, tested, traced, and audited on its own.
